items.title: AI股遭拋售重創資料中心設備商 財報亮眼仍難逃賣壓
items.title_en: AI Stocks Plunge, Crushing Data Center Equipment Makers Despite Strong Earnings
paras: 《Yahoo Finance》報導，AI資料中心建設熱潮中的兩大關鍵供應商，剛公布遠優於預期的財報，華爾街卻依然大舉拋售這些公司的股票。
Bloom Energy(BE-US)為資料中心提供現場發電設備，該燃料電池製造商週四表示，上季營收年增138%，並將全年營收成長展望上修至約122%。負責安裝資料中心冷卻與電力系統的 Comfort Systems(FIX-US)則表示，未完成訂單金額幾乎翻倍，達到178億美元。
然而，這兩檔股票週五(23日)連續第二個交易日大幅下跌。Bloom Energy 大跌11%，Comfort Systems 重挫9%。為資料中心製造網路零組件的 Credo(CRDO-US)也同步下跌9%。
All Star Charts 的 Steve Strazza 週五上午寫道，「一家公司即使交出驚人的業績，如果投資人不願意給予相應的回報，那就代表某些地方出了問題。」
不過，Bloom Energy 的財報也確實提供了看空者一些質疑的理由。該公司上季現金流轉為負值，利潤率的改善也未能跟上營收成長。
不只兩檔股票遭殃
根據 Yahoo Finance 計算，自標普500指數10月6日創下收盤歷史新高以來，負責建造及供應 AI 資料中心設備的企業，股價跌幅中位數已達23%。這個族群包括開拓重工(Caterpillar)(CAT-US)、GE Vernova(GEV-US)、Vertiv(VRT-US)及Eaton(ETN-US)等大型企業。
同期，電力生產商股價下跌14%，輝達(NVDA-US)下跌11%。反觀負責支付這些建設費用的大型科技公司，股價平均跌幅僅約5%。
換言之，收錢的公司，股價跌得比付錢的公司還要慘。
這樣的走勢與目前資料中心建設面臨的最大問題——供應不足——背道而馳。Jefferies分析師 Aniket Shah 週三表示，「目前 AI 資料中心建設最大的限制因素就是電力。」他並指出，社會大眾對新建資料中心的反對聲浪正在增加。連輝達執行長黃仁勳也表示，資料中心建設業者必須成為「好鄰居」。
阿波羅全球管理首席經濟學家 Torsten Sløk 本週撰文指出，運算能力的需求「遠遠大於供給」。他認為，若資料中心建設速度放緩，反而可能有利於掌握稀缺產能的業者，包括電力生產商及變壓器製造商。這些變壓器的交貨前置時間長達「26個月」。
他指出，真正的輸家將是「開發商與處於施工階段的投資人」，以及股價已反映所有建設都會如期完成的 AI 概念股。
Sløk 寫道，真正的風險在於，如果供給追上需求，或需求轉弱，原本的「稀缺局面就會消退」。如今就連他認為可能受惠的企業也遭到拋售，顯示市場正在押注最糟糕的情境。
自10月6日以來，12家大型資料中心建設商與電力相關企業的總市值，合計已蒸發超過3,000億美元。
然而，這些公司的訂單簿目前還看不出任何類似的惡化跡象。是未完成訂單的數據出了問題，還是股價反映過度悲觀的預期？
下一個關鍵考驗將在週三到來，微軟(MSFT-US)、Alphabet(GOOGL-US)及 Vertiv(VRT-US)將公布財報，亞馬遜(AMZN-US)則預計於週四公布業績。
這些公司的支出計畫，將揭示資料中心相關企業的未完成訂單是否會持續增加，還是對 AI 投資熱潮抱持懷疑態度的市場人士，其實看到了值得警惕的訊號。
paras_en: Yahoo Finance reported that two key suppliers in the AI data‑center construction boom just posted earnings far above expectations, yet Wall Street is still dumping their shares.

Bloom Energy (BE‑US), which provides on‑site power generation equipment for data centers, said Thursday that last‑quarter revenue grew 138% year‑over‑year and it raised its full‑year revenue growth outlook to about 122%. Comfort Systems (FIX‑US), which installs cooling and power systems for data centers, said its backlog of unfilled orders almost doubled to $17.8 billion.

However, both stocks fell sharply on Friday the 23rd for the second consecutive trading day. Bloom Energy tumbled 11%, Comfort Systems plunged 9%, and Credo (CRDO‑US), which makes network components for data centers, also slid 9%.
All Star Charts’ Steve Strazza wrote on Friday morning, “A company can deliver stunning results, but if investors aren’t willing to give it a commensurate return, something’s wrong somewhere.”
Still, Bloom Energy’s filing gave bears some ammunition. The company posted negative cash flow for the quarter and its profit‑margin improvement lagged behind revenue growth.
Not only those two stocks suffered

According to Yahoo Finance’s calculations, since the S&P 500 hit a record‑high close on October 6, the median decline for companies that build and supply AI data‑center equipment has reached 23%. The group includes heavy‑equipment maker Caterpillar (CAT‑US), GE Vernova (GEV‑US), Vertiv (VRT‑US) and Eaton (ETN‑US) among others.
During the same period, power‑producer stocks fell 14% and Nvidia (NVDA‑US) dropped 11%. By contrast, large tech firms that pay for the construction saw an average decline of only about 5%.
In other words, the companies that receive the money saw their shares fall harder than those that spend it.

That trend runs counter to the biggest current headache for data‑center builds—insufficient supply. Jefferies analyst Aniket Shah said on Wednesday, “Power is the biggest constraint on AI data‑center construction right now.” He added that public opposition to new data centers is growing, and even Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang has said builders must be “good neighbors.”

Apollo Global Management chief economist Torsten Sløk wrote this week that computing‑capacity demand “far outstrips supply.” He believes a slowdown in data‑center construction could actually benefit firms that control scarce capacity, such as power generators and transformer makers, whose lead times can stretch to 26 months.
He warned that the real losers will be “developers and investors still in the construction phase,” as well as AI‑themed stocks whose prices already assume all projects will be completed on schedule.

Sløk added that the true risk is that if supply catches up with demand—or demand weakens—the current scarcity will evaporate. Even the companies he thinks could benefit are now being sold off, showing the market is betting on the worst‑case scenario.
Since October 6, the combined market value of 12 large data‑center builders and power‑related firms has evaporated by more than $300 billion.
Yet there are no clear signs of order‑book deterioration at these companies. Is the backlog data flawed, or are stock prices reflecting overly pessimistic expectations?
The next key test arrives on Wednesday when Microsoft (MSFT‑US), Alphabet (GOOGL‑US) and Vertiv (VRT‑US) report earnings, with Amazon (AMZN‑US) slated to release results on Thursday.
Those spending plans will reveal whether unfinished orders for data‑center vendors will keep rising, or whether market participants skeptical of the AI investment frenzy are spotting warning signals.

items.title_en: New York FX Market: Dollar Rises, Yen Gains After AI Stock Plunge, French Debt Concerns Drag Euro
paras: 美元周五(23日)小幅上漲，美元指數本週變動不大。歐元則受法國政府公債遭拋售影響走低，法國債務風險溢酬升至2011年歐元區主權債務危機以來最高水準，歐元兌美元與日元均以週線收黑作收。日元受惠於週四AI概念股遭拋售引發的避險資金流入，兌美元本週上漲。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)上漲0.25%，報101.82，本週上漲約0.03%。
市場對法國國內動盪加劇及預算問題惡化的憂慮，持續打擊歐元。法國內政部長Laurent Nuñez表示，法國將於週六部署7萬名警察，並由特種警力支援，以因應抗議活動。此外，穆迪（Moody’s）也可能於週五調降法國的信用評等。
Bannockburn Global Forex 首席市場策略師 Marc Chandler 表示，「今天歐洲債券市場的壓力已有所緩解，但穆迪稍晚對法國債務評等的檢視仍是一項挑戰。儘管馬克宏政府已威脅動用軍事力量平息社會動盪，但週末可能仍會有更多活動發生。」
歐元兌美元下跌0.21%，至1.1191美元，本週下跌約0.43%。
歐元兌日元跌幅更大，一度觸及175.08日圓，創2025年10月以來最低。歐元兌日元下跌0.11%，本週跌約1.1%。
日元兌美元下跌0.1%，至156.9日元，但本週上漲約0.7%，創下9月中旬以來最佳單週表現。
三菱日聯金融集團（MUFG）資深外匯分析師 Lee Hardman 表示，「隨著本週尾聲的避險交易氣氛升溫，日元持續維持在較強勢水準。」
央行政策會議成市場焦點
交易員正關注下週美國聯準會（Fed）、歐洲央行（ECB）及日本銀行（BoJ）的政策會議。市場預期三家央行都將維持利率不變，但投資人將尋找未來貨幣政策走向的線索。
根據倫敦證券交易所集團（LSEG）數據，週四股市遭拋售後，聯邦基金利率期貨交易員下調了對聯準會12月升息的押注，但市場仍認為升息機率達81%。
交易員目前預估，歐洲央行12月升息的機率為66%。投資人將仔細檢視任何有關利率前景的訊號。歐洲央行總裁拉加德（Christine Lagarde）9月底曾表示，面對通膨，採取適度的政策反應是合適的。
採購經理人指數（PMI）數據顯示，歐元區民間部門10月成長速度放緩，降至四個月來最疲弱水準，主要受到法國經濟活動再度萎縮拖累。
花旗經濟學家 Giada Giani 表示，「我們認為，這次數據下滑讓PMI回到與其他經濟成長指標一致的水準，而非意味著未來下行風險正在增加。法國仍是拖累因素，但歐元區其他地區依然展現韌性。」
日本方面，週五公布的數據顯示，9月核心消費者物價年增率九個月來首度超過日本央行2%的通膨目標。分析師表示，這項數據顯示價格壓力正擴大至更多領域，也強化日銀近期升息的理由。
交易員目前預估，日本銀行12月升息的機率為61%。

paras_en: The dollar edged higher on Friday (the 23rd), with the DXY showing little change this week. The euro fell as French government bonds were sold off, pushing France's sovereign debt risk premium to its highest level since the Euro‑area crisis of 2011. Both the euro‑dollar and euro‑yen pairs closed the week in the red. The yen benefited from a flight‑to‑safety flow triggered by Thursday’s sell‑off in AI‑related stocks, rising against the dollar over the week.
In the New York close, the dollar index (DXY), which tracks the greenback against six major currencies, rose 0.25% to 101.82, up about 0.03% for the week.

Market worries about escalating domestic turmoil in France and worsening budget issues continued to weigh on the euro. French Interior Minister Laurent Nuñez said France will deploy 70,000 police officers, supported by special forces, on Saturday to address protests. Moody’s also may downgrade France’s credit rating on Friday.

Marc Chandler, chief market strategist at Bannockburn Global Forex, said, “The pressure on European bond markets has eased today, but Moody’s later review of France’s debt rating remains a challenge. Although the Macron government has threatened to use force to quell social unrest, more activity could still occur over the weekend.”
The euro fell 0.21% against the dollar to $1.1191, down about 0.43% for the week.
The euro‑yen pair slipped further, briefly hitting ¥175.08, the lowest since October 2025, down 0.11% and about 1.1% for the week.
The yen slipped 0.1% to ¥156.9 per dollar, but is up roughly 0.7% for the week, marking its best weekly performance since mid‑September.
Lee Hardman, senior FX analyst at MUFG, said, “With the hedge‑fund atmosphere heating up toward the end of the week, the yen remains firmly on the stronger side.”
Central‑bank policy meetings become market focus

Traders are watching next week’s policy meetings of the U.S. Federal Reserve, the European Central Bank and the Bank of Japan. Markets expect all three central banks to keep rates unchanged, but investors will look for clues on future monetary‑policy direction.

According to data from the London Stock Exchange Group, after Thursday’s equity sell‑off, Fed‑funds futures traders reduced bets on a December rate hike, yet the market still sees an 81% probability of a hike.

Traders currently estimate a 66% chance that the ECB will raise rates in December. Investors will scrutinise any signals about the rate outlook. ECB President Christine Lagarde said at the end of September that a measured policy response to inflation is appropriate.

Purchasing Managers’ Index (PMI) data showed that euro‑area private‑sector growth slowed in October to its weakest level in four months, mainly dragged down by a renewed contraction in French economic activity.

Citigroup economist Giada Giani said, “We think this data dip brings the PMI back in line with other growth indicators rather than signalling rising downside risk. France remains a drag, but the rest of the euro area continues to show resilience.”

In Japan, Friday’s data showed that September core CPI year‑over‑year finally exceeded the Bank of Japan’s 2% inflation target for the first time in nine months. Analysts said the figure indicates price pressure spreading to more sectors and bolsters the case for a near‑term rate hike by the BOJ.
Traders now assign a 61% probability to a BOJ rate increase in December.

items.title: 〈美股盤後〉油價衝破100美元！道瓊挫逾650點 費半小幅收紅、周線連三黑
items.title_en: US Stocks After Hours: Oil Prices Break $100, Dow Down Over 650 Points, Philly Semiconductor Slightly Up, Weekly Chart Shows Three Consecutive Black Candles
paras: 中東戰火再度升溫的疑慮推升油價，美股週五 (23 日) 普遍收黑，賣壓從前一交易日的科技股擴散至民生消費、公用事業及醫療保健等防禦性類股。道瓊重挫約653點，創下兩個月來最大單日跌幅。標普500指數下跌0.52%，那斯達克指數則在部分晶片股反彈支撐下，跌幅收斂至0.21%。費城半導體指數微升 0.44%。
市場近期受到人工智慧 (AI) 交易退燒、中東衝突可能擴大及美債劇烈波動影響，類股輪動明顯。美股週五賣壓進一步擴及民生消費、公用事業及醫療保健等防禦性族群，但拉長至整週來看，主要指數漲跌互見，顯示市場內部表現持續分化。
本週累計，道瓊則上漲0.4%，標普500指數下跌0.5%，那斯達克指數下跌0.7%，費半週線吞黑3.21%，連跌3週，創去年 11 月以來最長紀錄。
中東局勢成為週五市場主要壓力來源。美國與以色列可能規劃對伊朗發動新一波攻擊，伊朗則表示已準備好反擊，使原油供應中斷的疑慮再度升高。
美國總統川普稱美國可能再對伊朗採取軍事行動，並敦促德黑蘭接受談判，說法與他本月稍早稱期中選舉前不攻擊伊朗不同。
西德州原油期貨突破每桶100美元，布蘭特原油則逼近117美元，創4月以來最高收盤價，重新挑起市場對通膨的擔憂。在聯準會 (Fed) 即將公布利率決策之際，讓市場更加關注能源成本對通膨的影響。
美債市場方面，投資人週四因 AI 資料中心龐大融資需求及科技業借貸風險而轉向避險，帶動10年期美債殖利率一個月來首度跌破5%。
不過，隨著週五油價走高，美債回吐前一天部分漲幅，10年期殖利率回升逾4個基點至約4.999%，重新逼近5%關卡。
美股週五 (23 日) 主要指數表現：
NYSE FANG+ 指數中的科技五大巨頭僅微軟收紅。Meta (META-US) 下跌 0.96%；蘋果 (AAPL-US) 下跌 0.14%；Alphabet (GOOGL-US) 下跌 1.24%；微軟 (MSFT-US) 上漲 0.66%；亞馬遜 (AMZN-US) 下跌 0.95%。
半導體個股漲跌不一。AMD (AMD-US) 上漲 1.74%；博通 (AVGO-US) 下跌 0.48%；輝達 (NVDA-US) 下跌 0.59%；應用材料 (AMAT-US) 上漲 0.44%；高通 (QCOM-US) 上漲 1.78%。
記憶體與儲存族群漲跌互見。美光 (MU-US) 上漲 2.46%；威騰電子 (WDC-US) 下跌 2.97%；SanDisk (SNDK-US) 下跌 1.82%；希捷 (STX-US) 下跌 1.81%；SK 海力士 ADR (SKHY-US) 上漲 4.05%。
台股 ADR 漲多跌少。台積電 ADR (TSM-US) 上漲 1.49%；日月光 ADR (ASX-US) 上漲 2.52%；聯電 ADR (UMC-US) 上漲 1.94%；中華電信 ADR (CHT-US) 下跌 0.43%。
企業新聞
美國運通 (AXP-US) 急跌 3.62% 至每股 313.22 美元，成為拖累道瓊的個股之一。公司宣布將裁減全球約5%人力，理由包括因應AI發展及控制成本上升。開拓重工 (CAT-US) 下跌約2%，高盛 (GS-US) 跌逾1%，進一步加重道瓊壓力。
蘋果 (AAPL-US) 收黑0.14% 至每股 347.72 美元，週線收高1.83%，新款摺疊手機iPhone Duo上市後，有限的門市現貨迅速售罄，顯示這款起價接近2,000美元的裝置吸引買氣。
SpaceX正尋求在全美取得至少8萬處基地台站點，並已與至少一家大型行動通訊基礎設施業者洽談，持續推進地面通訊網路布局。SpaceX (SPCX-US) 揚升 1.89% 至每股 147.49 美元，週跌1.16%。
美國銀行將ServiceNow (NOW-US) 目標價調高至180美元，維持「買進」評等，理由是AI產品需求增加，可望支持營收持續成長。公司預計於10月28日公布第三季財報。ServiceNow 收高 1.25% 至每股 158.96 美元。
華爾街分析
Argent Capital Management投資組合經理Jed Ellerbroek表示，過去兩週投資人持續從科技股及資料中心受惠股轉向防禦性標的，但這股輪動終究會耗盡動能，週五盤勢正反映這種情況。
他認為，近期部分科技業者公布的財報表現良好，提供投資人重新評估科技股的理由，市場不必完全受避險情緒主導。
美國銀行策略師Michael Hartnett則維持審慎立場，預期AI交易疑慮與美國期中選舉的不確定性，將使避險情緒延續至11月中旬。他預期，美債殖利率、股市及美元可能同步走低。
瑞銀投資總監辦公室的Ulrike Hoffmann-Burchardi看法相對正面，認為企業獲利仍有望支撐股市，AI需求也依然強勁，單憑地緣政治發展，尚不足以支持全面轉向防禦性配置。
PIMCO經濟學家Tiffany Wilding指出，AI正在提振美國需求，而多項通膨指標仍高於目標，Fed透過適度調整利率及收緊金融情勢來因應具有合理性。不過，目前通膨雖偏高，尚未持續加速，應能讓Fed保有循序調整政策的空間。

paras_en: Middle‑East tensions reignited, pushing oil prices higher. US equities on Friday (the 23rd) mostly closed lower, with selling spreading from tech stocks the previous day to defensive sectors such as consumer staples, utilities and healthcare. The Dow plunged about 653 points, marking its biggest single‑day drop in two months. The S&P 500 fell 0.52%, while the Nasdaq’s decline narrowed to 0.21% thanks to a rebound in some chip stocks. The Philadelphia Semiconductor Index edged up 0.44%.

The market has recently been affected by a cooling off in AI‑driven trading, the risk of an expanding Middle‑East conflict, and volatile US Treasury movements, leading to a clear sector rotation. On Friday, selling pressure further extended into defensive groups like consumer staples, utilities and healthcare, but over the full week the major indices showed mixed gains and losses, indicating continued internal divergence.

For the week to date, the Dow was up 0.4%, the S&P 500 down 0.5%, the Nasdaq down 0.7%, and the Philly Semiconductor Index’s weekly chart turned black with a 3.21% decline, marking three straight weeks of losses—the longest streak since November last year.

The Middle‑East situation was the main source of pressure on Friday’s market. The US and Israel may be planning a new wave of attacks on Iran, and Iran says it is ready to retaliate, reviving concerns about oil‑supply disruptions.

Former US President Donald Trump said the United States might take further military action against Iran and urged Tehran to come to the negotiating table, a stance that differs from his earlier comment this month that the US would not attack Iran before the midterm elections.

West Texas Intermediate crude futures broke the $100‑per‑barrel barrier, while Brent crude edged toward $117, its highest close since April, rekindling market worries about inflation. With the Federal Reserve about to announce its rate decision, attention is focused on how energy costs could feed price pressures.

In the US Treasury market, investors on Thursday shifted to safety amid massive financing needs for AI data centers and credit risk in the tech sector, pushing the 10‑year Treasury yield below 5% for the first time in a month.

However, as oil prices rose on Friday, US Treasuries gave back some of the previous day’s gains; the 10‑year yield climbed more than four basis points to about 4.999%, once again edging toward the 5% threshold.
US equity performance on Friday (the 23rd):

Dow Jones Industrial Average down 652.82 points, or 1.23%, to 52,215.16. Nasdaq Composite down 53.52 points, or 0.21%, to 25,955.34. S&P 500 down 39.75 points, or 0.52%, to 7,623.68. Philadelphia Semiconductor Index up 47.49 points, or 0.44%, to 10,779.46. NYSE FANG+ Index down 46.66 points, or 0.26%, to 18,213.46.

Among the five big‑tech stocks in the NYSE FANG+ Index, only Microsoft posted a gain. Meta (META‑US) fell 0.96%; Apple (AAPL‑US) slipped 0.14%; Alphabet (GOOGL‑US) dropped 1.24%; Microsoft (MSFT‑US) rose 0.66%; Amazon (AMZN‑US) declined 0.95%.
Semiconductor stocks were mixed. AMD (AMD‑US) up 1.74%; Broadcom (AVGO‑US) down 0.48%; Nvidia (NVDA‑US) down 0.59%; Applied Materials (AMAT‑US) up 0.44%; Qualcomm (QCOM‑US) up 1.78%.

Memory and storage stocks showed both gains and losses. Micron (MU‑US) up 2.46%; Western Digital (WDC‑US) down 2.97%; SanDisk (SNDK‑US) down 1.82%; Seagate (STX‑US) down 1.81%; SK Hynix ADR (SKHY‑US) up 4.05%.
Taiwan ADRs rose more than they fell. TSMC ADR (TSM‑US) up 1.49%; ASE Technology ADR (ASX‑US) up 2.52%; UMC ADR (UMC‑US) up 1.94%; Chunghwa Telecom ADR (CHT‑US) down 0.43%.
Corporate news

American Express (AXP‑US) plunged 3.62% to $313.22, becoming one of the Dow‑dragging stocks. The company announced a global workforce reduction of about 5%, citing AI development and rising cost pressures. Caterpillar (CAT‑US) fell roughly 2%, and Goldman Sachs (GS‑US) dropped over 1%, adding further pressure to the Dow.

Apple (AAPL‑US) closed down 0.14% at $347.72, up 1.83% on the weekly chart. After the launch of the new foldable iPhone Duo, limited in‑store inventory sold out quickly, indicating strong demand for the device priced near $2,000.

SpaceX is seeking to secure at least 80,000 ground‑station sites across the United States and has been in talks with at least one major mobile‑network infrastructure provider to continue expanding its terrestrial communications network. SpaceX (SPCX‑US) rose 1.89% to $147.49, though it fell 1.16% for the week.

Bank of America raised ServiceNow’s (NOW‑US) target price to $180 and kept a “Buy” rating, citing growing AI product demand that should sustain revenue growth. The company is slated to report its Q3 results on October 28. ServiceNow gained 1.25% to $158.96.
Wall Street commentary

Jed Ellerbroek, portfolio manager at Argent Capital Management, said that over the past two weeks investors have been rotating from tech and data‑center beneficiaries into defensive assets, but that this rotation will eventually run out of steam, and Friday’s market action reflected that dynamic.
He added that recent solid earnings from some tech companies give investors reason to reassess tech stocks, and the market does not have to be dominated entirely by risk‑off sentiment.

Bank of America strategist Michael Hartnett remains cautious, expecting that concerns over AI‑driven trading and uncertainty surrounding the US midterm elections will keep risk‑off sentiment alive into mid‑November. He forecasts that Treasury yields, equities and the dollar could all move lower together.

Ulrike Hoffmann‑Burchardi of UBS’s Investment Management Office took a relatively upbeat view, believing corporate earnings can still support the market and AI demand remains strong; geopolitical developments alone are not enough to justify a full shift to defensive positioning.

Tiffany Wilding, economist at PIMCO, noted that AI is boosting US demand while many inflation gauges remain above target. She said the Fed’s modest rate adjustments and tighter financial conditions are a reasonable response. Although inflation is still elevated, it has not accelerated further, giving the Fed room to adjust policy gradually.
All figures are updated as of the deadline; please refer to actual market quotes for the latest numbers.

items.title: 川普再提對伊朗動武：可能再來一次「史詩怒火」行動
items.title_en: Trump Again Calls for Military Action Against Iran: Possible Repeat of “Operation Epic Fury”
paras: 美國總統川普週五 (23 日) 表示，美國可能再次對伊朗採取軍事行動，並敦促德黑蘭接受談判解決衝突。這番言論與他本月稍早表示期中選舉前不會攻擊伊朗的說法形成落差。隨著戰事即將滿 8 個月，燃料價格上漲也成為美國期中選舉的重要壓力。
川普當天在佛羅里達州麥爾茲堡 (Fort Myers) 的造勢活動上談及伊朗戰爭時表示：「我們可能再來一次小規模的『史詩怒火』(Operation Epic Fury) 行動，或者他們會同意。」史詩怒火是美軍對伊朗作戰使用的行動代號。
他並未進一步說明可能採取的行動規模、時間或目標。
川普在演說中聲稱，美軍先前透過「午夜之鎚」(Operation Midnight Hammer) 行動摧毀伊朗的鈾濃縮能力，再以「史詩怒火」行動進一步打擊其核能力。
川普接著向伊朗喊話：「如果他們夠聰明，就會說：『我們來認真談吧。』」
不過，他隨即表示，自己懷疑伊朗會採取這種做法。
川普週五稍早才表示，美國有能力迅速結束戰爭，但他仍在思考華府究竟應尋求快速終結衝突，還是讓戰事逐步平息。
他本月稍早則曾表示，美國不會在期中選舉前對伊朗發動攻擊，凸顯其對戰爭時程與下一步行動的說法仍有變動。
這場自 2 月下旬爆發的戰爭，至今仍未正式落幕。儘管各方曾達成停火安排，並簽署旨在敲定和平協議的諒解備忘錄，最終協議仍未完成。
美國與以色列對伊朗的攻擊，以及以色列對黎巴嫩的軍事行動，已造成數千人死亡、數百萬人流離失所。
伊朗方面則持續釋出強硬訊號。
伊朗革命衛隊政治局負責人Yadollah Javani 警告，若敵方發動地面入侵，伊朗將成為入侵外國部隊的葬身之地。他聲稱，美軍在區域內的基地與行動已面臨限制，難以進入陌生領土並維持長期駐軍。
與此同時，埃及、沙烏地阿拉伯、土耳其與巴基斯坦外長在伊斯坦堡會談後發表聯合聲明，強調應透過對話與外交處理美以對伊朗戰爭，並呼籲全面恢復荷姆茲海峽的安全通航，反對限制合法航行的措施。
中東供應風險升溫，國際油價週五 (23 日) 大幅收高。布蘭特原油期貨上漲 3.55 美元，或 3.14%，收每桶 116.72 美元，創 4 月 29 日以來最高收盤價。
西德州原油期貨上漲 3.80 美元，或 3.8%，收每桶 103.27 美元。全週布蘭特與西德州原油分別上漲 6% 及 2.3%。
葉門胡塞武裝接連攻擊沙烏地阿拉伯，包括能源基礎設施，加上阿拉伯聯合大公國外海傳出油輪漏油事件，加深市場對中東能源供應中斷的疑慮，成為推升油價的主要因素。
paras_en: U.S. President Donald Trump said on Friday (the 23rd) that the United States may once again take military action against Iran and urged Tehran to accept negotiations to resolve the conflict. This statement contrasts with his earlier comment this month that the U.S. would not attack Iran before the midterm elections. As the war approaches its eighth month, rising fuel prices have become a major pressure point for the U.S. midterms.

Speaking at a rally in Fort Myers, Florida, Trump said regarding the Iran war, "We may do a small‑scale repeat of ‘Operation Epic Fury,’ or they will agree." Epic Fury is the code name the U.S. military uses for operations against Iran.
He did not elaborate on the possible scale, timing or targets of any such action.

In his speech, Trump claimed that U.S. forces had previously destroyed Iran’s uranium enrichment capability through an operation called “Midnight Hammer,” and would follow up with “Epic Fury” to further strike its nuclear capacity.
Trump then addressed Iran directly: "If they’re smart enough, they’ll say, ‘Let’s talk seriously.’"
He quickly added that he doubted Iran would take that approach.

Earlier on Friday, Trump said the United States has the ability to end the war quickly, but he is still weighing whether Washington should seek a rapid termination of the conflict or let the fighting wind down gradually.

He had earlier this month said the United States would not launch an attack on Iran before the midterm elections, highlighting that his statements on the war’s timeline and next steps have been shifting.

The war that erupted in late February remains officially unresolved. Although cease‑fire arrangements were reached and a memorandum of understanding aimed at finalising a peace deal was signed, a definitive agreement has yet to be completed.
U.S. and Israeli attacks on Iran, as well as Israeli military actions in Lebanon, have already caused thousands of deaths and displaced millions.
Iran continues to issue hard‑line signals.

Yadollah Javani, a senior official of the Iranian Revolutionary Guard’s political bureau, warned that if the enemy launches a ground invasion, Iran will become a graveyard for invading foreign forces. He claimed U.S. bases and operations in the region are now constrained, making it difficult for American troops to enter unfamiliar territory and maintain a long‑term presence.

Meanwhile, foreign ministers from Egypt, Saudi Arabia, Turkey and Pakistan, after meeting in Istanbul, issued a joint statement emphasizing that the U.S.–Israel war with Iran should be handled through dialogue and diplomacy, calling for the full restoration of safe navigation through the Hormuz Strait and opposing measures that restrict legitimate shipping.

Middle‑East supply risks are heating up, and international oil prices surged sharply on Friday (the 23rd). Brent crude futures rose $3.55, or 3.14%, closing at $116.72 a barrel, the highest close since April 29.
West Texas Intermediate crude rose $3.80, or 3.8%, to $103.27 a barrel. Over the week, Brent and WTI gained 6% and 2.3% respectively.

Yemen’s Houthi forces have repeatedly attacked Saudi Arabia, including energy infrastructure, and an offshore oil‑spill incident off the United Arab Emirates has heightened market concerns about Middle‑East energy supply disruptions, becoming a key driver behind the rise in oil prices.

items.title: 〈能源盤後〉中東戰火 阿聯酋漏油 利比亞減產 多重供應風險推升油價創近6個月新高
items.title_en: <Energy After-Hours> Middle East Conflict, UAE Oil Leak, Libya Production Cut: Multiple Supply Risks Push Oil Prices to Near‑Six‑Month High
paras: 中東局勢升溫推高原油價格，布蘭特原油 (Brent) 23日收盤大漲逾3美元，創4月29日以來最高收盤價。葉門胡塞武裝對沙烏地阿拉伯發動攻擊，加上阿聯酋沿岸發現油輪漏油事件，市場擔憂中東能源供應與重要航運路線可能再度受到干擾，進一步推升原油市場的地緣政治風險溢價。
布蘭特原油期貨收盤上漲3.55美元，漲幅3.14%，報每桶116.72美元；美國西德州中質原油 (WTI) 期貨上漲3.80美元，漲幅3.8%，收在每桶103.27美元。以單週表現來看，布蘭特原油上漲6%，WTI上漲2.3%，兩大指標原油均以週線上漲作收。
市場人士指出，近期油價走高的核心因素，是投資人擔心中東衝突進一步擴大，可能影響原油生產、出口及油輪運輸。LPL Financial跨資產策略主管Adam Turnquist表示，伊朗支持的胡塞武裝在沙烏地阿拉伯多地發動一連串攻擊，其中包括能源基礎設施，供應中斷疑慮因此推動油價上漲。
沙烏地阿拉伯是全球最大的原油出口國之一。根據《路透社》報導，沙烏地阿拉伯國家石油公司沙烏地阿美 (Saudi Aramco) (2222.SR) 22日下令撤離位於波斯灣沿岸、鄰近巴林的宰赫蘭總部。隨著沙烏地阿拉伯與葉門胡塞武裝之間的戰事升溫，市場開始重新評估該地區石油生產設施及出口路線面臨的安全風險。
除了軍事攻擊，阿聯酋也通報沿岸出現漏油事件。阿聯酋氣候變遷與環境部表示，在烏姆蓋萬沿岸海域發現油輪漏油，但尚未說明事故原因，也未確認涉事油輪的身分。由於事故來源與影響範圍仍不明確，事件為區域海上運輸及能源供應增添不確定性。
油輪安全同樣成為市場關注焦點。航運消息人士指出，10月9日，一艘名為Gem No. 2的超大型油輪在阿聯酋阿爾賈茲拉以西約13海里、相當於24公里處，遭不明飛行物或不明投射物擊中。近期油輪遇襲事件增加，令市場擔憂波斯灣能源運輸可能遭遇更多干擾。
Lipow Oil Associates總裁Andrew Lipow表示，市場正關注過去一週增加的油輪遇襲事件。他指出，雖然目前經由荷姆茲海峽外運的石油數量有所增加，但這種情況隨時可能改變。
荷姆茲海峽是全球重要的能源運輸咽喉，任何軍事衝突升級或航運受阻，都可能影響中東原油輸往國際市場的速度與數量。胡塞武裝與支持葉門政府的沙烏地阿拉伯領導聯盟之間的衝突也持續升溫。自伊朗支持的胡塞武裝上月向紅海入口處的曼德海峽方向推進以來，區域交戰情勢加劇，讓連接紅海與亞丁灣的重要航運通道面臨額外風險。
根據華盛頓一家自2017年起追蹤全球海上安全事件的智庫彙整資料，2026年10月已成為荷姆茲海峽及周邊水域商船遇襲事件最嚴重的一個月。商船安全風險升高，不僅可能影響實際運輸量，也可能推高油輪運費與保險成本，進一步增加原油交付成本。
美國總統川普23日表示，美國可能迅速結束與伊朗的戰爭，但也提到，華府或許應讓衝突逐步降溫。市場仍須觀察相關表態能否轉化為實際外交進展，以及區域軍事活動是否持續升高。
美國政府另一方面也開始動用戰略石油儲備，以應對煉油供應中斷。美國能源部表示，已批准從戰略石油儲備緊急交換最多40萬桶原油，以處理菲利普斯66 (Phillips 66) (PSX-US) 位於路易斯安那州湖查爾斯煉油廠面臨的供應中斷問題。
不過，美國戰略石油儲備目前已降至1982年以來最低水準。川普政府先前因美國對伊朗戰爭擾亂供應鏈而動用儲備；前總統拜登也曾在俄羅斯入侵烏克蘭後釋出戰略石油儲備，以因應能源市場動盪。當儲備水位已相對偏低時，進一步釋出原油的政策空間也可能受到限制。
歐洲方面，德國國家石油儲備機構EBV已發布招標，計畫出售戰略儲備中的柴油、取暖油及原油。這是七大工業國集團 (G7) 成員在10月初同意釋出戰略儲備後，德國首次採取相關行動。當時，川普向其他國家施壓，要求共同釋出石油儲備，以緩解能源價格上漲壓力。
中東之外，利比亞石油供應也出現變化。利比亞國家石油公司負責人22日向《路透社》表示，連接哈馬達與塔哈拉油田至扎維耶港的輸油管線閥門已關閉，導致兩座油田的產量下降。當中東供應風險與其他產油地區的生產問題同時出現時，市場可用供應量的不確定性也隨之增加。
此外，船舶追蹤資料顯示，自莫斯科與川普政府達成出口協議以來，首批運往美國的俄羅斯柴油已搭乘油輪前往紐約。川普本月宣布相關安排，目的是在11月3日美國期中選舉前，設法壓低持續上漲的柴油價格。這批柴油能否有效緩解美國燃料供應壓力，仍取決於後續交付與市場需求情況。
美國能源服務公司貝克休斯 (Baker Hughes) (BKR-US) 23日公布的數據則顯示，截至10月23日當週，美國石油與天然氣鑽井平台總數維持在603座，連續第二週持平。鑽井平台數量通常被視為未來油氣產量的先行指標，最新數據顯示美國鑽探活動尚未出現明顯變化。
整體而言，油價上漲反映的並非只有當前原油供應變化，更包含市場對未來供應中斷的預期。胡塞武裝攻擊、油輪安全風險、阿聯酋漏油事件，以及利比亞產量下降等因素交織，使能源市場面臨多重不確定性。後續油價走勢將取決於實際供應中斷的規模、航運能否維持正常，以及中東衝突是否進一步擴大。
paras_en: Middle‑East tensions are heating up, pushing crude oil prices higher. Brent crude closed on the 23rd up more than $3, hitting its highest close since April 29. Houthi forces in Yemen launched attacks on Saudi Arabia, and a reported oil‑tanker leak off the UAE coast has raised market fears that Middle‑East energy supplies and key shipping routes could be disrupted again, adding a geopolitical risk premium to the oil market.

Brent crude futures closed up $3.55, a 3.14% gain, at $116.72 a barrel; U.S. West Texas Intermediate (WTI) futures rose $3.80, a 3.8% increase, to $103.27 a barrel. On a weekly basis, Brent was up 6% and WTI up 2.3%, with both benchmark crudes finishing the week higher.

Market participants say the core driver of the recent price rise is investors’ worry that the Middle‑East conflict could expand further, potentially affecting crude production, exports and tanker transport. Adam Turnquist, cross‑asset strategy head at LPL Financial, noted that Iran‑backed Houthi attacks across Saudi Arabia, including on energy infrastructure, have raised supply‑disruption concerns and pushed prices higher.

Saudi Arabia is one of the world’s largest crude exporters. Reuters reported that Saudi Aramco (2222.SR) ordered the evacuation of its Za’haran headquarters on the Persian Gulf coast near Bahrain on the 22nd. As fighting between Saudi forces and Yemen’s Houthi rebels intensifies, markets are reassessing the safety risks to regional production facilities and export routes.

In addition to the military attacks, the UAE reported an oil‑tanker leak along its coast. The UAE Ministry of Climate Change and Environment said a leak was detected in waters off Umm al‑Qaiwan, but gave no details on the cause or the vessel involved. Because the source and extent of the spill remain unclear, the incident adds uncertainty to regional maritime transport and energy supply.

Tanker safety has also become a market focus. Shipping sources said that on Oct. 9 a super‑tanker named Gem No. 2 was struck by an unidentified flying object or projectile about 13 nautical miles (≈24 km) west of Al Jazira, UAE. A rise in recent tanker attacks is heightening worries that energy shipments in the Persian Gulf could face further disruptions.

Andrew Lipow, president of Lipow Oil Associates, said the market is watching the uptick in tanker attacks over the past week. He noted that while oil volumes shipped through the Hormuz Strait have risen, the situation could change at any time.

The Hormuz Strait is a critical global energy chokepoint; any escalation of military conflict or shipping blockage could affect the speed and volume of Middle‑East crude flowing to international markets. The clash between the Houthi rebels and the Saudi‑led coalition supporting Yemen’s government continues to heat up. Since the Iran‑backed Houthis moved toward the Red Sea’s Bab el‑Mandeb entrance last month, regional fighting has intensified, adding extra risk to the vital Red Sea‑Aden Gulf shipping corridor.

According to a Washington‑based think‑tank that has tracked global maritime security incidents since 2017, October 2026 has become the worst month for merchant‑ship attacks in the Hormuz Strait and surrounding waters. Heightened security risks could not only curb actual cargo volumes but also drive up tanker freight and insurance costs, further raising the cost of delivering crude.

U.S. President Trump said on the 23rd that the United States might quickly end its war with Iran, but also noted that Washington may need to let the conflict de‑escalate gradually. Markets will watch whether such statements translate into diplomatic progress and whether regional military activity continues to rise.

The U.S. government has also begun tapping the Strategic Petroleum Reserve to address refinery supply disruptions. The Energy Department said it has approved an emergency exchange of up to 400,000 barrels from the reserve to help resolve a supply issue at Phillips 66’s (PSX-US) Lake Charles refinery in Louisiana.

However, the Strategic Petroleum Reserve is now at its lowest level since 1982. The Trump administration previously drew on the reserve when the Iran war threatened supply chains; former President Biden also released reserve oil after Russia’s invasion of Ukraine to calm market turbulence. With reserves already low, further releases may be constrained.

In Europe, Germany’s national oil reserve agency EBV has issued a tender to sell diesel, heating oil and crude from its strategic stockpile. This is the first German action after the G7 agreed in early October to release strategic reserves. At the time, Trump pressured other nations to jointly release oil stocks to ease rising energy prices.

Outside the Middle East, Libya’s oil supply is also shifting. Libya’s National Oil Corporation chief told Reuters on the 22nd that valve closures on the pipeline linking the Hamada and Tahra fields to the port of Zawia have cut output from the two fields. With Middle‑East supply risks and production issues elsewhere emerging simultaneously, the amount of oil available to the market becomes even more uncertain.

Shipping data show that since Moscow reached an export agreement with the Trump administration, the first batch of Russian diesel bound for the United States has been loaded onto tankers heading to New York. Trump announced the arrangement this month aiming to lower rising diesel prices before the November 3 mid‑term elections. Whether this diesel can meaningfully ease U.S. fuel‑supply pressure will depend on subsequent deliveries and market demand.

Data released by Baker Hughes (BKR-US) on the 23rd show that for the week ending Oct. 23 the total number of U.S. oil and gas drilling rigs remained steady at 603, marking the second consecutive week of no change. Rig counts are viewed as a leading indicator of future oil‑and‑gas production, and the latest figures suggest U.S. drilling activity has not shifted markedly.

Overall, the price rise reflects more than current supply changes; it also embeds market expectations of future disruptions. Houthi attacks, tanker‑security risks, the UAE oil leak and Libya’s output decline intertwine, creating multiple uncertainties for the energy market. Future price direction will hinge on the scale of actual supply interruptions, the ability of shipping to stay normal, and whether the Middle‑East conflict escalates further.

items.title: 川普豁免部分加拿大商品50%關稅 助攻緬因州參議員連任
items.title_en: Trump Waives 50% Tariff on Some Canadian Goods, Boosting Maine Senator’s Re‑election
paras: 美國政府將調整對加拿大進口商品的關稅，豁免部分農業設備與包裝材料的 50% 加徵關稅，同時將約 100 類其他商品納入課稅清單，維持整體受課稅商品的貿易規模。這項調整可望減輕緬因州農業生產者的成本壓力，也牽動共和黨參議員柯林斯 (Susan Collins) 的連任選情。
美國總統川普週五 (23 日) 簽署總統公告，相關調整將自 10 月 30 日起生效。
獲豁免的商品包括合板、部分紙製品、特定機械、冷藏設備及包裝箱；新納入課稅清單的商品則包括可可粉、洗髮精、地毯、獨木舟及木製棺材等，顯示這次措施主要是重新分配關稅負擔。
參議員柯林斯同日宣布，川普政府將豁免 9 類加拿大商品的加徵關稅，涵蓋緬因州農業使用的瓦楞紙或紙板製紙箱、塑膠箱、包裝袋、冷藏與冷凍設備、部分機械，以及供人食用的海藻與其他藻類產品。
她表示，緬因州許多農民與種植業者仰賴加拿大供應的專用設備、包裝材料及其他產品，部分商品無法向美國供應商取得，或必須付出高昂成本才能找到替代品，額外關稅已加重當地企業與家庭的負擔。
柯林斯指出，自己多次與美國貿易代表葛里爾 (Jamieson Greer)、商務部長盧特尼克 (Howard Lutnick) 及其他政府高層交涉，爭取取消相關商品的關稅，未來也將持續尋求更多豁免，並推動美加達成更廣泛的貿易協議。
這項調整正值 11 月期中選舉前夕。
柯林斯面臨民主黨對手傑克森 (Troy Jackson) 的強力挑戰，而加拿大是緬因州最大的進口來源國，關稅對當地企業的衝擊已成為選戰焦點。
《Politico》引述知情人士指出，川普政府希望透過這項措施協助柯林斯爭取連任，同時維持對加拿大的整體貿易立場。另一名知情人士表示，相關減免已醞釀超過 1 個月，直到柯林斯近日與盧特尼克及葛里爾討論後，才敲定最後內容。
傑克森則批評，柯林斯先前支持任命推動關稅政策的政府官員，如今爭取局部減免，仍不足以解決問題。他認為，緬因州家庭早已需要援助，這波調整來得太晚。
民調顯示，雙方 (柯林斯與傑克森) 選情膠著。福斯新聞週四公布的民調顯示，兩人支持度持平；薩福克大學 10 月 14 日公布的民調則顯示，傑克森領先 2 個百分點。
白宮發言人Matthew Middleton 表示，總統此舉是回應加拿大持續對美國商業採取的歧視與報復措施，目標在於保護美國農民、製造商及勞工。
川普週五在佛羅里達州造勢時，也再次捍衛關稅政策，主張撤除關稅將導致工廠離開美國。不過，他同日稍早向記者表示，美國已接近與加拿大及墨西哥達成貿易協議，並強調協議必須符合美方利益。
美加貿易談判自 8 月破局後陷入僵局。
當時，加拿大總理卡尼 (Mark Carney) 召回談判代表，白宮隨後提高對價值 200 億美元加拿大商品的關稅，加拿大則於 9 月初採取對等反制。
卡尼週五表示，只要美方願意本於誠意談判，加拿大隨時準備坐下來協商。至於能否在美國期中選舉前達成協議，他表示，決定權在美方。
paras_en: The U.S. government will adjust tariffs on Canadian imports, exempting 50% of the additional duty on certain agricultural equipment and packaging materials, while adding about 100 other product categories to the taxed list, keeping the overall trade volume of taxed goods unchanged. The adjustment is expected to ease cost pressures on Maine’s agricultural producers and also affect Republican Senator Susan Collins’s re‑election prospects.
President Donald Trump signed a presidential proclamation on Friday the 23rd, with the changes taking effect on October 30.

The exempted items include plywood, certain paper products, specific machinery, refrigeration equipment and packaging boxes; the newly taxed items include cocoa powder, shampoo, carpet, canoes and wooden coffins, showing that the measure mainly reallocates tariff burdens.

Senator Collins announced the same day that the Trump administration will waive the additional tariff on nine categories of Canadian goods, covering corrugated paper or cardboard boxes, plastic crates, packaging bags, refrigeration and freezing equipment, certain machinery, and edible seaweed and other algae products used by Maine agriculture.

She said many Maine farmers and growers rely on specialized equipment, packaging materials and other products supplied from Canada; some items cannot be sourced from U.S. suppliers or would require prohibitively expensive substitutes, and the extra tariff has added to the burden on local businesses and families.

Collins noted that she has repeatedly negotiated with U.S. Trade Representative Jamieson Greer, Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick and other senior officials to secure the tariff removals, and she will continue to seek further exemptions and push for a broader U.S.–Canada trade agreement.
The adjustment comes just before the November midterm elections.
Collins faces a strong challenge from Democratic opponent Troy Jackson, and Canada is Maine’s largest source of imports, making the tariff impact a focal point of the campaign.

Politico quoted sources saying the Trump administration hopes the measure will help Collins win re‑election while maintaining an overall trade stance toward Canada. Another source said the exemptions had been in the works for over a month and were only finalized after Collins’s recent talks with Lutnick and Greer.

Jackson criticized Collins for previously supporting the appointment of officials who drove the tariff policy and argued that the partial relief is insufficient. He said Maine families have long needed assistance and that the adjustment comes too late.
Polls show the race is tight. A Fox News poll released Thursday showed the two candidates tied, while a Suffolk University poll from October 14 showed Jackson leading by two points.

White House spokesperson Matthew Middleton said the president’s action responds to Canada’s ongoing discriminatory and retaliatory measures against U.S. businesses, aiming to protect American farmers, manufacturers and workers.

Trump, campaigning in Florida on Friday, again defended the tariff policy, arguing that removing tariffs would cause factories to leave the United States. Earlier that day he told reporters the U.S. is close to reaching a trade deal with Canada and Mexico, emphasizing that any agreement must serve U.S. interests.
U.S.–Canada trade talks have been deadlocked since they broke down in August.

At that time, Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney recalled his negotiating team, and the White House subsequently raised tariffs on $20 billion worth of Canadian goods, prompting Canada to launch a reciprocal retaliation in early September.

Carney said on Friday that Canada is ready to sit down for negotiations whenever the United States negotiates in good faith, and he left it to the U.S. side to decide whether a deal can be reached before the midterm elections.

items.title: 要人命！澤倫斯基稱星鏈限速仍未解除 川普否認致電馬斯克
items.title_en: Lives at Stake! Zelensky Says Starlink Throttling Still Not Lifted, Trump Denies Calling Musk
paras: 烏克蘭總統澤倫斯基週五 (23 日) 表示，SpaceX 旗下星鏈 (Starlink) 及軍用衛星通訊服務星盾 (Starshield) 的限速措施仍未解除，持續影響前線無人機作戰與打擊俄軍後勤的能力。美國總統川普前一天才表示服務已恢復，週五則否認曾為此致電馬斯克，並稱若問題尚未解決，他會與對方聯繫。
澤倫斯基週五在社群平台 X 發文指出，星鏈與星盾的限制「仍然存在」，連線速度也尚未恢復。他表示，相關政策與限速措施讓作戰更加困難，但烏軍仍堅守前線。烏方同時仍在等待美國交付先前已議定提供的攔截飛彈。
自 10 月 14 日以來，烏克蘭官員持續指控 SpaceX 對星盾實施速度限制，導致飛行時速超過 100 英里 (約 161 公里) 的無人機失去連線，干擾部分作戰任務。
華府智庫 Silverado Policy Accelerator 主席、資安公司 CrowdStrike 共同創辦人Dmitri Alperovitch表示，烏克蘭正因此損失無人機，打擊俄軍後勤的能力也受到限制。
澤倫斯基的國防科技顧問Serhii Beskrestnov 也在 Telegram 證實，限制措施仍然生效。
Beskrestnov 指出，雖然個別案例顯示，星鏈可能在略微超出既有限制的情況下運作，但這較可能與 SpaceX 的演算法或特定使用條件有關，不能視為限速已經解除。
烏克蘭駐美國副大使 Denys Sienik 則表示，烏方仍在等待限制解除，讓前線部隊取得保護生命所需的能力。他強調，截至週五，情況並未改變。
烏方最新說法，與川普先前對服務恢復的描述出現落差。
《華爾街日報》週四報導，川普曾致電馬斯克，要求解除烏克蘭星盾終端設備的限制。川普當天未證實是否通話，但表示：「重點是，他 (馬斯克) 把服務恢復了。」
不過，川普週五矢口否認曾與馬斯克談論烏克蘭星鏈服務，並再次表示，他聽說問題已經解決。他在白宮外向記者說：「但如果還沒解決，我會跟他談。」
目前仍不清楚，究竟由誰決定限制烏克蘭的服務。
此事也引發美國國會關切。民主黨議員已要求調查馬斯克及星盾限速事件；另有跨黨派議員週四致函國防部長赫格塞斯，敦促國防部儘速擴大星盾相關安排，確保烏克蘭獲得不中斷的衛星通訊支援。
在服務持續受限之際，烏克蘭正尋求其他衛星通訊方案。澤倫斯基表示，他週三與挪威官員及國防企業 Kongsberg 會面，討論防空系統，以及為烏軍開發新的衛星通訊能力。
烏克蘭國防部週四另與諾基亞及芬蘭太空情報公司 ICEYE 簽署意向書，探索太空領域合作，並協助建立烏克蘭自主掌控的衛星通訊能力。不過，專家先前指出，目前其他服務尚難與星鏈相比，烏方短期內要取得替代方案仍有挑戰。
澤倫斯基在聲明中表示：「現代戰爭已證明，可靠的通訊攸關國家安全。我們都必須仰賴自己能夠掌控的能力。」
SpaceX (SPCX-US) 週五升超1.89%，收報每股 147.49 美元，盤中最高觸及 149.75 美元，最低下探 144.08 美元，市值約 2 兆美元，本週累計跌1.16%。
paras_en: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky said on Friday that the throttling measures on SpaceX’s Starlink and its military satellite communications service Starshield have not been lifted, continuing to affect frontline drone operations and the ability to strike Russian logistics. U.S. President Donald Trump had said the service was restored the day before, and on Friday denied having called Elon Musk about it, saying he would contact him if the problem remained unresolved.

Zelensky posted on X on Friday that the limits on Starlink and Starshield “still exist” and connection speeds have not returned. He said the policies and throttling make operations harder, but Ukrainian forces are still holding the front line. Ukraine is also still waiting for the United States to deliver the interceptor missiles previously agreed upon.

Since October 14, Ukrainian officials have repeatedly accused SpaceX of imposing speed limits on Starshield, causing drones traveling faster than 100 mph (about 161 km/h) to lose connection and disrupting some missions.

Dmitri Alperovitch, chairman of the Silverado Policy Accelerator and co‑founder of cybersecurity firm CrowdStrike, said Ukraine is losing drones and its ability to hit Russian logistics is being limited because of this.
Zelensky’s defence‑technology adviser Serhii Beskrestnov also confirmed on Telegram that the restriction measures remain in effect.

Beskrestnov noted that although isolated cases show Starlink may operate slightly beyond the existing limits, this is more likely due to SpaceX’s algorithms or specific usage conditions and should not be taken as the throttling having been lifted.

Ukraine’s deputy ambassador to the United States, Denys Sienik, said Ukraine is still waiting for the restrictions to be removed so frontline troops can obtain the life‑saving capability they need. He emphasized that as of Friday the situation had not changed.
Ukraine’s latest statements differ from Trump’s earlier description of the service’s restoration.

The Wall Street Journal reported on Thursday that Trump called Musk and asked him to lift the restrictions on Ukraine’s Starshield terminal equipment. Trump did not confirm whether the call took place, but said, “The point is, he (Musk) restored the service.”

However, on Friday Trump flatly denied having discussed Ukraine’s Starlink service with Musk and again said he had heard the problem was solved. Speaking to reporters outside the White House he said, “But if it isn’t solved yet, I’ll talk to him.”
It remains unclear who actually decides the restrictions on Ukraine’s service.

The issue has also drawn congressional concern. Democratic lawmakers have called for an investigation into Musk and the Starshield throttling; bipartisan senators on Thursday sent a letter to Defense Secretary Lloyd Austin urging the department to quickly expand Starshield arrangements to ensure Ukraine receives uninterrupted satellite‑communication support.

While the service remains limited, Ukraine is seeking other satellite‑communication solutions. Zelensky said he met on Wednesday with Norwegian officials and defence firm Kongsberg to discuss air‑defence systems and to develop new satellite‑communication capabilities for Ukrainian forces.

Ukraine’s defence ministry on Thursday signed a memorandum of understanding with Nokia and Finnish space‑intelligence company ICEYE to explore cooperation in the space domain and help build an indigenous satellite‑communication capability. Experts have warned that other services still cannot match Starlink, so finding a short‑term substitute will be challenging.
Zelensky stated in the release, “Modern warfare has shown that reliable communications are a matter of national security. We all must rely on capabilities we can control ourselves.”

SpaceX (SPCX‑US) rose 1.89% on Friday, closing at $147.49 per share, reaching an intraday high of $149.75 and a low of $144.08, with a market value of about $2 trillion and a cumulative weekly decline of 1.16%.

items.title: 半導體暴跌散戶受重擊！摩根大通：資金未撤出AI交易 反而擴大布局
items.title_en: Semiconductor Crash Hits Retail Investors Hard! JPMorgan: Funds Not Pulling Out of AI Trades, Instead Expanding Positions
paras: 分析師指出，散戶投資人在過去一周積極搶進人工智慧(AI)概念半導體股，但他們都在周四(22日)的市場重挫中遭受重創。
摩根大通(JPMorgan Chase)策略師Arun Jain表示，根據上周四至本周三的交易資金流向，散戶過去一周加碼買進晶片製造商、新型雲端服務(neocloud)商以及記憶體製造商。相較之下，對「科技七巨頭」(Magnificent Seven)的買盤則有所減弱。
Jain表示，散戶對個別科技股的買入力道，已升至7月動能交易退潮以來的最高水準。

半導體股重挫 散戶熱門標的同步下跌

由於市場憂心AI基礎設施支出過於龐大，標普500指數周四收黑，晶片股領跌，半導體類股指標下跌6.7%，創6月以來最大單日跌幅。這使散戶投資人承受沉重壓力。
散戶買進最多的個股包括SanDisk(SNDK-US)、台積電(TSM-US)，以及近來社群媒體的散戶投資論壇中受矚目的Nebius Group(NBIS-S)，這三家公司股價周四均下跌至少4%。
SpaceX(SPCX-US)截至周二是散戶熱門買進標的第四名，但該公司公布令人鼓舞的財報、周二盤後股價大漲7.8%後，投資人轉而賣出。

科技ETF吸金創紀錄 散戶並未撤出AI交易

散戶對科技類股ETF的需求更為強勁。上周科技ETF資金流入規模創歷史第二高，部分原因是散戶在上周後半逢低買進。
科技ETF單日流入金額在上周五刷新歷史紀錄，使全周買進規模增至高於歷史平均值2.1個標準差的水準。VanEck半導體ETF(SMH-US)也是吸引大量資金的基金之一。
摩根大通的數據顯示，自各大雲端服務業者7月公布強勁財報迄今，散戶原本一直偏好科技七巨頭，如今資金轉向該群組以外的股票，顯示散戶並未因市場波動加劇而放棄AI交易，而是擴大投資範圍。
Integrity資產管理公司投資組合經理Joe Gilbert說：「由於AI生態系展現出比最初預期更持久的獲利能力，投資人已從科技七巨頭轉向更廣泛的科技股。」

科技業獲利成長支撐買盤 通膨疑慮仍添壓力

今年科技業一直是企業獲利成長的重要推手，根據美國銀行(BofA)彙整的數據，標普500資訊科技指數成分股企業第3季獲利預估將成長66%，增幅僅次於能源與通訊服務類股。
Gilbert說：「即使在科技七巨頭以外的領域，尤其是在利率較高的環境下，投資人仍有可能以較低的本益比，找到獲利強勁成長的機會。」
不過。目前散戶對科技股的熱情尚未轉化為全面的買盤激增。摩根大通數據顯示，散戶該周的整體資金流向仍相對平淡。
(本文不開放合作夥伴轉載)
paras_en: Analysts note that retail investors aggressively chased AI‑related semiconductor stocks over the past week, but they were hit hard in Thursday’s (the 22nd) market plunge.

JPMorgan Chase strategist Arun Jain said that, based on fund flows from last Thursday to this Wednesday, retail investors added to positions in chip manufacturers, neocloud service providers and memory makers over the past week. By contrast, buying pressure on the “Magnificent Seven” tech giants weakened.
Jain added that retail buying intensity for individual tech stocks has risen to its highest level since the July momentum‑trade slowdown.

Semiconductor stocks tumbled, dragging down retail‑favored names. Concern that AI infrastructure spending is too large pushed the S&P 500 lower on Thursday, with chip stocks leading the decline; the semiconductor index fell 6.7%, the biggest single‑day drop since June, putting heavy pressure on retail investors.

The most‑bought stocks by retail investors were SanDisk (SNDK‑US), Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co. (TSM‑US) and the Nebius Group (NBIS‑S), which has been a hot topic on retail forums; all three fell at least 4% on Thursday.
SpaceX (SPCX‑US) was the fourth‑most‑bought retail pick as of Tuesday, but after the company posted encouraging earnings and its after‑hours price jumped 7.8% on Tuesday, investors turned to selling.

Retail demand for tech‑sector ETFs remained strong. Last week’s inflows into tech ETFs hit the second‑largest level on record, partly because retail investors bought on dips in the latter half of the week.

Daily inflows into tech ETFs hit a historic high on Friday, pushing the week’s total to more than 2.1 standard deviations above the long‑term average. VanEck’s Semiconductor ETF (SMH‑US) was among the funds attracting large capital.

JPMorgan data show that since major cloud providers reported strong July earnings, retail investors, who had previously favored the Magnificent Seven, have shifted money to stocks outside that group, indicating they are not abandoning AI trades amid heightened volatility but are broadening their exposure.

Integrity Asset Management portfolio manager Joe Gilbert said, “Because the AI ecosystem is proving more profitable than initially expected, investors are moving from the Magnificent Seven into a broader set of tech stocks.”

Tech earnings growth continues to underpin buying. According to Bank of America data, S&P 500 information‑technology constituents are projected to see third‑quarter earnings rise 66%, second only to energy and communications‑services sectors.
Gilbert added, “Even outside the Magnificent Seven, especially in a higher‑rate environment, investors can still find strong earnings growth at lower price‑to‑earnings multiples.”
However, retail enthusiasm for tech stocks has not yet translated into a broad surge in buying. JPMorgan data show that overall retail fund flows that week remained relatively modest.

items.title: 鴻海斥12.03億美元 增資新加坡、法國及捷克子公司
items.title_en: Foxconn Spends $1.203 Billion to Capital‑Increase Singapore, France and Czech Subsidiaries
paras: 鴻海(2317-TW)今(23)日公告，董事會通過對新加坡、法國及捷克子公司進行增資，交易金額分別為11.01億美元、5,800萬美元及4,400萬美元，合計斥資12.03億美元，作為長期投資用途。
鴻海公告指出，將對新加坡子公司eCMMS Precision Singapore Pte. Ltd.進行現金增資，認購普通股11.01億股，每股價格1美元，交易總金額11.01億美元。增資後，鴻海累計持有該公司19.13億股，持股比例達100%。
此外，鴻海也將對法國子公司Foxconn AI Solution (FR) SAS增資5,800萬美元，取得約510.07萬股，每股價格10歐元。增資後，鴻海累計持股數為510.07萬股，持股比例達100%。
在捷克方面，鴻海將對子公司Foxconn European Manufacturing Services s.r.o.增資4,400萬美元，約當9.44億捷克克朗。公告顯示，鴻海累計持有該公司股權金額為9.44億捷克克朗，持股比例90.42%；另由Foxconn Holdings B.V.持有1億捷克克朗，持股比例9.58%。
鴻海表示，上述三筆投資均以長期投資為目的，相關增資案均經董事會決議通過。
paras_en: Foxconn (2317‑TW) announced today (23) that its board approved capital increases for subsidiaries in Singapore, France and the Czech Republic, with transaction amounts of $1.101 billion, $58 million and $44 million respectively, totaling $1.203 billion, for long‑term investment purposes.

Foxconn said it will make a cash capital increase in its Singapore subsidiary eCMMS Precision Singapore Pte. Ltd., subscribing for 1.101 billion ordinary shares at $1 per share, for a total of $1.101 billion. After the increase, Foxconn will hold a cumulative 1.913 billion shares, representing 100% ownership.

In addition, Foxconn will increase capital in its French subsidiary Foxconn AI Solution (FR) SAS by $58 million, acquiring about 5.1007 million shares at €10 per share. After the increase, Foxconn’s cumulative holding will be 5.1007 million shares, representing 100% ownership.

In the Czech Republic, Foxconn will increase capital in its subsidiary Foxconn European Manufacturing Services s.r.o. by $44 million, equivalent to CZK 944 million. The announcement shows Foxconn’s cumulative equity in the company is CZK 944 million, representing a 90.42% stake; Foxconn Holdings B.V. holds CZK 100 million, a 9.58% stake.
Foxconn said all three investments are for long‑term purposes and the capital increase plans have been approved by the board.

items.title: 〈工業生產指數〉連31紅！工業與製造業生產指數雙創新高 估10月續紅
items.title_en: Industrial Production Index Extends 31-Month Growth Streak; Both Industrial and Manufacturing Indices Hit Record Highs, October Expected to Remain Positive
paras: 受惠於人工智慧（AI）、高效能運算及雲端資料服務等應用需求持續熱絡，加上消費性電子新品備貨潮挹注，經濟部於今（23）日公布最新統計數據，9月工業生產指數為 140.76，較上年同月增加 19.17%；其中製造業生產指數達 143.31，年增 20.21%。兩大指數皆創下歷年同月新高，雙雙寫下連續 31 個月正成長紀錄。 展望10月，在AI與年終旺季帶動下，估 10 月製造業生產指數 141.56 至 145.86，年增 20.5% 至年增 24.2%。
累計今年前 9 個月來看，工業生產指數為 133.10，較上年同期增加 20.53%；製造業生產指數則為 135.48，年增 21.83%，展現出台灣科技製造業強韌的成長動能。
深入分析各產業表現，資訊電子工業成為推升本月指數創高的絕對主力，年增率高達 27.42%。其中：
電子零組件業： 9月年增 23.62%，主因受惠高效能運算與 AI 應用需求維持強勁，伴隨消費性電子新品備貨，帶動 12 吋晶圓代工、IC 封測、記憶體、IC 設計及載板等產品生產成長，累計前 9 月較上年同期增加 21.07%。
電腦電子產品及光學製品業： 隨著 AI 應用與雲端服務蓬勃發展，促使全球雲端服務大廠加速布建 AI 基礎設施，加以半導體設備投資動能續強，推升伺服器、半導體檢測設備及零組件、交換器、固態硬碟等產品生產大幅成長，年增率高達 45.92%，累計前 9 月更大增 80.05%。
在傳統產業方面，受惠於半導體業者持續擴產以及 AI 供應鏈的外溢需求，部分產業同步展現增產態勢：
機械設備業： 年增 26.02%，主因半導體廠持續拓展先進製程與高階封測產能，帶動電子與半導體生產用設備及零組件、機械傳動設備等產量擴增，外加工具機訂單續增所致。
基本金屬業與汽車零組件業： 基本金屬業年增 1.39%，主因市場需求緩步回溫，熱軋鋼捲板與靶材等產品生產增加；汽車及其零件業則因市場需求增溫及電動車政策加持，年增 2.35%。
化學材料及肥料業： 則因部分產品市場回溫力道仍緩，年減 4.29%（惟拋光矽晶圓受惠半導體需求持續增產）。

展望未來，經濟部指出，雖然全球經濟成長動能仍受到地緣政治及貿易政策等不確定性因素影響，但受惠於 AI、高效能運算及雲端服務等新興科技應用需求持續擴增，全球雲端大廠積極投資 AI 基礎設施，將有助於延續我國半導體先進製程、高階封裝及伺服器等相關供應鏈的生產動能。再加上年終消費旺季的備貨需求陸續湧現，預期將可有效支撐我國製造業生產維持穩健成長態勢。綜合研判，估 10 月製造業生產指數 141.56 至 145.86，年增 20.5% 至年增 24.2%。
paras_en: Benefiting from sustained demand for artificial intelligence (AI), high‑performance computing and cloud data services, as well as a surge in inventory buildup for new consumer electronics, the Ministry of Economic Affairs released the latest statistics on the 23rd. September’s industrial production index was 140.76, up 19.17% year‑on‑year; the manufacturing production index reached 143.31, up 20.21% YoY. Both indices set new monthly records and marked the 31st consecutive month of growth. Looking ahead to October, driven by AI and the year‑end peak season, the manufacturing production index is projected to range from 141.56 to 145.86, representing a 20.5% to 24.2% annual increase.

Cumulatively for the first nine months of this year, the industrial production index stood at 133.10, 20.53% higher than the same period last year; the manufacturing production index was 135.48, up 21.83% YoY, showcasing the robust growth momentum of Taiwan’s technology manufacturing sector.
A detailed sector analysis shows that the information and electronics industry was the absolute driver behind this month’s record‑high index, posting a year‑over‑year growth of 27.42%.

Electronic components: In September, the sector grew 23.62% YoY, mainly due to strong demand from high‑performance computing and AI applications, coupled with inventory buildup for new consumer electronics, which boosted production of 12‑inch wafer foundry, IC packaging and testing, memory, IC design and substrates, resulting in a 21.07% increase for the first nine months compared with last year.

Computer electronic products and optical products: The booming development of AI applications and cloud services has prompted global cloud providers to accelerate the deployment of AI infrastructure, further strengthening semiconductor equipment investment. This drove substantial production growth in servers, semiconductor testing equipment and components, switches, solid‑state drives and other products, with a 45.92% YoY increase and an 80.05% rise for the first nine months.
In traditional industries, the continued expansion of semiconductor manufacturers and spill‑over demand from the AI supply chain have led several sectors to show production gains as well.

Machinery and equipment: The sector grew 26.02% YoY, driven by semiconductor firms expanding advanced processes and high‑end packaging capacity, which increased demand for equipment and components used in electronics and semiconductor production, as well as mechanical transmission equipment, alongside continued growth in machine‑tool orders.

Basic metal and automotive parts: Basic metal rose 1.39% YoY, reflecting a gradual recovery in market demand and higher output of hot‑rolled steel coils, plates and target materials. The automotive and parts sector, buoyed by warming demand and supportive electric‑vehicle policies, grew 2.35% YoY.

Chemical materials and fertilizer: This sector declined 4.29% YoY as demand for some products remained weak, although polished silicon wafers benefited from ongoing semiconductor demand and saw production increases.

Looking forward, the Ministry of Economic Affairs notes that while global economic growth is still subject to geopolitical and trade‑policy uncertainties, the expanding demand for emerging technologies such as AI, high‑performance computing and cloud services, together with aggressive AI infrastructure investments by major cloud providers, will help sustain production momentum in Taiwan’s advanced semiconductor processes, high‑end packaging and server supply chains. Coupled with the upcoming year‑end consumer‑spending season, these factors are expected to support steady growth in the nation’s manufacturing output. The ministry estimates the October manufacturing production index will range from 141.56 to 145.86, reflecting a 20.5% to 24.2% annual increase.

items.title: 台積電運動會因颱風喊卡 「小禮物」特別獎金正常發放加碼到3萬元
items.title_en: TSMC Sports Day Cancelled by Typhoon, ‘Small Gift’ Special Bonus Still Paid and Boosted to NT$30,000
paras: 台積電(2330-TW)原定於10月24日運動會因為颱風薔琵取消，不過，「小禮物」特別獎金據悉仍將照常發出，且加碼達3萬元，高於去年的2.5萬元。
台積電近年運動會都發放特別獎金，且逐年加碼，從2023年1.6萬元、到2024年2萬元、2025年2.5萬元，到今年3萬元，只要符合資格的員工均可領到。
受到薔琵颱風影響，新竹縣市政府公告10月23日停止上班，台積電表示，由於運動會的準備工作也受到影響，考量人員安全，因此運動會將取消辦理。
paras_en: TSMC (2330‑TW) had scheduled its annual sports day for October 24, but the event was called off because of Typhoon Chanh‑pi. However, the “small‑gift” special bonus is reportedly still being issued as usual, and the amount has been increased to NT$30,000, up from NT$25,000 last year.

In recent years TSMC has awarded a special bonus at its sports day and has been raising the amount each year—NT$16,000 in 2023, NT$20,000 in 2024, NT$25,000 in 2025, and this year NT$30,000. Any employee who meets the eligibility criteria will receive the bonus.

Due to the impact of Typhoon Chanh‑pi, the Hsinchu County and City governments announced a work‑stop on October 23. TSMC said that because the preparation for the sports day was also affected and to ensure staff safety, the event will be cancelled.

items.title: 聯茂8、9月合賺22.1億元EPS 6.08元超越H1 前3季提前賺逾一股本
items.title_en: Lianmao Posts NT$2.21 B Combined Profit for August‑September, EPS NT$6.08 Beats H1; First Three Quarters Earn Over One Year’s Capital in Advance
paras: CCL廠聯茂電子(6213-TW)今(23)日公布最新獲利資訊，2026年9月營收達58.24億元，創歷史新高，單月稅後純益達12.86億元，每股純益(EPS)3.54元。加計8月稅後純益9.24億元，聯茂第三季光兩個月累計稅後純益就達22.1億元，每股純益合計6.08元，不僅獲利表現強勁，更已超越上半年稅後純益15.94億元。
聯茂2026年上半年營收為206.73億元，毛利率17.33%，稅後純益15.94億元，每股純益4.39元。若加計第三季8、9月獲利，前三季累計稅後純益已達38.04億元，每股純益合計10.47元，提前賺逾一個股本，獲利動能持續升溫。
在高階產品需求強勁帶動下，聯茂積極擴充泰國、江西、無錫及台灣等生產基地產能，預計2026年全球總產能將達每月570萬張。其中，泰國大型生產基地持續推進三期投資計畫，第一期預計於今年底完成，屆時產能將由每月30萬張倍增至60萬張，進一步提升高階材料供應能力。
聯茂泰國第二期擴產計畫也已打樁動工，初期規劃新增每月30萬張產能，公司規劃最快於2026年投產。隨著各地擴產計畫陸續推進，聯茂預估2029年全球總產能將進一步擴大至每月915萬張，持續因應AI及高階電子材料市場需求。
同時，聯茂持續提升泰國廠的技術層次，以因應在地PCB廠的擴廠生產需求，預計聯茂泰國廠於2026年完成M8 CCL的技術轉移，並於2027年完成M9產品技術轉移至泰國。而聯茂本身在M10產品的開發也在認證之中。
聯茂董事長陳進財先前指出，聯茂自2026年至2030年的全球生產規劃皆已完備，目前正依進度進行投資，但2026年尚無在公開市場籌資的規劃。
聯茂9月營收達58.2億元，月增15.5%、年增110.7%；第三季營收達156億元，優於市場預期並再創單季歷史新高。累計前9月營收達329.05億元，已超越歷年全年營收。法人分析，主要受惠於產品漲價效益持續反映，以及伺服器市場需求維持強勁。
paras_en: CCL manufacturer Lianmao Electronics (6213‑TW) today (23) announced the latest profit information, September 2026 revenue reached NT$5.824 billion, a historic high, monthly after‑tax net profit was NT$1.286 billion, EPS NT$3.54. Adding August after‑tax profit of NT$924 million, Lianmao’s Q3 two‑month cumulative after‑tax profit reached NT$2.21 billion, EPS total NT$6.08, not only a strong performance but already exceeds the H1 after‑tax profit of NT$1.594 billion.

Lianmao’s H1 2026 revenue was NT$20.673 billion, gross margin 17.33%, after‑tax profit NT$1.594 billion, EPS NT$4.39. Including Q3 August‑September profit, the first three quarters cumulative after‑tax profit reached NT$3.804 billion, EPS NT$10.47, earning more than one year’s equity in advance, and profit momentum continues to heat up.

Driven by strong demand for high‑end products, Lianmao is actively expanding capacity at its plants in Thailand, Jiangxi, Wuxi and Taiwan, expecting total global capacity in 2026 to reach 5.7 million sheets per month. The large Thailand plant continues its Phase‑3 investment, with Phase‑1 expected to be completed by year‑end, raising capacity from 300,000 to 600,000 sheets per month, further boosting high‑end material supply capability.

The second‑phase expansion at the Thailand plant has also begun pile‑driving, initially adding 300,000 sheets per month, with the company planning to start production as early as 2026. As expansion projects progress, Lianmao forecasts global capacity to grow to 9.15 million sheets per month by 2029, continuing to meet AI and high‑end electronic material market demand.

At the same time, Lianmao is upgrading the technology level of its Thailand factory to meet local PCB fab expansion needs, expecting to complete M8 CCL technology transfer at the Thailand plant in 2026 and finish M9 product technology transfer there in 2027. Lianmao’s own M10 product development is also under certification.

Chairman Chen Jin‑cai previously noted that Lianmao’s global production plan for 2026‑2030 is fully set, and investments are proceeding on schedule, but there is no plan to raise capital in the public market in 2026.

Lianmao’s September revenue hit NT$5.82 billion, up 15.5% month‑over‑month and 110.7% year‑over‑year; Q3 revenue reached NT$15.6 billion, beating market expectations and setting a new quarterly record. Cumulative revenue for the first nine months reached NT$32.905 billion, surpassing any full‑year revenue in history. Analysts say the results are mainly due to continued price‑increase benefits and strong server market demand.

items.title: 玉晶光獲3M參與私募股款已到位持股4.68% 自結9月EPS達3.85元
items.title_en: Yujing Optical Secures 3M Participation in Private Placement, Stake Reaches 4.68%, September EPS Hits T$3.85
paras: 獲美商3M以逾48億元參與私募現增案並取得約 4.68% 股權的光學鏡頭與精密光學元件大廠玉晶光(3406-TW)，今(23)日公布最新自結獲利資訊，玉晶光2026年9月營收26.72億元，月減1.75%，年增0.54%，自結單月稅後純益4.34億元，年減15%，單月每股純益3.85元。
玉晶光第三季為客戶傳統鋪貨旺季，單季營收表現也佳，達 78.16 億元，進入歷史高檔區，季增37.55%，年增1%。2026年1-9月玉晶光營收196.31億元，年增10.21%。
展望第四季營運，玉晶光指出，端視客戶新機銷售狀況，另其它領域的產品目前仍在積極送樣、認證，目前進度符合公司預期。
3M 預計參與玉晶光的私募發行新股，認購玉晶光普通股5534張，每股認購價格為869.6元，投資總金額高達48.13億元（約1.5億美金元），股款並已匯入，3M透過參與私募將取得玉晶光約 4.68%股權。
玉晶光與3M的大舉合作，雙方合作結合了 3M 在 EBO 技術的領導地位、材料科學、光學設計及全球客戶網絡，與玉晶光長期積累的精密光學鏡頭製造能力、量產規模及高精度組裝技術。玉晶光的生產團隊將全力支援 3M EBO 套管（ferrules）、共封裝光學（CPO）解決方案及相關光互連模組的量產做準備。
玉晶光在2026年上半年營收118.23億元，毛利率33.37%，稅後純益15.77億元，每股純益13.99元。
paras_en: Yujing Optical (3406‑TW), a leading manufacturer of optical lenses and precision optical components that received participation from U.S. company 3M in a private placement raising over T$4.8 billion and acquiring about a 4.68% stake, announced its latest self‑reported profit figures today (23rd). For September 2026, Yujing posted revenue of T$2.672 billion, down 1.75% month‑over‑month but up 0.54% year‑over‑year, with a net profit after tax of T$434 million, a 15% year‑over‑year decline, and earnings per share of T$3.85 for the month.

The third quarter, traditionally a strong distribution season for customers, saw Yujing’s quarterly revenue reach T$7.816 billion, entering a historically high range, up 37.55% quarter‑over‑quarter and 1% year‑over‑year. For the January‑September 2026 period, Yujing’s revenue totaled T$19.631 billion, a 10.21% increase year‑over‑year.

Looking ahead to the fourth quarter, Yujing said its performance will depend on customers’ new product sales, while products in other segments are still being actively sampled and certified, with progress currently meeting the company’s expectations.

3M plans to participate in Yujing’s private placement of new shares, subscribing to 5,534 ordinary shares at a price of T$869.6 per share, for a total investment of T$4.813 billion (approximately US$150 million). The funds have already been transferred, and through this private placement 3M will obtain roughly a 4.68% equity stake in Yujing.

The extensive collaboration between Yujing and 3M combines 3M’s leadership in EBO technology, material science, optical design, and its global customer network with Yujing’s long‑standing precision optical lens manufacturing capability, mass‑production scale, and high‑precision assembly technology. Yujing’s production team will fully support the mass‑production preparation of 3M’s EBO ferrules, co‑packaged optics (CPO) solutions, and related optical interconnect modules.
In the first half of 2026, Yujing reported revenue of T$11.823 billion, a gross margin of 33.37%, net profit after tax of T$1.577 billion, and earnings per share of T$13.99.

items.title: 揚明光連三季獲利 前三季EPS 0.11元
items.title_en: Yang Ming Optical Posts Profit for Three Consecutive Quarters, EPS 0.11 NT$ for First Three Quarters
paras: 光學元件廠揚明光學(3504-TW)今(23)日召開董事會，公告第三季稅後純益122萬元，季減76.25%，較去年同期由虧轉盈，每股純益0.01元；前三季稅後純益1234萬元，每股純益0.11元，較去年同期由虧轉盈。
展望第四季，揚明光學指出，光學元件類產品受物流投影鏡頭客戶啟動新版本變更計畫影響，相關需求可能遞延或暫緩，預估出貨動能將下修；3D列印產品隨新機種逐步導入客戶端測試，出貨預期略增；其餘產品線因接近年底，客戶備貨轉趨保守，預計出貨較第三季持平或略減。整體而言，預估第四季出貨量將較第三季減少。
揚明光學2026年第三季營收7.46億元，毛利率16.8%，季增0.36個百分點、年減0.22個百分點，營業損失872萬元；前三季營收21.7億元，毛利率17.13%，年增0.94個百分點。
揚明光學表示，第三季智能家居新機種持續放量，但低階舊型鏡頭也進入終止階段，取像光學產品出貨表現持平；光學元件類產品因客戶AR眼鏡進入量產，出貨較上季增加；3D列印產品則因進入新舊機種銜接期，受到客戶端調整舊機種庫存及新機驗證雙重影響，本季出貨相對放緩。
車用產品方面，揚明光學第三季隨LiDAR鏡頭新機種順利量產，逐步取代舊機種，帶動出貨量略增。
paras_en: Optical component manufacturer Yang Ming Optical (3504‑TW) held its board meeting today (23rd) and announced a Q3 after‑tax net profit of NT$1.22 million, down 76.25% quarter‑over‑quarter, turning a loss into a profit compared with the same period last year, resulting in earnings per share of NT$0.01; for the first three quarters the after‑tax net profit was NT$12.34 million, EPS NT$0.11, also turning a loss into a profit versus the prior year.

Looking ahead to Q4, Yang Ming Optical noted that demand for optical‑component products may be delayed or postponed due to logistics projection‑lens customers launching new version change programs, so shipment momentum is expected to be revised downward; 3D‑printing products are gradually being introduced to customer testing with new models, so shipments are expected to rise slightly; other product lines, as the year‑end approaches, see customers becoming more conservative in inventory, so shipments are expected to be flat or slightly lower than Q3. Overall, Q4 shipment volume is projected to be lower than Q3.

Yang Ming Optical reported Q3 2026 revenue of NT$746 million, gross margin 16.8%, up 0.36 percentage points quarter‑over‑quarter but down 0.22 points year‑over‑year, and an operating loss of NT$8.72 million; for the first three quarters revenue was NT$2.17 billion, gross margin 17.13%, up 0.94 percentage points year‑over‑year.

The company said that in Q3 the new smart‑home models continued to ramp up, while low‑end legacy lenses entered the phase‑out stage, keeping imaging‑optics product shipments flat; optical‑component products saw higher shipments as a customer’s AR glasses entered mass production; 3D‑printing products experienced a slowdown this quarter because they are in a transition period between old and new models, affected by customers adjusting old‑model inventory and validating new models.
In the automotive segment, Yang Ming Optical’s new LiDAR lens models were successfully mass‑produced in Q3, gradually replacing older models and driving a modest increase in shipment volume.

items.title_en: Shenghe's First CB Issuance Expected to Trade OTC on Oct 30; Market Fundraising This Year Will Reach NT$540 million
paras: 益生菌原料大廠生合(1295-TW)2026年積極進行市場籌資，繼8月完成以發行現增股3125張完成1.4億元的籌資之後，再以完成發行面額4億元的國內第一次無擔保轉換公司債(CB)籌資，這筆CB預計在10月30日上櫃掛牌交易。

paras_en: Probiotic ingredient giant Shenghe (1295‑TW) is actively raising capital in 2026. After completing a capital increase in August that raised NT$1.4 billion by issuing 3,125 new shares, the company will now issue its first domestic unsecured convertible bond (CB) with a face value of NT$4 billion, slated to begin trading on the OTC market on October 30.

The August capital increase was priced at NT$45 per share, raising NT$1.4 billion. This month, Shenghe will issue a domestic unsecured CB with a face value of NT$4 billion and a conversion price of NT$50, also expected to trade on the OTC market on October 30. Together, the two market‑raising actions— the capital increase and the CB issuance—will total NT$5.4 billion for the year.
Shenghe's NT$5.4 billion of fundraising this year will primarily be used to repay bank loans.
For the first half of 2026, Shenghe reported revenue of NT$5.11 billion, a gross margin of 49.76%, net profit after tax of NT$68.03 million, and earnings per share of NT$1.97.
Shenghe's closing price on October 22 was NT$46.75 per share.

items.title: 台新私人銀行亞灣旗艦店正式開幕 攜瑞聯銀行打造國際級私人銀行服務
items.title_en: Taishin Private Bank Asia-Pacific Flagship Branch Officially Opens, Partnering with Union Bancaire Privée to Offer International-Grade Private Banking Services
paras: 台新銀行積極響應政府推動亞洲資產管理中心政策，持續深耕高資產財富管理市場，今(23)日正式成立「台新私人銀行亞灣旗艦店」，展現布局南臺灣、連結亞洲財富管理市場的決心。此次開幕典禮由台新銀行私銀暨高端理財事業總處執行長林尚愷主持，並與瑞聯銀行(Union Bancaire Privée, UBP)簽署策略聯盟合作備忘錄，借助瑞聯銀行作為瑞士規模最大的家族所有私人銀行之一在高資產財富管理服務及國際投資的專業優勢，進一步強化台新私人銀行的國際視野與服務量能。

台新私銀總處執行長林尚愷表示，隨著台新新光金控合併逐步展現集團規模效益，客戶基礎擴大至逾1,100萬戶。為因應快速成長的高端財富管理需求，台新銀行今(2026)年正式成立「私銀暨高端理財事業總處」，匯聚金融資歷逾20年且具備CFP、AFP等專業認證的財富規劃顧問團隊，結合具豐富實務經驗的律師、會計師等專業人士，全面強化高資產客群財富規劃服務。面對全球稅務變局與企業世代交替浪潮，台新私銀家族辦公室以家族投資管理、財富傳承、稅務服務、家族治理與生活管家為五大核心領域，提供高資產客戶全方位的家辦式顧問服務。

看好台新新光合併後的龐大資源優勢及深耕在地客戶的深厚經驗，瑞聯銀行亞洲區行政總裁Michael Blake表示，雙方合作建基於共同企業願景、以客為本及高度互補的優勢之上，台新銀行精準掌握臺灣市場高資產客戶需求，瑞聯銀行則具備全球投資視野與國際財富管理經驗；未來瑞聯銀行將分享全球市場洞察、資產配置與投資專業，並透過人才培育與專業交流，協助台新私人銀行團隊拓展國際視野、深化專業能力，共同推動臺灣私人銀行服務持續升級。
台新銀行深耕財富管理35年，持續投入高資產客戶服務，逐步建構涵蓋專業團隊、產品平台，以及臺灣、香港、新加坡據點的完整私銀服務體系。此次與瑞聯銀行策略合作最重要的意義，在於將國際經驗轉化為服務客戶的能力。未來台新銀行將結合自身對臺灣市場及高資產客戶需求的精準掌握，借重瑞聯銀行全球市場洞察與專業經驗，持續精進資產配置、產品服務及財富管理能力，提供更完整、更專業且更具國際視野的私人銀行服務。
展望未來，台新私人銀行將持續以臺灣為根基、連結亞洲、接軌全球，以「認真專業、永續傳承」的精神，實踐「我們承諾守護您的託付」的理念，致力成為高資產客戶與家族長期信賴的「資產負債管理夥伴」，陪伴客戶穩健管理財富、創造長期價值，實現跨世代的財富永續與傳承。
paras_en: Taishin Bank is actively responding to the government’s push for an Asian asset‑management hub and continues to deepen its high‑net‑worth wealth‑management market. On the 23rd, it formally launched the “Taishin Private Bank Asia‑Pacific Flagship Branch,” showcasing its commitment to expanding in southern Taiwan and linking to the Asian wealth‑management market. The opening ceremony was hosted by Lin Shang‑kai, Executive Director of Taishin’s Private Banking and High‑End Wealth Management Division, and featured a strategic alliance memorandum of understanding with Union Bancaire Privée (UBP). Leveraging UBP—one of the largest family‑owned private banks in Switzerland—for its expertise in high‑net‑worth wealth management and international investment will further strengthen Taishin Private Bank’s global perspective and service capacity.

Taishin Private Banking’s Executive Director Lin Shang‑kai noted that, as the Taishin‑Shin Kong Financial Holding merger gradually yields scale benefits, the customer base has grown to over 11.0 million accounts. To meet the rapidly expanding demand for high‑end wealth management, Taishin Bank officially established a “Private Banking and High‑End Wealth Management Division” in 2026, assembling a team of wealth‑planning advisors with more than 20 years of financial experience and CFP, AFP certifications, alongside seasoned lawyers and accountants. This bolsters comprehensive wealth‑planning services for high‑net‑worth clients. Facing global tax changes and generational business transitions, Taishin’s family‑office offers five core services—family investment management, wealth succession, tax services, family governance, and lifestyle concierge—to deliver full‑suite advisory support to affluent families.

Seeing the huge resource advantage and deep local customer expertise that will result from the Taishin‑Shin Kong merger, Michael Blake, President of UBP’s Asia region, said the partnership is built on a shared corporate vision, client‑centric focus and highly complementary strengths. Taishin precisely understands the needs of Taiwan’s high‑net‑worth market, while UBP brings global investment insight and international wealth‑management experience. Going forward, UBP will share global market insights, asset‑allocation and investment expertise, and through talent development and professional exchange will help Taishin’s private‑banking team broaden its international outlook and deepen its capabilities, jointly advancing Taiwan’s private‑banking services.

Taishin Bank has been cultivating wealth management for 35 years, continuously investing in services for high‑net‑worth clients and gradually building a complete private‑banking ecosystem that includes professional teams, product platforms, and locations in Taiwan, Hong Kong and Singapore. The strategic cooperation with UBP is most significant for translating international experience into client‑service capability. In the future, Taishin will combine its precise grasp of the Taiwan market and high‑net‑worth client needs with UBP’s global market insight and expertise, continuously refining asset allocation, product offerings and wealth‑management skills to deliver more comprehensive, professional and internationally‑oriented private‑banking services.

Looking ahead, Taishin Private Bank will remain rooted in Taiwan, connect to Asia and link to the world, embodying the spirit of “serious professionalism and sustainable inheritance.” It pledges to “protect your entrusted assets,” aiming to become a trusted “asset‑liability management partner” for high‑net‑worth individuals and families, helping clients manage wealth prudently, create long‑term value, and achieve cross‑generational wealth sustainability and legacy.

items.title: AI股遭拋售重創資料中心設備商 財報亮眼仍難逃賣壓
items.title_en: AI Stocks Plunge, Crushing Data Center Equipment Makers Despite Strong Earnings
paras: 《Yahoo Finance》報導，AI資料中心建設熱潮中的兩大關鍵供應商，剛公布遠優於預期的財報，華爾街卻依然大舉拋售這些公司的股票。
Bloom Energy(BE-US)為資料中心提供現場發電設備，該燃料電池製造商週四表示，上季營收年增138%，並將全年營收成長展望上修至約122%。負責安裝資料中心冷卻與電力系統的 Comfort Systems(FIX-US)則表示，未完成訂單金額幾乎翻倍，達到178億美元。
然而，這兩檔股票週五(23日)連續第二個交易日大幅下跌。Bloom Energy 大跌11%，Comfort Systems 重挫9%。為資料中心製造網路零組件的 Credo(CRDO-US)也同步下跌9%。
All Star Charts 的 Steve Strazza 週五上午寫道，「一家公司即使交出驚人的業績，如果投資人不願意給予相應的回報，那就代表某些地方出了問題。」
不過，Bloom Energy 的財報也確實提供了看空者一些質疑的理由。該公司上季現金流轉為負值，利潤率的改善也未能跟上營收成長。
不只兩檔股票遭殃
根據 Yahoo Finance 計算，自標普500指數10月6日創下收盤歷史新高以來，負責建造及供應 AI 資料中心設備的企業，股價跌幅中位數已達23%。這個族群包括開拓重工(Caterpillar)(CAT-US)、GE Vernova(GEV-US)、Vertiv(VRT-US)及Eaton(ETN-US)等大型企業。
同期，電力生產商股價下跌14%，輝達(NVDA-US)下跌11%。反觀負責支付這些建設費用的大型科技公司，股價平均跌幅僅約5%。
換言之，收錢的公司，股價跌得比付錢的公司還要慘。
這樣的走勢與目前資料中心建設面臨的最大問題——供應不足——背道而馳。Jefferies分析師 Aniket Shah 週三表示，「目前 AI 資料中心建設最大的限制因素就是電力。」他並指出，社會大眾對新建資料中心的反對聲浪正在增加。連輝達執行長黃仁勳也表示，資料中心建設業者必須成為「好鄰居」。
阿波羅全球管理首席經濟學家 Torsten Sløk 本週撰文指出，運算能力的需求「遠遠大於供給」。他認為，若資料中心建設速度放緩，反而可能有利於掌握稀缺產能的業者，包括電力生產商及變壓器製造商。這些變壓器的交貨前置時間長達「26個月」。
他指出，真正的輸家將是「開發商與處於施工階段的投資人」，以及股價已反映所有建設都會如期完成的 AI 概念股。
Sløk 寫道，真正的風險在於，如果供給追上需求，或需求轉弱，原本的「稀缺局面就會消退」。如今就連他認為可能受惠的企業也遭到拋售，顯示市場正在押注最糟糕的情境。
自10月6日以來，12家大型資料中心建設商與電力相關企業的總市值，合計已蒸發超過3,000億美元。
然而，這些公司的訂單簿目前還看不出任何類似的惡化跡象。是未完成訂單的數據出了問題，還是股價反映過度悲觀的預期？
下一個關鍵考驗將在週三到來，微軟(MSFT-US)、Alphabet(GOOGL-US)及 Vertiv(VRT-US)將公布財報，亞馬遜(AMZN-US)則預計於週四公布業績。
這些公司的支出計畫，將揭示資料中心相關企業的未完成訂單是否會持續增加，還是對 AI 投資熱潮抱持懷疑態度的市場人士，其實看到了值得警惕的訊號。
paras_en: Yahoo Finance reported that two key suppliers in the AI data‑center construction boom just posted earnings far above expectations, yet Wall Street is still dumping their shares.

Bloom Energy (BE‑US), which provides on‑site power generation equipment for data centers, said Thursday that last‑quarter revenue grew 138% year‑over‑year and it raised its full‑year revenue growth outlook to about 122%. Comfort Systems (FIX‑US), which installs cooling and power systems for data centers, said its backlog of unfilled orders almost doubled to $17.8 billion.

However, both stocks fell sharply on Friday the 23rd for the second consecutive trading day. Bloom Energy tumbled 11%, Comfort Systems plunged 9%, and Credo (CRDO‑US), which makes network components for data centers, also slid 9%.
All Star Charts’ Steve Strazza wrote on Friday morning, “A company can deliver stunning results, but if investors aren’t willing to give it a commensurate return, something’s wrong somewhere.”
Still, Bloom Energy’s filing gave bears some ammunition. The company posted negative cash flow for the quarter and its profit‑margin improvement lagged behind revenue growth.
Not only those two stocks suffered

According to Yahoo Finance’s calculations, since the S&P 500 hit a record‑high close on October 6, the median decline for companies that build and supply AI data‑center equipment has reached 23%. The group includes heavy‑equipment maker Caterpillar (CAT‑US), GE Vernova (GEV‑US), Vertiv (VRT‑US) and Eaton (ETN‑US) among others.
During the same period, power‑producer stocks fell 14% and Nvidia (NVDA‑US) dropped 11%. By contrast, large tech firms that pay for the construction saw an average decline of only about 5%.
In other words, the companies that receive the money saw their shares fall harder than those that spend it.

That trend runs counter to the biggest current headache for data‑center builds—insufficient supply. Jefferies analyst Aniket Shah said on Wednesday, “Power is the biggest constraint on AI data‑center construction right now.” He added that public opposition to new data centers is growing, and even Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang has said builders must be “good neighbors.”

Apollo Global Management chief economist Torsten Sløk wrote this week that computing‑capacity demand “far outstrips supply.” He believes a slowdown in data‑center construction could actually benefit firms that control scarce capacity, such as power generators and transformer makers, whose lead times can stretch to 26 months.
He warned that the real losers will be “developers and investors still in the construction phase,” as well as AI‑themed stocks whose prices already assume all projects will be completed on schedule.

Sløk added that the true risk is that if supply catches up with demand—or demand weakens—the current scarcity will evaporate. Even the companies he thinks could benefit are now being sold off, showing the market is betting on the worst‑case scenario.
Since October 6, the combined market value of 12 large data‑center builders and power‑related firms has evaporated by more than $300 billion.
Yet there are no clear signs of order‑book deterioration at these companies. Is the backlog data flawed, or are stock prices reflecting overly pessimistic expectations?
The next key test arrives on Wednesday when Microsoft (MSFT‑US), Alphabet (GOOGL‑US) and Vertiv (VRT‑US) report earnings, with Amazon (AMZN‑US) slated to release results on Thursday.
Those spending plans will reveal whether unfinished orders for data‑center vendors will keep rising, or whether market participants skeptical of the AI investment frenzy are spotting warning signals.

items.title: 〈紐約匯市〉美元上漲 日元因AI股重挫轉強 法國債務疑慮拖累歐元
items.title_en: New York FX Market: Dollar Rises, Yen Gains After AI Stock Plunge, French Debt Concerns Drag Euro
paras: 美元周五(23日)小幅上漲，美元指數本週變動不大。歐元則受法國政府公債遭拋售影響走低，法國債務風險溢酬升至2011年歐元區主權債務危機以來最高水準，歐元兌美元與日元均以週線收黑作收。日元受惠於週四AI概念股遭拋售引發的避險資金流入，兌美元本週上漲。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)上漲0.25%，報101.82，本週上漲約0.03%。
市場對法國國內動盪加劇及預算問題惡化的憂慮，持續打擊歐元。法國內政部長Laurent Nuñez表示，法國將於週六部署7萬名警察，並由特種警力支援，以因應抗議活動。此外，穆迪（Moody’s）也可能於週五調降法國的信用評等。
Bannockburn Global Forex 首席市場策略師 Marc Chandler 表示，「今天歐洲債券市場的壓力已有所緩解，但穆迪稍晚對法國債務評等的檢視仍是一項挑戰。儘管馬克宏政府已威脅動用軍事力量平息社會動盪，但週末可能仍會有更多活動發生。」
歐元兌美元下跌0.21%，至1.1191美元，本週下跌約0.43%。
歐元兌日元跌幅更大，一度觸及175.08日圓，創2025年10月以來最低。歐元兌日元下跌0.11%，本週跌約1.1%。
日元兌美元下跌0.1%，至156.9日元，但本週上漲約0.7%，創下9月中旬以來最佳單週表現。
三菱日聯金融集團（MUFG）資深外匯分析師 Lee Hardman 表示，「隨著本週尾聲的避險交易氣氛升溫，日元持續維持在較強勢水準。」
央行政策會議成市場焦點
交易員正關注下週美國聯準會（Fed）、歐洲央行（ECB）及日本銀行（BoJ）的政策會議。市場預期三家央行都將維持利率不變，但投資人將尋找未來貨幣政策走向的線索。
根據倫敦證券交易所集團（LSEG）數據，週四股市遭拋售後，聯邦基金利率期貨交易員下調了對聯準會12月升息的押注，但市場仍認為升息機率達81%。
交易員目前預估，歐洲央行12月升息的機率為66%。投資人將仔細檢視任何有關利率前景的訊號。歐洲央行總裁拉加德（Christine Lagarde）9月底曾表示，面對通膨，採取適度的政策反應是合適的。
採購經理人指數（PMI）數據顯示，歐元區民間部門10月成長速度放緩，降至四個月來最疲弱水準，主要受到法國經濟活動再度萎縮拖累。
