paras_en: The dollar edged higher on Friday (the 23rd), with the DXY showing little change this week. The euro fell as French government bonds were sold off, pushing France's sovereign debt risk premium to its highest level since the Euro‑area crisis of 2011. Both the euro‑dollar and euro‑yen pairs closed the week in the red. The yen benefited from a flight‑to‑safety flow triggered by Thursday’s sell‑off in AI‑related stocks, rising against the dollar over the week.
In the New York close, the dollar index (DXY), which tracks the greenback against six major currencies, rose 0.25% to 101.82, up about 0.03% for the week.

Market worries about escalating domestic turmoil in France and worsening budget issues continued to weigh on the euro. French Interior Minister Laurent Nuñez said France will deploy 70,000 police officers, supported by special forces, on Saturday to address protests. Moody’s also may downgrade France’s credit rating on Friday.

Marc Chandler, chief market strategist at Bannockburn Global Forex, said, “The pressure on European bond markets has eased today, but Moody’s later review of France’s debt rating remains a challenge. Although the Macron government has threatened to use force to quell social unrest, more activity could still occur over the weekend.”
The euro fell 0.21% against the dollar to $1.1191, down about 0.43% for the week.
The euro‑yen pair slipped further, briefly hitting ¥175.08, the lowest since October 2025, down 0.11% and about 1.1% for the week.
The yen slipped 0.1% to ¥156.9 per dollar, but is up roughly 0.7% for the week, marking its best weekly performance since mid‑September.
Lee Hardman, senior FX analyst at MUFG, said, “With the hedge‑fund atmosphere heating up toward the end of the week, the yen remains firmly on the stronger side.”
Central‑bank policy meetings become market focus

Traders are watching next week’s policy meetings of the U.S. Federal Reserve, the European Central Bank and the Bank of Japan. Markets expect all three central banks to keep rates unchanged, but investors will look for clues on future monetary‑policy direction.

According to data from the London Stock Exchange Group, after Thursday’s equity sell‑off, Fed‑funds futures traders reduced bets on a December rate hike, yet the market still sees an 81% probability of a hike.

Traders currently estimate a 66% chance that the ECB will raise rates in December. Investors will scrutinise any signals about the rate outlook. ECB President Christine Lagarde said at the end of September that a measured policy response to inflation is appropriate.

Purchasing Managers’ Index (PMI) data showed that euro‑area private‑sector growth slowed in October to its weakest level in four months, mainly dragged down by a renewed contraction in French economic activity.

Citigroup economist Giada Giani said, “We think this data dip brings the PMI back in line with other growth indicators rather than signalling rising downside risk. France remains a drag, but the rest of the euro area continues to show resilience.”

In Japan, Friday’s data showed that September core CPI year‑over‑year finally exceeded the Bank of Japan’s 2% inflation target for the first time in nine months. Analysts said the figure indicates price pressure spreading to more sectors and bolsters the case for a near‑term rate hike by the BOJ.
Traders now assign a 61% probability to a BOJ rate increase in December.

paras: 中東戰火再度升溫的疑慮推升油價，美股週五 (23 日) 普遍收黑，賣壓從前一交易日的科技股擴散至民生消費、公用事業及醫療保健等防禦性類股。道瓊重挫約653點，創下兩個月來最大單日跌幅。標普500指數下跌0.52%，那斯達克指數則在部分晶片股反彈支撐下，跌幅收斂至0.21%。費城半導體指數微升 0.44%。
市場近期受到人工智慧 (AI) 交易退燒、中東衝突可能擴大及美債劇烈波動影響，類股輪動明顯。美股週五賣壓進一步擴及民生消費、公用事業及醫療保健等防禦性族群，但拉長至整週來看，主要指數漲跌互見，顯示市場內部表現持續分化。
本週累計，道瓊則上漲0.4%，標普500指數下跌0.5%，那斯達克指數下跌0.7%，費半週線吞黑3.21%，連跌3週，創去年 11 月以來最長紀錄。
中東局勢成為週五市場主要壓力來源。美國與以色列可能規劃對伊朗發動新一波攻擊，伊朗則表示已準備好反擊，使原油供應中斷的疑慮再度升高。
美國總統川普稱美國可能再對伊朗採取軍事行動，並敦促德黑蘭接受談判，說法與他本月稍早稱期中選舉前不攻擊伊朗不同。
西德州原油期貨突破每桶100美元，布蘭特原油則逼近117美元，創4月以來最高收盤價，重新挑起市場對通膨的擔憂。在聯準會 (Fed) 即將公布利率決策之際，讓市場更加關注能源成本對通膨的影響。
美債市場方面，投資人週四因 AI 資料中心龐大融資需求及科技業借貸風險而轉向避險，帶動10年期美債殖利率一個月來首度跌破5%。
不過，隨著週五油價走高，美債回吐前一天部分漲幅，10年期殖利率回升逾4個基點至約4.999%，重新逼近5%關卡。
美股週五 (23 日) 主要指數表現：
NYSE FANG+ 指數中的科技五大巨頭僅微軟收紅。Meta (META-US) 下跌 0.96%；蘋果 (AAPL-US) 下跌 0.14%；Alphabet (GOOGL-US) 下跌 1.24%；微軟 (MSFT-US) 上漲 0.66%；亞馬遜 (AMZN-US) 下跌 0.95%。
半導體個股漲跌不一。AMD (AMD-US) 上漲 1.74%；博通 (AVGO-US) 下跌 0.48%；輝達 (NVDA-US) 下跌 0.59%；應用材料 (AMAT-US) 上漲 0.44%；高通 (QCOM-US) 上漲 1.78%。
記憶體與儲存族群漲跌互見。美光 (MU-US) 上漲 2.46%；威騰電子 (WDC-US) 下跌 2.97%；SanDisk (SNDK-US) 下跌 1.82%；希捷 (STX-US) 下跌 1.81%；SK 海力士 ADR (SKHY-US) 上漲 4.05%。
台股 ADR 漲多跌少。台積電 ADR (TSM-US) 上漲 1.49%；日月光 ADR (ASX-US) 上漲 2.52%；聯電 ADR (UMC-US) 上漲 1.94%；中華電信 ADR (CHT-US) 下跌 0.43%。
企業新聞
美國運通 (AXP-US) 急跌 3.62% 至每股 313.22 美元，成為拖累道瓊的個股之一。公司宣布將裁減全球約5%人力，理由包括因應AI發展及控制成本上升。開拓重工 (CAT-US) 下跌約2%，高盛 (GS-US) 跌逾1%，進一步加重道瓊壓力。
蘋果 (AAPL-US) 收黑0.14% 至每股 347.72 美元，週線收高1.83%，新款摺疊手機iPhone Duo上市後，有限的門市現貨迅速售罄，顯示這款起價接近2,000美元的裝置吸引買氣。
SpaceX正尋求在全美取得至少8萬處基地台站點，並已與至少一家大型行動通訊基礎設施業者洽談，持續推進地面通訊網路布局。SpaceX (SPCX-US) 揚升 1.89% 至每股 147.49 美元，週跌1.16%。
美國銀行將ServiceNow (NOW-US) 目標價調高至180美元，維持「買進」評等，理由是AI產品需求增加，可望支持營收持續成長。公司預計於10月28日公布第三季財報。ServiceNow 收高 1.25% 至每股 158.96 美元。
華爾街分析
Argent Capital Management投資組合經理Jed Ellerbroek表示，過去兩週投資人持續從科技股及資料中心受惠股轉向防禦性標的，但這股輪動終究會耗盡動能，週五盤勢正反映這種情況。
他認為，近期部分科技業者公布的財報表現良好，提供投資人重新評估科技股的理由，市場不必完全受避險情緒主導。
美國銀行策略師Michael Hartnett則維持審慎立場，預期AI交易疑慮與美國期中選舉的不確定性，將使避險情緒延續至11月中旬。他預期，美債殖利率、股市及美元可能同步走低。
瑞銀投資總監辦公室的Ulrike Hoffmann-Burchardi看法相對正面，認為企業獲利仍有望支撐股市，AI需求也依然強勁，單憑地緣政治發展，尚不足以支持全面轉向防禦性配置。
PIMCO經濟學家Tiffany Wilding指出，AI正在提振美國需求，而多項通膨指標仍高於目標，Fed透過適度調整利率及收緊金融情勢來因應具有合理性。不過，目前通膨雖偏高，尚未持續加速，應能讓Fed保有循序調整政策的空間。

paras_en: Middle‑East tensions reignited, pushing oil prices higher. US equities on Friday (the 23rd) mostly closed lower, with selling spreading from tech stocks the previous day to defensive sectors such as consumer staples, utilities and healthcare. The Dow plunged about 653 points, marking its biggest single‑day drop in two months. The S&P 500 fell 0.52%, while the Nasdaq’s decline narrowed to 0.21% thanks to a rebound in some chip stocks. The Philadelphia Semiconductor Index edged up 0.44%.

The market has recently been affected by a cooling off in AI‑driven trading, the risk of an expanding Middle‑East conflict, and volatile US Treasury movements, leading to a clear sector rotation. On Friday, selling pressure further extended into defensive groups like consumer staples, utilities and healthcare, but over the full week the major indices showed mixed gains and losses, indicating continued internal divergence.

For the week to date, the Dow was up 0.4%, the S&P 500 down 0.5%, the Nasdaq down 0.7%, and the Philly Semiconductor Index’s weekly chart turned black with a 3.21% decline, marking three straight weeks of losses—the longest streak since November last year.

The Middle‑East situation was the main source of pressure on Friday’s market. The US and Israel may be planning a new wave of attacks on Iran, and Iran says it is ready to retaliate, reviving concerns about oil‑supply disruptions.

Former US President Donald Trump said the United States might take further military action against Iran and urged Tehran to come to the negotiating table, a stance that differs from his earlier comment this month that the US would not attack Iran before the midterm elections.

West Texas Intermediate crude futures broke the $100‑per‑barrel barrier, while Brent crude edged toward $117, its highest close since April, rekindling market worries about inflation. With the Federal Reserve about to announce its rate decision, attention is focused on how energy costs could feed price pressures.

In the US Treasury market, investors on Thursday shifted to safety amid massive financing needs for AI data centers and credit risk in the tech sector, pushing the 10‑year Treasury yield below 5% for the first time in a month.

However, as oil prices rose on Friday, US Treasuries gave back some of the previous day’s gains; the 10‑year yield climbed more than four basis points to about 4.999%, once again edging toward the 5% threshold.
US equity performance on Friday (the 23rd):

Dow Jones Industrial Average down 652.82 points, or 1.23%, to 52,215.16. Nasdaq Composite down 53.52 points, or 0.21%, to 25,955.34. S&P 500 down 39.75 points, or 0.52%, to 7,623.68. Philadelphia Semiconductor Index up 47.49 points, or 0.44%, to 10,779.46. NYSE FANG+ Index down 46.66 points, or 0.26%, to 18,213.46.

Among the five big‑tech stocks in the NYSE FANG+ Index, only Microsoft posted a gain. Meta (META‑US) fell 0.96%; Apple (AAPL‑US) slipped 0.14%; Alphabet (GOOGL‑US) dropped 1.24%; Microsoft (MSFT‑US) rose 0.66%; Amazon (AMZN‑US) declined 0.95%.
Semiconductor stocks were mixed. AMD (AMD‑US) up 1.74%; Broadcom (AVGO‑US) down 0.48%; Nvidia (NVDA‑US) down 0.59%; Applied Materials (AMAT‑US) up 0.44%; Qualcomm (QCOM‑US) up 1.78%.

Memory and storage stocks showed both gains and losses. Micron (MU‑US) up 2.46%; Western Digital (WDC‑US) down 2.97%; SanDisk (SNDK‑US) down 1.82%; Seagate (STX‑US) down 1.81%; SK Hynix ADR (SKHY‑US) up 4.05%.
Taiwan ADRs rose more than they fell. TSMC ADR (TSM‑US) up 1.49%; ASE Technology ADR (ASX‑US) up 2.52%; UMC ADR (UMC‑US) up 1.94%; Chunghwa Telecom ADR (CHT‑US) down 0.43%.
Corporate news

American Express (AXP‑US) plunged 3.62% to $313.22, becoming one of the Dow‑dragging stocks. The company announced a global workforce reduction of about 5%, citing AI development and rising cost pressures. Caterpillar (CAT‑US) fell roughly 2%, and Goldman Sachs (GS‑US) dropped over 1%, adding further pressure to the Dow.

Apple (AAPL‑US) closed down 0.14% at $347.72, up 1.83% on the weekly chart. After the launch of the new foldable iPhone Duo, limited in‑store inventory sold out quickly, indicating strong demand for the device priced near $2,000.

SpaceX is seeking to secure at least 80,000 ground‑station sites across the United States and has been in talks with at least one major mobile‑network infrastructure provider to continue expanding its terrestrial communications network. SpaceX (SPCX‑US) rose 1.89% to $147.49, though it fell 1.16% for the week.

Bank of America raised ServiceNow’s (NOW‑US) target price to $180 and kept a “Buy” rating, citing growing AI product demand that should sustain revenue growth. The company is slated to report its Q3 results on October 28. ServiceNow gained 1.25% to $158.96.
Wall Street commentary

Jed Ellerbroek, portfolio manager at Argent Capital Management, said that over the past two weeks investors have been rotating from tech and data‑center beneficiaries into defensive assets, but that this rotation will eventually run out of steam, and Friday’s market action reflected that dynamic.
He added that recent solid earnings from some tech companies give investors reason to reassess tech stocks, and the market does not have to be dominated entirely by risk‑off sentiment.

Bank of America strategist Michael Hartnett remains cautious, expecting that concerns over AI‑driven trading and uncertainty surrounding the US midterm elections will keep risk‑off sentiment alive into mid‑November. He forecasts that Treasury yields, equities and the dollar could all move lower together.

Ulrike Hoffmann‑Burchardi of UBS’s Investment Management Office took a relatively upbeat view, believing corporate earnings can still support the market and AI demand remains strong; geopolitical developments alone are not enough to justify a full shift to defensive positioning.

Tiffany Wilding, economist at PIMCO, noted that AI is boosting US demand while many inflation gauges remain above target. She said the Fed’s modest rate adjustments and tighter financial conditions are a reasonable response. Although inflation is still elevated, it has not accelerated further, giving the Fed room to adjust policy gradually.

items.title: 川普再提對伊朗動武：可能再來一次「史詩怒火」行動
items.title_en: Trump Again Calls for Military Action Against Iran: Possible Repeat of “Operation Epic Fury”
paras: 美國總統川普週五 (23 日) 表示，美國可能再次對伊朗採取軍事行動，並敦促德黑蘭接受談判解決衝突。這番言論與他本月稍早表示期中選舉前不會攻擊伊朗的說法形成落差。隨著戰事即將滿 8 個月，燃料價格上漲也成為美國期中選舉的重要壓力。
川普當天在佛羅里達州麥爾茲堡 (Fort Myers) 的造勢活動上談及伊朗戰爭時表示：「我們可能再來一次小規模的『史詩怒火』(Operation Epic Fury) 行動，或者他們會同意。」史詩怒火是美軍對伊朗作戰使用的行動代號。
他並未進一步說明可能採取的行動規模、時間或目標。
川普在演說中聲稱，美軍先前透過「午夜之鎚」(Operation Midnight Hammer) 行動摧毀伊朗的鈾濃縮能力，再以「史詩怒火」行動進一步打擊其核能力。
川普接著向伊朗喊話：「如果他們夠聰明，就會說：『我們來認真談吧。』」
不過，他隨即表示，自己懷疑伊朗會採取這種做法。
川普週五稍早才表示，美國有能力迅速結束戰爭，但他仍在思考華府究竟應尋求快速終結衝突，還是讓戰事逐步平息。
他本月稍早則曾表示，美國不會在期中選舉前對伊朗發動攻擊，凸顯其對戰爭時程與下一步行動的說法仍有變動。
這場自 2 月下旬爆發的戰爭，至今仍未正式落幕。儘管各方曾達成停火安排，並簽署旨在敲定和平協議的諒解備忘錄，最終協議仍未完成。
美國與以色列對伊朗的攻擊，以及以色列對黎巴嫩的軍事行動，已造成數千人死亡、數百萬人流離失所。
伊朗方面則持續釋出強硬訊號。
伊朗革命衛隊政治局負責人Yadollah Javani 警告，若敵方發動地面入侵，伊朗將成為入侵外國部隊的葬身之地。他聲稱，美軍在區域內的基地與行動已面臨限制，難以進入陌生領土並維持長期駐軍。
與此同時，埃及、沙烏地阿拉伯、土耳其與巴基斯坦外長在伊斯坦堡會談後發表聯合聲明，強調應透過對話與外交處理美以對伊朗戰爭，並呼籲全面恢復荷姆茲海峽的安全通航，反對限制合法航行的措施。
中東供應風險升溫，國際油價週五 (23 日) 大幅收高。布蘭特原油期貨上漲 3.55 美元，或 3.14%，收每桶 116.72 美元，創 4 月 29 日以來最高收盤價。
西德州原油期貨上漲 3.80 美元，或 3.8%，收每桶 103.27 美元。全週布蘭特與西德州原油分別上漲 6% 及 2.3%。
葉門胡塞武裝接連攻擊沙烏地阿拉伯，包括能源基礎設施，加上阿拉伯聯合大公國外海傳出油輪漏油事件，加深市場對中東能源供應中斷的疑慮，成為推升油價的主要因素。
paras_en: U.S. President Donald Trump said on Friday (the 23rd) that the United States may once again take military action against Iran and urged Tehran to accept negotiations to resolve the conflict. This statement contrasts with his earlier comment this month that the U.S. would not attack Iran before the midterm elections. As the war approaches its eighth month, rising fuel prices have become a major pressure point for the U.S. midterms.

Speaking at a rally in Fort Myers, Florida, Trump said regarding the Iran war, "We may do a small‑scale repeat of ‘Operation Epic Fury,’ or they will agree." Epic Fury is the code name the U.S. military uses for operations against Iran.
He did not elaborate on the possible scale, timing or targets of any such action.

In his speech, Trump claimed that U.S. forces had previously destroyed Iran’s uranium enrichment capability through an operation called “Midnight Hammer,” and would follow up with “Epic Fury” to further strike its nuclear capacity.
Trump then addressed Iran directly: "If they’re smart enough, they’ll say, ‘Let’s talk seriously.’"
He quickly added that he doubted Iran would take that approach.

Earlier on Friday, Trump said the United States has the ability to end the war quickly, but he is still weighing whether Washington should seek a rapid termination of the conflict or let the fighting wind down gradually.

He had earlier this month said the United States would not launch an attack on Iran before the midterm elections, highlighting that his statements on the war’s timeline and next steps have been shifting.

The war that erupted in late February remains officially unresolved. Although cease‑fire arrangements were reached and a memorandum of understanding aimed at finalising a peace deal was signed, a definitive agreement has yet to be completed.
U.S. and Israeli attacks on Iran, as well as Israeli military actions in Lebanon, have already caused thousands of deaths and displaced millions.
Iran continues to issue hard‑line signals.

Yadollah Javani, a senior official of the Iranian Revolutionary Guard’s political bureau, warned that if the enemy launches a ground invasion, Iran will become a graveyard for invading foreign forces. He claimed U.S. bases and operations in the region are now constrained, making it difficult for American troops to enter unfamiliar territory and maintain a long‑term presence.

Meanwhile, foreign ministers from Egypt, Saudi Arabia, Turkey and Pakistan, after meeting in Istanbul, issued a joint statement emphasizing that the U.S.–Israel war with Iran should be handled through dialogue and diplomacy, calling for the full restoration of safe navigation through the Hormuz Strait and opposing measures that restrict legitimate shipping.

Middle‑East supply risks are heating up, and international oil prices surged sharply on Friday (the 23rd). Brent crude futures rose $3.55, or 3.14%, closing at $116.72 a barrel, the highest close since April 29.
West Texas Intermediate crude rose $3.80, or 3.8%, to $103.27 a barrel. Over the week, Brent and WTI gained 6% and 2.3% respectively.

Yemen’s Houthi forces have repeatedly attacked Saudi Arabia, including energy infrastructure, and an offshore oil‑spill incident off the United Arab Emirates has heightened market concerns about Middle‑East energy supply disruptions, becoming a key driver behind the rise in oil prices.

items.title: 「大賣空」貝瑞：美股結構愈來愈像網路泡沫化那年 但美政府幾乎無力對抗下場危機
items.title_en: "The Big Short" Michael Burry: US Stock Market Structure Is Becoming More Like the 2000 Dot‑Com Bubble, Yet the US Government Is Almost Powerless to Counter the Resulting Crisis
paras: 電影《大賣空》(The Big Short)原型人物、曾成功預判2008年美國房市泡沫聞名的知名華爾街空頭麥可·貝瑞(Michael Burry)再度對金融市場發出警告，指出美國政府過去不斷以危機為由放寬財政紀律，累積大量債務，如今面對下一次金融危機時，能夠動用的政策空間可能已所剩不多。
與此同時，標普500指數雖然持續創下歷史新高，成分股的實際表現卻明顯分化，市場上漲動能集中於少數股票，部分內部指標更呈現與2000年科技泡沫高峰相似的特徵。
貝瑞在個人Substack電子報《Cassandra Unchained》發文指出，政府過去藉由真正發生的危機作為放棄財政審慎原則的理由，危機過後卻未恢復原有紀律，最終使政府在面對下一次市場崩跌時，缺乏足夠的財政能力支撐市場。他認為，當前私人信貸市場已存在泡沫，一旦泡沫破裂，華府可能難以像過去一樣迅速出手救市。
貝瑞將政府在持續增加債務的同時，又一再縮短市場自然修復過程的做法形容為「不可原諒」，並警告相關後果終將浮現，甚至可能已經開始發生。
貝瑞的疑慮不只來自政府債務，也與美股市場內部的結構性弱點有關。他透過數十年來的標普500指數成分股歷史資料，建立衡量市場下跌廣度的指標，觀察有多少成分股已較過去10年高點下跌逾20%，並將其稱為熊市比率 (Bear Market Ratio)。
追蹤標普500指數表現的SPDR標普500 ETF (SPY-US) 於10月6日收在歷史新高時，貝瑞計算的熊市比率已達55%，遠高於8月13日指數前一次創高時的47%。這代表即使大盤指數持續刷新紀錄，超過半數成分股的股價實際上已較各自過去10年的高點下跌逾20%。
回顧過去40年，只有一次標普500指數創高時的市場廣度比目前更差。2000年3月科技泡沫達到高峰時，有71.2%的指數成分股已進入各自的熊市區間。相較之下，自1985年以來，一般市場高點出現時，熊市比率通常約為20%至31%。
其他市場廣度指標也顯示，上漲動能並未廣泛擴散。10月6日標普500指數創下歷史新高當天，僅有15檔成分股同步收在自身歷史新高，只有97檔股票的股價位於各自高點下方10%以內。
2000年3月科技泡沫高峰時，同樣只有15檔成分股同步創高，但有87檔股票距離自身高點不到10%。目前與當年相似之處，在於大盤指數雖然處於高檔，能夠同步參與上漲的股票數量卻相當有限。
此外，目前標普500成分股的股價中位數，較各自高點低22%；2000年科技泡沫高峰時，這項差距更達31%。這反映出指數整體表現與多數個股的實際狀況之間，存在明顯落差。
為了排除部分股票仍受多年以前高點影響的情況，貝瑞另外建立「新近回落比率」(Fresh Drawdown Ratio)，用來觀察近期市場下跌的廣度。過去一般市場高點出現時，該指標通常介於6%至13%，目前則升至27%，約為2000年科技泡沫高峰時的一半。
綜合這些指標，貝瑞認為，當前市場的內部結構比2000年以來任何時期都更接近當年的科技泡沫高峰，但仍未達到2000年的極端程度。
不過，貝瑞並未將基本情境設定為市場立即出現單日或短期全面崩盤。他預期，市場更可能經歷一段緩慢下滑的過程，期間可能出現劇烈震盪，先前領漲的股票逐漸走弱，而已經大幅下跌的中位數股票反而可能上漲。這種指數下跌、部分落後股回升的走勢，曾在2000年科技泡沫破裂後出現。
他認為，隨著企業基本面利空逐步浮現，市場可能開始重新評估人工智慧投資熱潮的合理性，相關風險也會逐漸反映在股價上。即使美國市場的危機應對機制過去曾成功處理突然發生的拋售潮，當市場同時面臨基本面惡化、技術面轉弱及上漲參與度下降時，處理難度也會明顯提高。
貝瑞近期持續質疑大型科技企業在AI領域的資本支出。他先前指出，除了蘋果 (Apple) (AAPL-US) 以外，其他大型科技企業的投資規模，彷彿企業生存完全取決於這場AI競賽能否成功。他認為，當市場對AI成長前景的預期過高，一旦實際獲利、需求或投資回報不如預期，原本支撐股價的樂觀情緒便可能迅速逆轉。
目前的關鍵在於，美國政府能否在下一次重大金融或債務危機發生時，提供足夠的政策支持。若政府債務負擔持續增加，財政刺激與市場救援的能力可能受到限制；另一方面，如果股市上漲主要由少數大型企業帶動，市場整體的脆弱性也可能被指數創高的表象掩蓋。
貝瑞的分析並不代表市場必然重演2000年科技泡沫崩盤，也沒有提出確切的崩跌日期或目標價。不過，他透過市場廣度、個股回落幅度及政府財政能力等不同角度提出警訊，認為投資人不應只看標普500指數是否創高，更應留意有多少成分股真正參與上漲，以及政府在下一次危機來臨時還剩下多少應對空間。
paras_en: Michael Burry, the Wall Street short‑seller whose story inspired the film "The Big Short" and who famously predicted the 2008 US housing bubble, has again warned about the financial markets, saying that the US government has repeatedly relaxed fiscal discipline under the pretext of crises, amassing huge debt, and now has little policy space left for the next financial shock.

At the same time, although the S&P 500 continues to hit all‑time highs, the actual performance of its component stocks is sharply divided, with upward momentum concentrated in a few stocks and some internal indicators showing patterns similar to the peak of the 2000 tech bubble.

In a post on his personal Substack newsletter "Cassandra Unchained," Burry noted that the government has used real crises as an excuse to abandon fiscal prudence, failed to restore discipline after the crises, and thus lacks sufficient fiscal capacity to support the market when the next crash hits. He believes a bubble already exists in the private‑credit market, and if it bursts Washington may not be able to intervene as quickly as before.

Burry described the government’s habit of continuously adding debt while repeatedly shortening the market’s natural healing process as "unforgivable," warning that the resulting consequences will eventually surface, and may already be unfolding.

Burry’s concerns stem not only from government debt but also from structural weaknesses inside the US equity market. Using decades of historical data on S&P 500 constituents, he created a metric that measures the breadth of market declines, counting how many components have fallen more than 20% from their 10‑year highs, which he calls the Bear Market Ratio.

When the SPDR S&P 500 ETF (SPY‑US) closed at a record high on October 6, Burry’s Bear Market Ratio was already 55%, up from 47% when the index last peaked on August 13. That means that even as the index keeps breaking records, more than half of its stocks are trading at least 20% below their own 10‑year peaks.

Looking back over the past 40 years, there has been only one instance when market breadth was worse at an S&P 500 peak than it is today. At the March 2000 tech‑bubble peak, 71.2% of the index’s components were already in their own bear zones. By contrast, since 1985, typical market highs have seen a Bear Market Ratio of about 20%‑31%.

Other breadth indicators also show that upward momentum is not broadly distributed. On the day the S&P 500 hit a record high on October 6, only 15 components closed at their own all‑time highs, and merely 97 stocks were within 10% of their individual peaks.

At the March 2000 tech‑bubble peak, the same 15 components hit new highs, but 87 stocks were within 10% of their own peaks. The similarity today is that, despite a high index level, only a limited number of stocks are participating in the rally.

Furthermore, the median price of current S&P 500 constituents is 22% below their individual peaks, compared with a 31% gap at the 2000 tech‑bubble peak, highlighting a clear divergence between the index’s headline performance and most individual stocks.

To filter out stocks still anchored to much older highs, Burry also created a "Fresh Drawdown Ratio" to gauge recent market‑wide declines. Historically, this metric has ranged from 6% to 13% at typical market peaks; it is now up to 27%, roughly half of the level seen at the 2000 tech‑bubble peak.

Putting these metrics together, Burry argues that today’s market structure is closer than any time since 2000 to the conditions at the tech‑bubble peak, though it has not yet reached the extreme levels of 2000.

However, Burry does not assume an immediate, single‑day or short‑term market collapse. He expects a slower, drawn‑out decline that may feature sharp volatility, with former leaders losing steam while the heavily‑depressed median stocks could actually rise—a pattern that occurred after the 2000 tech‑bubble burst.

He believes that as corporate fundamentals turn negative, the market will begin to reassess the rationality of the AI investment frenzy, and related risks will start to be priced in. Even though US crisis‑management mechanisms have previously handled sudden sell‑offs, the combination of deteriorating fundamentals, weakening technicals, and reduced participation in the rally will make mitigation considerably harder.

Burry has recently questioned the scale of AI‑related capital spending by large tech firms. Aside from Apple (AAPL‑US), he says the investment size of other big tech companies suggests their survival seems tied to winning the AI race. He warns that if AI growth expectations are overstated and actual profits, demand, or returns fall short, the optimism that has buoyed stock prices could reverse quickly.

The key now is whether the US government can provide sufficient policy support when the next major financial or debt crisis hits. If debt burdens keep rising, fiscal stimulus and market rescue capacity may be constrained; conversely, if the rally is driven mainly by a few mega‑caps, the overall market’s fragility could be masked by the index’s new highs.

Burry’s analysis does not claim the market will inevitably repeat the 2000 tech‑bubble crash, nor does it give a specific crash date or target level. Nonetheless, by highlighting market breadth, individual stock drawdowns, and government fiscal capacity, he warns investors to look beyond whether the S&P 500 is at a record and pay attention to how many components truly join the rise and how much policy room remains for the next crisis.

items.title: 資料中心機電工程需求強，Comfort Systems擴大2027年模組化廠房規模
items.title_en: Strong Demand for Data Center MEP Engineering Drives Comfort Systems to Expand Modular Plant Size for 2027
paras: 2026年10月24日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 美國機電工程承包商Comfort Systems USA(FIX-US)在第三季法說會表示，預計2027年底模組化業務廠房面積將達約600萬平方呎，高於2026年底逾400萬平方呎的規模。公司同時預估，2027年既有業務營收將成長約25%，毛利率可望維持近幾季的強勁水準。

這波擴張背後，是資料中心客戶提前鎖定施工與製造能力。Comfort Systems承作空調、管線與電氣工程，也在工廠預製模組化冷卻設施與熱通道封閉系統，再送往客戶場址。管理層指出，客戶因施工能力稀缺而更早承諾、更大範圍的工程；目前限制接單的主要因素不是需求，而是能否調度足夠技術人力。第三季底在手訂單達178.1億美元，較第二季底140.6億美元增加約27%，年增約90%；大型專案使訂單執行期間延長至約18至24個月。
模組化業務前九月占營收17%。管理層說明，2027年底的擴廠規畫主要依據既有客戶合作安排，這類合作通常包含五年採購量承諾，公司才投入大額資本支出建置廠房。公司已為新的前沿AI實驗室與資料中心代管業者製作產品，但尚未建立相同形式的長期量產合作；是否擴大承接，仍取決於採購承諾、付款時點與客戶財務能力。
第三季營收37.66億美元，年增53.7%；淨利4.89億美元，年增67.7%，每股稀釋盈餘13.91美元。毛利率24.8%，與去年同期持平，營業利益率則由15.5%升至16.6%。公司指出，當季設備與材料占成本比重較高，雖推升營收，卻拉低季比毛利率；部分大型工程也仍處於初期，公司會保留成本預備額，待施工進度提高、剩餘成本更明確後才認列較多利潤。
為支應需求，Comfort Systems預估2026年資本支出占營收4%至5%，2027年上半年仍將維持較高投入。除了模組化擴廠，公司也已投入逾1億美元擴充傳統工程的預製設施。管理層強調，承接每筆工程前都會先確認人力計畫；在手訂單能否轉為營收與獲利，仍取決於擴廠、人員配置與專案執行進度。

paras_en: On October 24, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center report) – U.S. MEP contractor Comfort Systems USA (FIX-US) said at its third‑quarter earnings call that it expects the modular‑business plant area to reach about 6 million square feet by the end of 2027, up from more than 4 million square feet at the end of 2026. The company also forecasts existing‑business revenue to grow roughly 25% in 2027, with gross margin expected to stay near the strong levels seen in recent quarters.

The expansion is driven by data‑center customers locking in construction and manufacturing capacity early. Comfort Systems provides HVAC, piping and electrical work and also prefabricates modular cooling equipment and enclosed hot‑aisle systems in its factories before shipping them to customer sites. Management noted that because construction capacity is scarce, customers are committing earlier and for larger scopes; the main constraint on new orders is not demand but the ability to mobilize enough skilled labor. Backlog at the end of Q3 was $17.81 billion, up about 27% from $14.06 billion at the end of Q2, roughly a 90% year‑over‑year increase, with large projects extending execution periods to about 18‑24 months.

Modular business accounted for 17% of revenue in the first nine months. Management explained that the 2027 plant‑expansion plan is based primarily on existing customer collaboration agreements, which typically include a five‑year purchase‑volume commitment before the company makes a large capital investment in a new plant. The firm has already produced products for a new frontier AI lab and a data‑center colocation provider, but has not yet established the same type of long‑term mass‑production partnership; any further expansion will depend on purchase commitments, payment timing and the customers’ financial strength.

Third‑quarter revenue was $3.766 billion, up 53.7% year‑over‑year; net income was $489 million, up 67.7%, and diluted earnings per share were $13.91. Gross margin was 24.8%, flat versus the prior year, while operating margin rose from 15.5% to 16.6%. The company noted that equipment and material costs made up a larger share of expenses this quarter, boosting revenue but pulling down quarterly gross margin; some large projects are still in early stages, so the firm is retaining cost reserves and will recognize more profit as construction progresses and remaining costs become clearer.

To meet demand, Comfort Systems estimates capital expenditures will represent 4%‑5% of revenue in 2026, with similarly high spending in the first half of 2027. In addition to the modular expansion, the company has already invested over $100 million to expand prefabrication facilities for its traditional engineering business. Management emphasized that each project is vetted for labor plans before acceptance; whether backlog converts to revenue and profit still depends on plant expansion, staffing and project execution progress.

items.title: 美股收盤｜道瓊跌逾1%，市場緊盯科技巨頭AI支出與Fed決策
items.title_en: U.S. Stocks Close | Dow Down Over 1%, Market Eyes Tech Giants' AI Spending and Fed Decision
paras: 2026年10月24日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 美股10月23日週五三大指數同步收低，道瓊下跌逾650點。科技股在前一天重挫後暫時止穩，但消費與金融股賣壓未退，電信股又受到SpaceX可能加入競爭的消息衝擊。歷經AI投資疑慮引發的一週震盪，華爾街接下來將迎來科技巨頭財報與聯準會利率決策。
道瓊工業指數下跌652.82點，跌幅1.23%，收52,215.16點；標普500指數下跌39.75點，跌0.52%，收7,623.68點；那斯達克綜合指數下跌53.52點，跌0.21%，收25,955.34點。全週來看，標普500下跌0.5%、那斯達克下跌0.7%，道瓊則上漲0.4%，連續第三週收紅。
電信股成為當天賣壓焦點。根據先前報導，SpaceX正尋求數千座基地台，準備籌建美國第四家無線電信業者。AT&T與T-Mobile股價均重挫近8%，Verizon下跌1.2%；基地台業者則逆勢走強，Crown Castle上漲9%、American Tower上漲4%。
能源股逆勢走強，標普500能源類股上漲2.5%、創下新高。葉門胡塞武裝襲擊沙烏地阿拉伯，引發中東能源供應進一步中斷的擔憂，推升油價；油田服務商SLB第三季獲利優於市場預期，股價上漲7%。相較之下，美國運通雖上修獲利展望，股價仍下跌3.7%，成為道瓊的拖累之一。
科技股當天回穩，標普500科技類股上漲0.35%，但支撐大規模AI投資所需的融資成本，仍是市場關注的風險。下週Alphabet、微軟與亞馬遜將公布財報，資本支出展望將接受投資人檢視。Man Group首席市場策略師Kristina Hooper表示，市場仍在消化對AI投資熱潮的質疑，明年資料中心建置支出可能低於先前預估，讓投資人轉趨觀望。
下週約有三分之一標普500成分企業公布季度業績。依LSEG IBES資料，標普500企業第三季獲利目前預估年增逾32%，仍為股市提供支撐。市場同時預期聯準會將在10月28日維持利率不變，並將從決策聲明尋找12月是否可能升息的線索。

paras_en: October 24, 2026 (You Analysis/Industry Data Center report) – On Friday, October 23, the three major U.S. indices all closed lower, with the Dow dropping more than 650 points. Tech stocks steadied after a sharp sell‑off the day before, but pressure on consumer and financial stocks persisted, and telecom stocks were hit by news that SpaceX may enter the competition. After a week of volatility sparked by doubts over AI investment, Wall Street now looks ahead to earnings from tech giants and the Federal Reserve’s rate decision.

The Dow Jones Industrial Average fell 652.82 points, down 1.23% to 52,215.16; the S&P 500 slipped 39.75 points, down 0.52% to 7,623.68; and the Nasdaq Composite dropped 53.52 points, down 0.21% to 25,955.34. Over the week, the S&P 500 was down 0.5%, the Nasdaq down 0.7%, while the Dow was up 0.4%, marking a third consecutive week of gains.

Telecom stocks were the focus of the day's selling pressure. According to earlier reports, SpaceX is seeking thousands of base stations as it prepares to launch the United States’ fourth wireless carrier. AT&T and T‑Mobile shares each plunged nearly 8%, while Verizon fell 1.2%; base‑station owners moved opposite, with Crown Castle up 9% and American Tower up 4%.

Energy stocks rose against the trend, with S&P 500 energy sector shares up 2.5% to a new high. Houthi attacks in Yemen on Saudi Arabia raised concerns of further Middle‑East energy supply disruptions, pushing oil prices higher; oil‑field services firm SLB posted third‑quarter earnings above market expectations, sending its stock up 7%. By contrast, American Express, despite raising its profit outlook, saw its share price fall 3.7%, becoming one of the Dow’s drags.

Tech stocks steadied that day, with S&P 500 technology shares up 0.35%, but financing costs needed to support large‑scale AI investment remain a market risk. Next week Alphabet, Microsoft and Amazon will release earnings, and their capital‑expenditure outlooks will be scrutinized by investors. Man Group chief market strategist Kristina Hooper said the market is still digesting doubts about the AI investment boom, and data‑center build‑out spending next year may be lower than previously forecast, prompting investors to adopt a wait‑and‑see stance.

About one‑third of S&P 500 component companies are set to report quarterly results next week. According to LSEG IBES data, third‑quarter earnings for S&P 500 firms are currently projected to grow more than 32% year‑over‑year, still providing support for the equity market. The market also expects the Fed to keep rates unchanged on October 28 and to look for clues in the decision statement about a possible rate hike in December.

items.title: 石墨電極漲價效應顯現，GrafTech預估第四季售價回升
items.title_en: Graphite Electrode Price Rise Shows Effect, GrafTech Forecasts Q4 Price Recovery
paras: 2026年10月24日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 電弧爐煉鋼耗材石墨電極大廠GrafTech(EAF-US)表示，隨較高價格的新訂單陸續交貨，預估第四季加權平均實現售價將較第三季上升中個位數百分比，2027年售價也可望明顯高於今年。公司9月初再宣布調漲30%，作為2027年合約議價起點。
第三季平均售價約每公噸3900美元，年減7%，與第二季持平。執行長Timothy Flanagan表示，公司3月底宣布調價時，全年約八成銷量已取得客戶承諾，新價格初期僅適用少部分訂單。依公司估算，調價後新訂單價格約提高15%，第四季交貨中適用新價的比重將增加。
2027年訂單仍在洽談。公司預計明年2月公布第四季財報時，約60%至65%的2027年銷量將完成確認。
第三季石墨電極銷量2.88萬公噸，與去年同期持平；營收約1.40億美元，年減3%。每公噸現金銷貨成本年減4%，調整後EBITDA由去年同期1301萬美元降至863萬美元。淨損擴大至4677萬美元，其中約1400萬美元為墨西哥廠重整與退出費用，多數為非現金項目。
產能方面，GrafTech第三季產能利用率64%，第二季為74%。執行長估計，中國以外整體產業產能利用率約65%，扣除公司此次減少的約5.1萬公噸產能後，可望上升至70%出頭。
GrafTech正推進9月宣布的Monterrey廠關閉計畫，訂單轉由法國與西班牙廠承接，預計2027年第二季初完成轉移，屆時年產能約12.7萬公噸。公司估計每年可節省2000萬至2500萬美元現金成本，完整效益於2028年實現；關廠需支出約2000萬至2500萬美元一次性現金成本。
GrafTech指出，中國石墨電極價格今年持續上漲，出口量年減約10%。美國商務部正對中國與印度大尺寸石墨電極進行反傾銷調查，最終裁定預計2027年第一季出爐。
需求方面，GrafTech預估中國以外石墨電極需求未來每年成長約3%。美國鋼鐵業產能利用率連續兩季達80%。世界鋼鐵協會預測，中國以外鋼材需求成長率將由2026年的約1.5%，上升至2027年的4%。
成本方面，上游針狀焦價格今年持續走高，公司歐洲固定價格能源合約將於2027年部分到期重新定價。管理層表示，2027年電極漲幅可望超過成本增幅。公司維持2026年銷量年增5%至10%、每公噸現金銷貨成本下降低個位數百分比的預期。

優分析觀點
價格上漲，通常有兩種來源：一種是需求暴增，貨不夠賣；另一種是供給減少，原本太多的貨變少了。石墨電極屬於後者。需求每年只成長約3%，真正推動漲價的，是業者關廠減產、原料與能源成本上升，以及貿易保護減少低價進口。
這兩種漲價的力道不一樣。需求暴增時，產能滿載、客戶搶貨，供應商可以一路漲價，利潤快速擴大。石墨電極則不同，即使扣除這次關閉的產能，中國以外的產業利用率也只有約70%，供給仍相對寬鬆；漲價的同時成本也在上升，能轉成多少利潤仍有限。

paras_en: October 24, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center report) – Major electric‑arc furnace graphite electrode producer GrafTech (EAF‑US) said that as higher‑priced new orders are gradually delivered, it expects the weighted‑average realized price in Q4 to rise by a low‑single‑digit percentage versus Q3, and 2027 prices to be clearly higher than this year. The company announced another 30% price increase in early September as the starting point for 2027 contract negotiations.

The average price in Q3 was about $3,900 per metric ton, down 7% year‑over‑year and flat with Q2. CEO Timothy Flanagan said that when the price hike was announced at the end of March, roughly 80% of annual volume had already been secured from customers, and the new price initially applied only to a small portion of orders. The company estimates the new orders after the hike are priced about 15% higher, and the share of Q4 deliveries at the new price will increase.
Orders for 2027 are still being negotiated. The company expects that when it releases its Q4 results in February next year, about 60%‑65% of 2027 sales will be confirmed.

Graphite electrode sales in Q3 were 28,800 metric tons, unchanged from the same period last year; revenue was about $1.40 billion, down 3% year‑over‑year. Cash cost per ton fell 4% year‑over‑year, and adjusted EBITDA dropped from $13.01 million last year to $8.63 million. Net loss widened to $46.77 million, of which roughly $14 million relates to restructuring and exit costs at the Mexico plant, most of which are non‑cash items.

Capacity utilization was 64% in Q3, down from 74% in Q2. The CEO estimates that overall industry capacity utilization outside China is about 65%; after subtracting the roughly 51,000‑ton reduction from GrafTech’s own capacity, utilization could rise to just over 70%.

GrafTech is moving forward with the Monterrey plant closure announced in September, shifting orders to its France and Spain facilities, with the transfer expected to be completed in early Q2 2027, resulting in an annual capacity of about 127,000 metric tons. The company estimates annual cash cost savings of $20‑$25 million, with full benefits realized in 2028; the closure will require a one‑time cash outlay of about $20‑$25 million.

GrafTech noted that graphite electrode prices in China have continued to rise this year, while export volumes fell about 10% year‑over‑year. The U.S. Department of Commerce is conducting an anti‑dumping investigation into large‑size graphite electrodes from China and India, with a final ruling expected in Q1 2027.

On the demand side, GrafTech projects that graphite electrode demand outside China will grow about 3% annually. U.S. steel‑making capacity utilization has held at 80% for two consecutive quarters. The World Steel Association forecasts that steel demand outside China will rise from roughly 1.5% in 2026 to 4% in 2027.

On the cost side, upstream needle coke prices have kept climbing this year, and the company’s fixed‑price European energy contracts will be partially renegotiated in 2027. Management says electrode price increases in 2027 are expected to outpace cost growth. The company maintains its outlook for 2026 sales growth of 5%‑10% and a low‑single‑digit percentage decline in cash cost per ton.

U‑Analysis view: Price increases usually stem from two sources – a demand surge that outstrips supply, or a supply contraction that makes previously abundant goods scarcer. Graphite electrodes fall into the latter category. Demand grows only about 3% annually; the real drivers of price hikes are plant closures, higher raw‑material and energy costs, and reduced low‑price imports due to trade protection.

These two price‑increase forces differ in intensity. When demand spikes, capacity runs full, customers scramble, and suppliers can raise prices continuously, quickly expanding margins. Graphite electrodes are different – even after subtracting the capacity closed this time, industry utilization outside China is only about 70%, so supply remains relatively ample; while prices rise, costs are also climbing, limiting how much profit can be captured.

items.title: AI股遭拋售重創資料中心設備商 財報亮眼仍難逃賣壓
items.title_en: AI Stocks Plunge, Crushing Data Center Equipment Makers Despite Strong Earnings
paras: 《Yahoo Finance》報導，AI資料中心建設熱潮中的兩大關鍵供應商，剛公布遠優於預期的財報，華爾街卻依然大舉拋售這些公司的股票。
Bloom Energy(BE-US)為資料中心提供現場發電設備，該燃料電池製造商週四表示，上季營收年增138%，並將全年營收成長展望上修至約122%。負責安裝資料中心冷卻與電力系統的 Comfort Systems(FIX-US)則表示，未完成訂單金額幾乎翻倍，達到178億美元。
然而，這兩檔股票週五(23日)連續第二個交易日大幅下跌。Bloom Energy 大跌11%，Comfort Systems 重挫9%。為資料中心製造網路零組件的 Credo(CRDO-US)也同步下跌9%。
All Star Charts 的 Steve Strazza 週五上午寫道，「一家公司即使交出驚人的業績，如果投資人不願意給予相應的回報，那就代表某些地方出了問題。」
不過，Bloom Energy 的財報也確實提供了看空者一些質疑的理由。該公司上季現金流轉為負值，利潤率的改善也未能跟上營收成長。
不只兩檔股票遭殃
根據 Yahoo Finance 計算，自標普500指數10月6日創下收盤歷史新高以來，負責建造及供應 AI 資料中心設備的企業，股價跌幅中位數已達23%。這個族群包括開拓重工(Caterpillar)(CAT-US)、GE Vernova(GEV-US)、Vertiv(VRT-US)及Eaton(ETN-US)等大型企業。
同期，電力生產商股價下跌14%，輝達(NVDA-US)下跌11%。反觀負責支付這些建設費用的大型科技公司，股價平均跌幅僅約5%。
換言之，收錢的公司，股價跌得比付錢的公司還要慘。
這樣的走勢與目前資料中心建設面臨的最大問題——供應不足——背道而馳。Jefferies分析師 Aniket Shah 週三表示，「目前 AI 資料中心建設最大的限制因素就是電力。」他並指出，社會大眾對新建資料中心的反對聲浪正在增加。連輝達執行長黃仁勳也表示，資料中心建設業者必須成為「好鄰居」。
阿波羅全球管理首席經濟學家 Torsten Sløk 本週撰文指出，運算能力的需求「遠遠大於供給」。他認為，若資料中心建設速度放緩，反而可能有利於掌握稀缺產能的業者，包括電力生產商及變壓器製造商。這些變壓器的交貨前置時間長達「26個月」。
他指出，真正的輸家將是「開發商與處於施工階段的投資人」，以及股價已反映所有建設都會如期完成的 AI 概念股。
Sløk 寫道，真正的風險在於，如果供給追上需求，或需求轉弱，原本的「稀缺局面就會消退」。如今就連他認為可能受惠的企業也遭到拋售，顯示市場正在押注最糟糕的情境。
自10月6日以來，12家大型資料中心建設商與電力相關企業的總市值，合計已蒸發超過3,000億美元。
然而，這些公司的訂單簿目前還看不出任何類似的惡化跡象。是未完成訂單的數據出了問題，還是股價反映過度悲觀的預期？
下一個關鍵考驗將在週三到來，微軟(MSFT-US)、Alphabet(GOOGL-US)及 Vertiv(VRT-US)將公布財報，亞馬遜(AMZN-US)則預計於週四公布業績。
這些公司的支出計畫，將揭示資料中心相關企業的未完成訂單是否會持續增加，還是對 AI 投資熱潮抱持懷疑態度的市場人士，其實看到了值得警惕的訊號。
paras_en: Yahoo Finance reported that two key suppliers in the AI data‑center construction boom just posted earnings far above expectations, yet Wall Street is still dumping their shares.

Bloom Energy (BE‑US), which provides on‑site power generation equipment for data centers, said Thursday that last‑quarter revenue grew 138% year‑over‑year and it raised its full‑year revenue growth outlook to about 122%. Comfort Systems (FIX‑US), which installs cooling and power systems for data centers, said its backlog of unfilled orders almost doubled to $17.8 billion.

However, both stocks fell sharply on Friday the 23rd for the second consecutive trading day. Bloom Energy tumbled 11%, Comfort Systems plunged 9%, and Credo (CRDO‑US), which makes network components for data centers, also slid 9%.
All Star Charts’ Steve Strazza wrote on Friday morning, “A company can deliver stunning results, but if investors aren’t willing to give it a commensurate return, something’s wrong somewhere.”
Still, Bloom Energy’s filing gave bears some ammunition. The company posted negative cash flow for the quarter and its profit‑margin improvement lagged behind revenue growth.
Not only those two stocks suffered

According to Yahoo Finance’s calculations, since the S&P 500 hit a record‑high close on October 6, the median decline for companies that build and supply AI data‑center equipment has reached 23%. The group includes heavy‑equipment maker Caterpillar (CAT‑US), GE Vernova (GEV‑US), Vertiv (VRT‑US) and Eaton (ETN‑US) among others.
During the same period, power‑producer stocks fell 14% and Nvidia (NVDA‑US) dropped 11%. By contrast, large tech firms that pay for the construction saw an average decline of only about 5%.
In other words, the companies that receive the money saw their shares fall harder than those that spend it.

That trend runs counter to the biggest current headache for data‑center builds—insufficient supply. Jefferies analyst Aniket Shah said on Wednesday, “Power is the biggest constraint on AI data‑center construction right now.” He added that public opposition to new data centers is growing, and even Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang has said builders must be “good neighbors.”

Apollo Global Management chief economist Torsten Sløk wrote this week that computing‑capacity demand “far outstrips supply.” He believes a slowdown in data‑center construction could actually benefit firms that control scarce capacity, such as power generators and transformer makers, whose lead times can stretch to 26 months.
He warned that the real losers will be “developers and investors still in the construction phase,” as well as AI‑themed stocks whose prices already assume all projects will be completed on schedule.

Sløk added that the true risk is that if supply catches up with demand—or demand weakens—the current scarcity will evaporate. Even the companies he thinks could benefit are now being sold off, showing the market is betting on the worst‑case scenario.
Since October 6, the combined market value of 12 large data‑center builders and power‑related firms has evaporated by more than $300 billion.
Yet there are no clear signs of order‑book deterioration at these companies. Is the backlog data flawed, or are stock prices reflecting overly pessimistic expectations?
The next key test arrives on Wednesday when Microsoft (MSFT‑US), Alphabet (GOOGL‑US) and Vertiv (VRT‑US) report earnings, with Amazon (AMZN‑US) slated to release results on Thursday.
Those spending plans will reveal whether unfinished orders for data‑center vendors will keep rising, or whether market participants skeptical of the AI investment frenzy are spotting warning signals.

paras: 美元周五(23日)小幅上漲，美元指數本週變動不大。歐元則受法國政府公債遭拋售影響走低，法國債務風險溢酬升至2011年歐元區主權債務危機以來最高水準，歐元兌美元與日元均以週線收黑作收。日元受惠於週四AI概念股遭拋售引發的避險資金流入，兌美元本週上漲。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)上漲0.25%，報101.82，本週上漲約0.03%。
市場對法國國內動盪加劇及預算問題惡化的憂慮，持續打擊歐元。法國內政部長Laurent Nuñez表示，法國將於週六部署7萬名警察，並由特種警力支援，以因應抗議活動。此外，穆迪（Moody’s）也可能於週五調降法國的信用評等。
Bannockburn Global Forex 首席市場策略師 Marc Chandler 表示，「今天歐洲債券市場的壓力已有所緩解，但穆迪稍晚對法國債務評等的檢視仍是一項挑戰。儘管馬克宏政府已威脅動用軍事力量平息社會動盪，但週末可能仍會有更多活動發生。」
歐元兌美元下跌0.21%，至1.1191美元，本週下跌約0.43%。
歐元兌日元跌幅更大，一度觸及175.08日圓，創2025年10月以來最低。歐元兌日元下跌0.11%，本週跌約1.1%。
日元兌美元下跌0.1%，至156.9日元，但本週上漲約0.7%，創下9月中旬以來最佳單週表現。
三菱日聯金融集團（MUFG）資深外匯分析師 Lee Hardman 表示，「隨著本週尾聲的避險交易氣氛升溫，日元持續維持在較強勢水準。」
央行政策會議成市場焦點
交易員正關注下週美國聯準會（Fed）、歐洲央行（ECB）及日本銀行（BoJ）的政策會議。市場預期三家央行都將維持利率不變，但投資人將尋找未來貨幣政策走向的線索。
根據倫敦證券交易所集團（LSEG）數據，週四股市遭拋售後，聯邦基金利率期貨交易員下調了對聯準會12月升息的押注，但市場仍認為升息機率達81%。
交易員目前預估，歐洲央行12月升息的機率為66%。投資人將仔細檢視任何有關利率前景的訊號。歐洲央行總裁拉加德（Christine Lagarde）9月底曾表示，面對通膨，採取適度的政策反應是合適的。
採購經理人指數（PMI）數據顯示，歐元區民間部門10月成長速度放緩，降至四個月來最疲弱水準，主要受到法國經濟活動再度萎縮拖累。
花旗經濟學家 Giada Giani 表示，「我們認為，這次數據下滑讓PMI回到與其他經濟成長指標一致的水準，而非意味著未來下行風險正在增加。法國仍是拖累因素，但歐元區其他地區依然展現韌性。」
日本方面，週五公布的數據顯示，9月核心消費者物價年增率九個月來首度超過日本央行2%的通膨目標。分析師表示，這項數據顯示價格壓力正擴大至更多領域，也強化日銀近期升息的理由。

paras_en: The dollar edged higher on Friday (the 23rd), with the DXY showing little change this week. The euro fell as French government bonds were sold off, pushing France's sovereign debt risk premium to its highest level since the Euro‑area crisis of 2011. Both the euro‑dollar and euro‑yen pairs closed the week in the red. The yen benefited from a flight‑to‑safety flow triggered by Thursday’s sell‑off in AI‑related stocks, rising against the dollar over the week.
In the New York close, the dollar index (DXY), which tracks the greenback against six major currencies, rose 0.25% to 101.82, up about 0.03% for the week.

Market worries about escalating domestic turmoil in France and worsening budget issues continued to weigh on the euro. French Interior Minister Laurent Nuñez said France will deploy 70,000 police officers, supported by special forces, on Saturday to address protests. Moody’s also may downgrade France’s credit rating on Friday.

Marc Chandler, chief market strategist at Bannockburn Global Forex, said, “The pressure on European bond markets has eased today, but Moody’s later review of France’s debt rating remains a challenge. Although the Macron government has threatened to use force to quell social unrest, more activity could still occur over the weekend.”
The euro fell 0.21% against the dollar to $1.1191, down about 0.43% for the week.
The euro‑yen pair slipped further, briefly hitting ¥175.08, the lowest since October 2025, down 0.11% and about 1.1% for the week.
The yen slipped 0.1% to ¥156.9 per dollar, but is up roughly 0.7% for the week, marking its best weekly performance since mid‑September.
Lee Hardman, senior FX analyst at MUFG, said, “With the hedge‑fund atmosphere heating up toward the end of the week, the yen remains firmly on the stronger side.”
Central‑bank policy meetings become market focus

Traders are watching next week’s policy meetings of the U.S. Federal Reserve, the European Central Bank and the Bank of Japan. Markets expect all three central banks to keep rates unchanged, but investors will look for clues on future monetary‑policy direction.

According to data from the London Stock Exchange Group, after Thursday’s equity sell‑off, Fed‑funds futures traders reduced bets on a December rate hike, yet the market still sees an 81% probability of a hike.

Traders currently estimate a 66% chance that the ECB will raise rates in December. Investors will scrutinise any signals about the rate outlook. ECB President Christine Lagarde said at the end of September that a measured policy response to inflation is appropriate.

Purchasing Managers’ Index (PMI) data showed that euro‑area private‑sector growth slowed in October to its weakest level in four months, mainly dragged down by a renewed contraction in French economic activity.

Citigroup economist Giada Giani said, “We think this data dip brings the PMI back in line with other growth indicators rather than signalling rising downside risk. France remains a drag, but the rest of the euro area continues to show resilience.”

In Japan, Friday’s data showed that September core CPI year‑over‑year finally exceeded the Bank of Japan’s 2% inflation target for the first time in nine months. Analysts said the figure indicates price pressure spreading to more sectors and bolsters the case for a near‑term rate hike by the BOJ.
Traders now assign a 61% probability to a BOJ rate increase in December.

items.title_en: US Stocks After Hours: Oil Prices Break $100, Dow Down Over 650 Points, Philly Semiconductor Slightly Up, Weekly Chart Shows Three Consecutive Black Candles
paras: 中東戰火再度升溫的疑慮推升油價，美股週五 (23 日) 普遍收黑，賣壓從前一交易日的科技股擴散至民生消費、公用事業及醫療保健等防禦性類股。道瓊重挫約653點，創下兩個月來最大單日跌幅。標普500指數下跌0.52%，那斯達克指數則在部分晶片股反彈支撐下，跌幅收斂至0.21%。費城半導體指數微升 0.44%。
市場近期受到人工智慧 (AI) 交易退燒、中東衝突可能擴大及美債劇烈波動影響，類股輪動明顯。美股週五賣壓進一步擴及民生消費、公用事業及醫療保健等防禦性族群，但拉長至整週來看，主要指數漲跌互見，顯示市場內部表現持續分化。
本週累計，道瓊則上漲0.4%，標普500指數下跌0.5%，那斯達克指數下跌0.7%，費半週線吞黑3.21%，連跌3週，創去年 11 月以來最長紀錄。
中東局勢成為週五市場主要壓力來源。美國與以色列可能規劃對伊朗發動新一波攻擊，伊朗則表示已準備好反擊，使原油供應中斷的疑慮再度升高。
美國總統川普稱美國可能再對伊朗採取軍事行動，並敦促德黑蘭接受談判，說法與他本月稍早稱期中選舉前不攻擊伊朗不同。
西德州原油期貨突破每桶100美元，布蘭特原油則逼近117美元，創4月以來最高收盤價，重新挑起市場對通膨的擔憂。在聯準會 (Fed) 即將公布利率決策之際，讓市場更加關注能源成本對通膨的影響。
美債市場方面，投資人週四因 AI 資料中心龐大融資需求及科技業借貸風險而轉向避險，帶動10年期美債殖利率一個月來首度跌破5%。
不過，隨著週五油價走高，美債回吐前一天部分漲幅，10年期殖利率回升逾4個基點至約4.999%，重新逼近5%關卡。
美股週五 (23 日) 主要指數表現：
NYSE FANG+ 指數中的科技五大巨頭僅微軟收紅。Meta (META-US) 下跌 0.96%；蘋果 (AAPL-US) 下跌 0.14%；Alphabet (GOOGL-US) 下跌 1.24%；微軟 (MSFT-US) 上漲 0.66%；亞馬遜 (AMZN-US) 下跌 0.95%。
半導體個股漲跌不一。AMD (AMD-US) 上漲 1.74%；博通 (AVGO-US) 下跌 0.48%；輝達 (NVDA-US) 下跌 0.59%；應用材料 (AMAT-US) 上漲 0.44%；高通 (QCOM-US) 上漲 1.78%。
記憶體與儲存族群漲跌互見。美光 (MU-US) 上漲 2.46%；威騰電子 (WDC-US) 下跌 2.97%；SanDisk (SNDK-US) 下跌 1.82%；希捷 (STX-US) 下跌 1.81%；SK 海力士 ADR (SKHY-US) 上漲 4.05%。
台股 ADR 漲多跌少。台積電 ADR (TSM-US) 上漲 1.49%；日月光 ADR (ASX-US) 上漲 2.52%；聯電 ADR (UMC-US) 上漲 1.94%；中華電信 ADR (CHT-US) 下跌 0.43%。
企業新聞
美國運通 (AXP-US) 急跌 3.62% 至每股 313.22 美元，成為拖累道瓊的個股之一。公司宣布將裁減全球約5%人力，理由包括因應AI發展及控制成本上升。開拓重工 (CAT-US) 下跌約2%，高盛 (GS-US) 跌逾1%，進一步加重道瓊壓力。
蘋果 (AAPL-US) 收黑0.14% 至每股 347.72 美元，週線收高1.83%，新款摺疊手機iPhone Duo上市後，有限的門市現貨迅速售罄，顯示這款起價接近2,000美元的裝置吸引買氣。
SpaceX正尋求在全美取得至少8萬處基地台站點，並已與至少一家大型行動通訊基礎設施業者洽談，持續推進地面通訊網路布局。SpaceX (SPCX-US) 揚升 1.89% 至每股 147.49 美元，週跌1.16%。
美國銀行將ServiceNow (NOW-US) 目標價調高至180美元，維持「買進」評等，理由是AI產品需求增加，可望支持營收持續成長。公司預計於10月28日公布第三季財報。ServiceNow 收高 1.25% 至每股 158.96 美元。
華爾街分析
Argent Capital Management投資組合經理Jed Ellerbroek表示，過去兩週投資人持續從科技股及資料中心受惠股轉向防禦性標的，但這股輪動終究會耗盡動能，週五盤勢正反映這種情況。
他認為，近期部分科技業者公布的財報表現良好，提供投資人重新評估科技股的理由，市場不必完全受避險情緒主導。
美國銀行策略師Michael Hartnett則維持審慎立場，預期AI交易疑慮與美國期中選舉的不確定性，將使避險情緒延續至11月中旬。他預期，美債殖利率、股市及美元可能同步走低。
瑞銀投資總監辦公室的Ulrike Hoffmann-Burchardi看法相對正面，認為企業獲利仍有望支撐股市，AI需求也依然強勁，單憑地緣政治發展，尚不足以支持全面轉向防禦性配置。
PIMCO經濟學家Tiffany Wilding指出，AI正在提振美國需求，而多項通膨指標仍高於目標，Fed透過適度調整利率及收緊金融情勢來因應具有合理性。不過，目前通膨雖偏高，尚未持續加速，應能讓Fed保有循序調整政策的空間。

paras_en: Middle‑East tensions reignited, pushing oil prices higher. US equities on Friday (the 23rd) mostly closed lower, with selling spreading from tech stocks the previous day to defensive sectors such as consumer staples, utilities and healthcare. The Dow plunged about 653 points, marking its biggest single‑day drop in two months. The S&P 500 fell 0.52%, while the Nasdaq’s decline narrowed to 0.21% thanks to a rebound in some chip stocks. The Philadelphia Semiconductor Index edged up 0.44%.

The market has recently been affected by a cooling off in AI‑driven trading, the risk of an expanding Middle‑East conflict, and volatile US Treasury movements, leading to a clear sector rotation. On Friday, selling pressure further extended into defensive groups like consumer staples, utilities and healthcare, but over the full week the major indices showed mixed gains and losses, indicating continued internal divergence.

For the week to date, the Dow was up 0.4%, the S&P 500 down 0.5%, the Nasdaq down 0.7%, and the Philly Semiconductor Index’s weekly chart turned black with a 3.21% decline, marking three straight weeks of losses—the longest streak since November last year.

The Middle‑East situation was the main source of pressure on Friday’s market. The US and Israel may be planning a new wave of attacks on Iran, and Iran says it is ready to retaliate, reviving concerns about oil‑supply disruptions.

Former US President Donald Trump said the United States might take further military action against Iran and urged Tehran to come to the negotiating table, a stance that differs from his earlier comment this month that the US would not attack Iran before the midterm elections.

West Texas Intermediate crude futures broke the $100‑per‑barrel barrier, while Brent crude edged toward $117, its highest close since April, rekindling market worries about inflation. With the Federal Reserve about to announce its rate decision, attention is focused on how energy costs could feed price pressures.

In the US Treasury market, investors on Thursday shifted to safety amid massive financing needs for AI data centers and credit risk in the tech sector, pushing the 10‑year Treasury yield below 5% for the first time in a month.

However, as oil prices rose on Friday, US Treasuries gave back some of the previous day’s gains; the 10‑year yield climbed more than four basis points to about 4.999%, once again edging toward the 5% threshold.
US equity performance on Friday (the 23rd):

Dow Jones Industrial Average down 652.82 points, or 1.23%, to 52,215.16. Nasdaq Composite down 53.52 points, or 0.21%, to 25,955.34. S&P 500 down 39.75 points, or 0.52%, to 7,623.68. Philadelphia Semiconductor Index up 47.49 points, or 0.44%, to 10,779.46. NYSE FANG+ Index down 46.66 points, or 0.26%, to 18,213.46.

Among the five big‑tech stocks in the NYSE FANG+ Index, only Microsoft posted a gain. Meta (META‑US) fell 0.96%; Apple (AAPL‑US) slipped 0.14%; Alphabet (GOOGL‑US) dropped 1.24%; Microsoft (MSFT‑US) rose 0.66%; Amazon (AMZN‑US) declined 0.95%.
Semiconductor stocks were mixed. AMD (AMD‑US) up 1.74%; Broadcom (AVGO‑US) down 0.48%; Nvidia (NVDA‑US) down 0.59%; Applied Materials (AMAT‑US) up 0.44%; Qualcomm (QCOM‑US) up 1.78%.

Memory and storage stocks showed both gains and losses. Micron (MU‑US) up 2.46%; Western Digital (WDC‑US) down 2.97%; SanDisk (SNDK‑US) down 1.82%; Seagate (STX‑US) down 1.81%; SK Hynix ADR (SKHY‑US) up 4.05%.
Taiwan ADRs rose more than they fell. TSMC ADR (TSM‑US) up 1.49%; ASE Technology ADR (ASX‑US) up 2.52%; UMC ADR (UMC‑US) up 1.94%; Chunghwa Telecom ADR (CHT‑US) down 0.43%.
Corporate news

American Express (AXP‑US) plunged 3.62% to $313.22, becoming one of the Dow‑dragging stocks. The company announced a global workforce reduction of about 5%, citing AI development and rising cost pressures. Caterpillar (CAT‑US) fell roughly 2%, and Goldman Sachs (GS‑US) dropped over 1%, adding further pressure to the Dow.

Apple (AAPL‑US) closed down 0.14% at $347.72, up 1.83% on the weekly chart. After the launch of the new foldable iPhone Duo, limited in‑store inventory sold out quickly, indicating strong demand for the device priced near $2,000.

SpaceX is seeking to secure at least 80,000 ground‑station sites across the United States and has been in talks with at least one major mobile‑network infrastructure provider to continue expanding its terrestrial communications network. SpaceX (SPCX‑US) rose 1.89% to $147.49, though it fell 1.16% for the week.

Bank of America raised ServiceNow’s (NOW‑US) target price to $180 and kept a “Buy” rating, citing growing AI product demand that should sustain revenue growth. The company is slated to report its Q3 results on October 28. ServiceNow gained 1.25% to $158.96.
Wall Street commentary

Jed Ellerbroek, portfolio manager at Argent Capital Management, said that over the past two weeks investors have been rotating from tech and data‑center beneficiaries into defensive assets, but that this rotation will eventually run out of steam, and Friday’s market action reflected that dynamic.
He added that recent solid earnings from some tech companies give investors reason to reassess tech stocks, and the market does not have to be dominated entirely by risk‑off sentiment.

Bank of America strategist Michael Hartnett remains cautious, expecting that concerns over AI‑driven trading and uncertainty surrounding the US midterm elections will keep risk‑off sentiment alive into mid‑November. He forecasts that Treasury yields, equities and the dollar could all move lower together.

Ulrike Hoffmann‑Burchardi of UBS’s Investment Management Office took a relatively upbeat view, believing corporate earnings can still support the market and AI demand remains strong; geopolitical developments alone are not enough to justify a full shift to defensive positioning.

Tiffany Wilding, economist at PIMCO, noted that AI is boosting US demand while many inflation gauges remain above target. She said the Fed’s modest rate adjustments and tighter financial conditions are a reasonable response. Although inflation is still elevated, it has not accelerated further, giving the Fed room to adjust policy gradually.

items.title: 川普再提對伊朗動武：可能再來一次「史詩怒火」行動
items.title_en: Trump Again Calls for Military Action Against Iran: Possible Repeat of “Operation Epic Fury”
paras: 美國總統川普週五 (23 日) 表示，美國可能再次對伊朗採取軍事行動，並敦促德黑蘭接受談判解決衝突。這番言論與他本月稍早表示期中選舉前不會攻擊伊朗的說法形成落差。隨著戰事即將滿 8 個月，燃料價格上漲也成為美國期中選舉的重要壓力。
川普當天在佛羅里達州麥爾茲堡 (Fort Myers) 的造勢活動上談及伊朗戰爭時表示：「我們可能再來一次小規模的『史詩怒火』(Operation Epic Fury) 行動，或者他們會同意。」史詩怒火是美軍對伊朗作戰使用的行動代號。
他並未進一步說明可能採取的行動規模、時間或目標。
川普在演說中聲稱，美軍先前透過「午夜之鎚」(Operation Midnight Hammer) 行動摧毀伊朗的鈾濃縮能力，再以「史詩怒火」行動進一步打擊其核能力。
川普接著向伊朗喊話：「如果他們夠聰明，就會說：『我們來認真談吧。』」
不過，他隨即表示，自己懷疑伊朗會採取這種做法。
川普週五稍早才表示，美國有能力迅速結束戰爭，但他仍在思考華府究竟應尋求快速終結衝突，還是讓戰事逐步平息。
他本月稍早則曾表示，美國不會在期中選舉前對伊朗發動攻擊，凸顯其對戰爭時程與下一步行動的說法仍有變動。
這場自 2 月下旬爆發的戰爭，至今仍未正式落幕。儘管各方曾達成停火安排，並簽署旨在敲定和平協議的諒解備忘錄，最終協議仍未完成。
美國與以色列對伊朗的攻擊，以及以色列對黎巴嫩的軍事行動，已造成數千人死亡、數百萬人流離失所。
伊朗方面則持續釋出強硬訊號。
伊朗革命衛隊政治局負責人Yadollah Javani 警告，若敵方發動地面入侵，伊朗將成為入侵外國部隊的葬身之地。他聲稱，美軍在區域內的基地與行動已面臨限制，難以進入陌生領土並維持長期駐軍。
與此同時，埃及、沙烏地阿拉伯、土耳其與巴基斯坦外長在伊斯坦堡會談後發表聯合聲明，強調應透過對話與外交處理美以對伊朗戰爭，並呼籲全面恢復荷姆茲海峽的安全通航，反對限制合法航行的措施。
中東供應風險升溫，國際油價週五 (23 日) 大幅收高。布蘭特原油期貨上漲 3.55 美元，或 3.14%，收每桶 116.72 美元，創 4 月 29 日以來最高收盤價。
西德州原油期貨上漲 3.80 美元，或 3.8%，收每桶 103.27 美元。全週布蘭特與西德州原油分別上漲 6% 及 2.3%。
葉門胡塞武裝接連攻擊沙烏地阿拉伯，包括能源基礎設施，加上阿拉伯聯合大公國外海傳出油輪漏油事件，加深市場對中東能源供應中斷的疑慮，成為推升油價的主要因素。
paras_en: U.S. President Donald Trump said on Friday (the 23rd) that the United States may once again take military action against Iran and urged Tehran to accept negotiations to resolve the conflict. This statement contrasts with his earlier comment this month that the U.S. would not attack Iran before the midterm elections. As the war approaches its eighth month, rising fuel prices have become a major pressure point for the U.S. midterms.

Speaking at a rally in Fort Myers, Florida, Trump said regarding the Iran war, "We may do a small‑scale repeat of ‘Operation Epic Fury,’ or they will agree." Epic Fury is the code name the U.S. military uses for operations against Iran.
He did not elaborate on the possible scale, timing or targets of any such action.

In his speech, Trump claimed that U.S. forces had previously destroyed Iran’s uranium enrichment capability through an operation called “Midnight Hammer,” and would follow up with “Epic Fury” to further strike its nuclear capacity.
Trump then addressed Iran directly: "If they’re smart enough, they’ll say, ‘Let’s talk seriously.’"
He quickly added that he doubted Iran would take that approach.

Earlier on Friday, Trump said the United States has the ability to end the war quickly, but he is still weighing whether Washington should seek a rapid termination of the conflict or let the fighting wind down gradually.

He had earlier this month said the United States would not launch an attack on Iran before the midterm elections, highlighting that his statements on the war’s timeline and next steps have been shifting.

The war that erupted in late February remains officially unresolved. Although cease‑fire arrangements were reached and a memorandum of understanding aimed at finalising a peace deal was signed, a definitive agreement has yet to be completed.
U.S. and Israeli attacks on Iran, as well as Israeli military actions in Lebanon, have already caused thousands of deaths and displaced millions.
Iran continues to issue hard‑line signals.

Yadollah Javani, a senior official of the Iranian Revolutionary Guard’s political bureau, warned that if the enemy launches a ground invasion, Iran will become a graveyard for invading foreign forces. He claimed U.S. bases and operations in the region are now constrained, making it difficult for American troops to enter unfamiliar territory and maintain a long‑term presence.

Meanwhile, foreign ministers from Egypt, Saudi Arabia, Turkey and Pakistan, after meeting in Istanbul, issued a joint statement emphasizing that the U.S.–Israel war with Iran should be handled through dialogue and diplomacy, calling for the full restoration of safe navigation through the Hormuz Strait and opposing measures that restrict legitimate shipping.

Middle‑East supply risks are heating up, and international oil prices surged sharply on Friday (the 23rd). Brent crude futures rose $3.55, or 3.14%, closing at $116.72 a barrel, the highest close since April 29.
West Texas Intermediate crude rose $3.80, or 3.8%, to $103.27 a barrel. Over the week, Brent and WTI gained 6% and 2.3% respectively.

Yemen’s Houthi forces have repeatedly attacked Saudi Arabia, including energy infrastructure, and an offshore oil‑spill incident off the United Arab Emirates has heightened market concerns about Middle‑East energy supply disruptions, becoming a key driver behind the rise in oil prices.

items.title: 「大賣空」貝瑞：美股結構愈來愈像網路泡沫化那年 但美政府幾乎無力對抗下場危機
items.title_en: "The Big Short" Michael Burry: US Stock Market Structure Is Becoming More Like the 2000 Dot‑Com Bubble, Yet the US Government Is Almost Powerless to Counter the Resulting Crisis
paras: 電影《大賣空》(The Big Short)原型人物、曾成功預判2008年美國房市泡沫聞名的知名華爾街空頭麥可·貝瑞(Michael Burry)再度對金融市場發出警告，指出美國政府過去不斷以危機為由放寬財政紀律，累積大量債務，如今面對下一次金融危機時，能夠動用的政策空間可能已所剩不多。
與此同時，標普500指數雖然持續創下歷史新高，成分股的實際表現卻明顯分化，市場上漲動能集中於少數股票，部分內部指標更呈現與2000年科技泡沫高峰相似的特徵。
貝瑞在個人Substack電子報《Cassandra Unchained》發文指出，政府過去藉由真正發生的危機作為放棄財政審慎原則的理由，危機過後卻未恢復原有紀律，最終使政府在面對下一次市場崩跌時，缺乏足夠的財政能力支撐市場。他認為，當前私人信貸市場已存在泡沫，一旦泡沫破裂，華府可能難以像過去一樣迅速出手救市。
貝瑞將政府在持續增加債務的同時，又一再縮短市場自然修復過程的做法形容為「不可原諒」，並警告相關後果終將浮現，甚至可能已經開始發生。
貝瑞的疑慮不只來自政府債務，也與美股市場內部的結構性弱點有關。他透過數十年來的標普500指數成分股歷史資料，建立衡量市場下跌廣度的指標，觀察有多少成分股已較過去10年高點下跌逾20%，並將其稱為熊市比率 (Bear Market Ratio)。
追蹤標普500指數表現的SPDR標普500 ETF (SPY-US) 於10月6日收在歷史新高時，貝瑞計算的熊市比率已達55%，遠高於8月13日指數前一次創高時的47%。這代表即使大盤指數持續刷新紀錄，超過半數成分股的股價實際上已較各自過去10年的高點下跌逾20%。
回顧過去40年，只有一次標普500指數創高時的市場廣度比目前更差。2000年3月科技泡沫達到高峰時，有71.2%的指數成分股已進入各自的熊市區間。相較之下，自1985年以來，一般市場高點出現時，熊市比率通常約為20%至31%。
其他市場廣度指標也顯示，上漲動能並未廣泛擴散。10月6日標普500指數創下歷史新高當天，僅有15檔成分股同步收在自身歷史新高，只有97檔股票的股價位於各自高點下方10%以內。
2000年3月科技泡沫高峰時，同樣只有15檔成分股同步創高，但有87檔股票距離自身高點不到10%。目前與當年相似之處，在於大盤指數雖然處於高檔，能夠同步參與上漲的股票數量卻相當有限。
此外，目前標普500成分股的股價中位數，較各自高點低22%；2000年科技泡沫高峰時，這項差距更達31%。這反映出指數整體表現與多數個股的實際狀況之間，存在明顯落差。
為了排除部分股票仍受多年以前高點影響的情況，貝瑞另外建立「新近回落比率」(Fresh Drawdown Ratio)，用來觀察近期市場下跌的廣度。過去一般市場高點出現時，該指標通常介於6%至13%，目前則升至27%，約為2000年科技泡沫高峰時的一半。
綜合這些指標，貝瑞認為，當前市場的內部結構比2000年以來任何時期都更接近當年的科技泡沫高峰，但仍未達到2000年的極端程度。
不過，貝瑞並未將基本情境設定為市場立即出現單日或短期全面崩盤。他預期，市場更可能經歷一段緩慢下滑的過程，期間可能出現劇烈震盪，先前領漲的股票逐漸走弱，而已經大幅下跌的中位數股票反而可能上漲。這種指數下跌、部分落後股回升的走勢，曾在2000年科技泡沫破裂後出現。
他認為，隨著企業基本面利空逐步浮現，市場可能開始重新評估人工智慧投資熱潮的合理性，相關風險也會逐漸反映在股價上。即使美國市場的危機應對機制過去曾成功處理突然發生的拋售潮，當市場同時面臨基本面惡化、技術面轉弱及上漲參與度下降時，處理難度也會明顯提高。
貝瑞近期持續質疑大型科技企業在AI領域的資本支出。他先前指出，除了蘋果 (Apple) (AAPL-US) 以外，其他大型科技企業的投資規模，彷彿企業生存完全取決於這場AI競賽能否成功。他認為，當市場對AI成長前景的預期過高，一旦實際獲利、需求或投資回報不如預期，原本支撐股價的樂觀情緒便可能迅速逆轉。
目前的關鍵在於，美國政府能否在下一次重大金融或債務危機發生時，提供足夠的政策支持。若政府債務負擔持續增加，財政刺激與市場救援的能力可能受到限制；另一方面，如果股市上漲主要由少數大型企業帶動，市場整體的脆弱性也可能被指數創高的表象掩蓋。
貝瑞的分析並不代表市場必然重演2000年科技泡沫崩盤，也沒有提出確切的崩跌日期或目標價。不過，他透過市場廣度、個股回落幅度及政府財政能力等不同角度提出警訊，認為投資人不應只看標普500指數是否創高，更應留意有多少成分股真正參與上漲，以及政府在下一次危機來臨時還剩下多少應對空間。
paras_en: Michael Burry, the Wall Street short‑seller whose story inspired the film "The Big Short" and who famously predicted the 2008 US housing bubble, has again warned about the financial markets, saying that the US government has repeatedly relaxed fiscal discipline under the pretext of crises, amassing huge debt, and now has little policy space left for the next financial shock.

At the same time, although the S&P 500 continues to hit all‑time highs, the actual performance of its component stocks is sharply divided, with upward momentum concentrated in a few stocks and some internal indicators showing patterns similar to the peak of the 2000 tech bubble.

In a post on his personal Substack newsletter "Cassandra Unchained," Burry noted that the government has used real crises as an excuse to abandon fiscal prudence, failed to restore discipline after the crises, and thus lacks sufficient fiscal capacity to support the market when the next crash hits. He believes a bubble already exists in the private‑credit market, and if it bursts Washington may not be able to intervene as quickly as before.

Burry described the government’s habit of continuously adding debt while repeatedly shortening the market’s natural healing process as "unforgivable," warning that the resulting consequences will eventually surface, and may already be unfolding.

Burry’s concerns stem not only from government debt but also from structural weaknesses inside the US equity market. Using decades of historical data on S&P 500 constituents, he created a metric that measures the breadth of market declines, counting how many components have fallen more than 20% from their 10‑year highs, which he calls the Bear Market Ratio.

When the SPDR S&P 500 ETF (SPY‑US) closed at a record high on October 6, Burry’s Bear Market Ratio was already 55%, up from 47% when the index last peaked on August 13. That means that even as the index keeps breaking records, more than half of its stocks are trading at least 20% below their own 10‑year peaks.

Looking back over the past 40 years, there has been only one instance when market breadth was worse at an S&P 500 peak than it is today. At the March 2000 tech‑bubble peak, 71.2% of the index’s components were already in their own bear zones. By contrast, since 1985, typical market highs have seen a Bear Market Ratio of about 20%‑31%.

Other breadth indicators also show that upward momentum is not broadly distributed. On the day the S&P 500 hit a record high on October 6, only 15 components closed at their own all‑time highs, and merely 97 stocks were within 10% of their individual peaks.

At the March 2000 tech‑bubble peak, the same 15 components hit new highs, but 87 stocks were within 10% of their own peaks. The similarity today is that, despite a high index level, only a limited number of stocks are participating in the rally.

Furthermore, the median price of current S&P 500 constituents is 22% below their individual peaks, compared with a 31% gap at the 2000 tech‑bubble peak, highlighting a clear divergence between the index’s headline performance and most individual stocks.

To filter out stocks still anchored to much older highs, Burry also created a "Fresh Drawdown Ratio" to gauge recent market‑wide declines. Historically, this metric has ranged from 6% to 13% at typical market peaks; it is now up to 27%, roughly half of the level seen at the 2000 tech‑bubble peak.

Putting these metrics together, Burry argues that today’s market structure is closer than any time since 2000 to the conditions at the tech‑bubble peak, though it has not yet reached the extreme levels of 2000.

However, Burry does not assume an immediate, single‑day or short‑term market collapse. He expects a slower, drawn‑out decline that may feature sharp volatility, with former leaders losing steam while the heavily‑depressed median stocks could actually rise—a pattern that occurred after the 2000 tech‑bubble burst.

He believes that as corporate fundamentals turn negative, the market will begin to reassess the rationality of the AI investment frenzy, and related risks will start to be priced in. Even though US crisis‑management mechanisms have previously handled sudden sell‑offs, the combination of deteriorating fundamentals, weakening technicals, and reduced participation in the rally will make mitigation considerably harder.

Burry has recently questioned the scale of AI‑related capital spending by large tech firms. Aside from Apple (AAPL‑US), he says the investment size of other big tech companies suggests their survival seems tied to winning the AI race. He warns that if AI growth expectations are overstated and actual profits, demand, or returns fall short, the optimism that has buoyed stock prices could reverse quickly.

The key now is whether the US government can provide sufficient policy support when the next major financial or debt crisis hits. If debt burdens keep rising, fiscal stimulus and market rescue capacity may be constrained; conversely, if the rally is driven mainly by a few mega‑caps, the overall market’s fragility could be masked by the index’s new highs.

Burry’s analysis does not claim the market will inevitably repeat the 2000 tech‑bubble crash, nor does it give a specific crash date or target level. Nonetheless, by highlighting market breadth, individual stock drawdowns, and government fiscal capacity, he warns investors to look beyond whether the S&P 500 is at a record and pay attention to how many components truly join the rise and how much policy room remains for the next crisis.

items.title: 營收僅增1%、資本支出砍46%！加拿大電信商Rogers不拚擴張，改拚現金流
items.title_en: Revenue Up Only 1%, Capital Expenditure Slashed 46%: Canadian Telco Rogers Shifts Focus from Expansion to Cash Flow
paras: 2026年10月24日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 加拿大電信商Rogers Communications(RCI-US)公布2026年第三季財報，資本支出降至5.24億加元，年減46%；自由現金流年增65%至13.7億加元。同期服務營收與調整後EBITDA均僅年增1%，現金流改善主要來自資本支出及現金稅款減少。
本業營收持續承壓。第三季行動通訊服務營收年減1%，每用戶平均營收下滑2.6%。公司指出，電信本業面臨價格與監管壓力。
管理層在法說會表示，除延後既有專案，也取消或出售不再優先投入的建設，以降低後續資金需求。投資重點由全面擴張，轉向提升既有網路效能與回報。
網路升級仍持續進行。Rogers持續投入5G與光纖到府，既有有線寬頻網路推進DOCSIS 3.1升級、朝4.0演進，並調整頻寬配置以提升上傳速度。
資本支出降幅也受資產出售影響。依公司計算方式，資本支出為新增設備與建設支出，扣除資產出售款及政府補助後的金額。第三季Rogers出售無線網路資產、施工中的偏鄉光纖專案及不動產，分別取得1.33億、0.86億及0.55億加元，合計2.74億加元，去年同期僅0.13億加元。帳面資本支出降幅，因此大於實際建設支出的縮減幅度。
財測方面，公司維持2026年資本支出25億至27億加元，此區間已於4月下修，本季底再調降。財務長Glenn Brandt表示，此水準可作為2027年以後投資方向的參考，公司尚未發布2027年財測，也不打算以持續出售資產達成預算。

paras_en: October 24, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center) – Rogers Communications (RCI‑US) reported its Q3 2026 results, with capital expenditures falling to C$524 million, a 46% year‑over‑year decline, and free cash flow rising 65% year‑over‑year to C$1.37 billion. Both service revenue and adjusted EBITDA grew just 1% year‑over‑year, with the cash‑flow improvement driven mainly by lower capex and reduced cash taxes.

Core revenue remains under pressure. Q3 mobile service revenue fell 1% year‑over‑year, and average revenue per user dropped 2.6%. The company said the telecom business faces pricing and regulatory pressures.

Management said at the earnings call that, besides postponing existing projects, it is cancelling or selling constructions that are no longer a priority to reduce future funding needs. Investment focus is shifting from broad expansion to improving the performance and returns of the existing network.

Network upgrades continue. Rogers is still investing in 5G and fiber‑to‑the‑home, advancing its existing wired broadband network with a DOCSIS 3.1 upgrade moving toward 4.0, and re‑allocating bandwidth to boost upload speeds.

The capex decline is also affected by asset sales. Under the company’s definition, capital expenditures equal new equipment and construction spending, net of proceeds from asset sales and government subsidies. In Q3 Rogers sold wireless network assets, a rural fiber project under construction, and real estate, receiving C$133 million, C$86 million and C$55 million respectively—a total of C$274 million, versus only C$13 million in the same quarter last year. The reported capex drop therefore exceeds the actual reduction in construction spending.

Regarding guidance, the company maintains its 2026 capex outlook at C$2.5‑2.7 billion, a range that was already trimmed in April and will be lowered again at the end of this quarter. CFO Glenn Brandt said this level can serve as a reference for investment direction after 2027; the firm has not issued 2027 guidance and does not plan to meet the budget by continuously selling assets.

items.title: 資料中心機電工程需求強，Comfort Systems擴大2027年模組化廠房規模
items.title_en: Strong Demand for Data Center MEP Engineering Drives Comfort Systems to Expand Modular Plant Size for 2027
paras: 2026年10月24日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 美國機電工程承包商Comfort Systems USA(FIX-US)在第三季法說會表示，預計2027年底模組化業務廠房面積將達約600萬平方呎，高於2026年底逾400萬平方呎的規模。公司同時預估，2027年既有業務營收將成長約25%，毛利率可望維持近幾季的強勁水準。

這波擴張背後，是資料中心客戶提前鎖定施工與製造能力。Comfort Systems承作空調、管線與電氣工程，也在工廠預製模組化冷卻設施與熱通道封閉系統，再送往客戶場址。管理層指出，客戶因施工能力稀缺而更早承諾、更大範圍的工程；目前限制接單的主要因素不是需求，而是能否調度足夠技術人力。第三季底在手訂單達178.1億美元，較第二季底140.6億美元增加約27%，年增約90%；大型專案使訂單執行期間延長至約18至24個月。
模組化業務前九月占營收17%。管理層說明，2027年底的擴廠規畫主要依據既有客戶合作安排，這類合作通常包含五年採購量承諾，公司才投入大額資本支出建置廠房。公司已為新的前沿AI實驗室與資料中心代管業者製作產品，但尚未建立相同形式的長期量產合作；是否擴大承接，仍取決於採購承諾、付款時點與客戶財務能力。
第三季營收37.66億美元，年增53.7%；淨利4.89億美元，年增67.7%，每股稀釋盈餘13.91美元。毛利率24.8%，與去年同期持平，營業利益率則由15.5%升至16.6%。公司指出，當季設備與材料占成本比重較高，雖推升營收，卻拉低季比毛利率；部分大型工程也仍處於初期，公司會保留成本預備額，待施工進度提高、剩餘成本更明確後才認列較多利潤。
為支應需求，Comfort Systems預估2026年資本支出占營收4%至5%，2027年上半年仍將維持較高投入。除了模組化擴廠，公司也已投入逾1億美元擴充傳統工程的預製設施。管理層強調，承接每筆工程前都會先確認人力計畫；在手訂單能否轉為營收與獲利，仍取決於擴廠、人員配置與專案執行進度。

paras_en: On October 24, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center report) – U.S. MEP contractor Comfort Systems USA (FIX-US) said at its third‑quarter earnings call that it expects the modular‑business plant area to reach about 6 million square feet by the end of 2027, up from more than 4 million square feet at the end of 2026. The company also forecasts existing‑business revenue to grow roughly 25% in 2027, with gross margin expected to stay near the strong levels seen in recent quarters.

The expansion is driven by data‑center customers locking in construction and manufacturing capacity early. Comfort Systems provides HVAC, piping and electrical work and also prefabricates modular cooling equipment and enclosed hot‑aisle systems in its factories before shipping them to customer sites. Management noted that because construction capacity is scarce, customers are committing earlier and for larger scopes; the main constraint on new orders is not demand but the ability to mobilize enough skilled labor. Backlog at the end of Q3 was $17.81 billion, up about 27% from $14.06 billion at the end of Q2, roughly a 90% year‑over‑year increase, with large projects extending execution periods to about 18‑24 months.

Modular business accounted for 17% of revenue in the first nine months. Management explained that the 2027 plant‑expansion plan is based primarily on existing customer collaboration agreements, which typically include a five‑year purchase‑volume commitment before the company makes a large capital investment in a new plant. The firm has already produced products for a new frontier AI lab and a data‑center colocation provider, but has not yet established the same type of long‑term mass‑production partnership; any further expansion will depend on purchase commitments, payment timing and the customers’ financial strength.

Third‑quarter revenue was $3.766 billion, up 53.7% year‑over‑year; net income was $489 million, up 67.7%, and diluted earnings per share were $13.91. Gross margin was 24.8%, flat versus the prior year, while operating margin rose from 15.5% to 16.6%. The company noted that equipment and material costs made up a larger share of expenses this quarter, boosting revenue but pulling down quarterly gross margin; some large projects are still in early stages, so the firm is retaining cost reserves and will recognize more profit as construction progresses and remaining costs become clearer.

To meet demand, Comfort Systems estimates capital expenditures will represent 4%‑5% of revenue in 2026, with similarly high spending in the first half of 2027. In addition to the modular expansion, the company has already invested over $100 million to expand prefabrication facilities for its traditional engineering business. Management emphasized that each project is vetted for labor plans before acceptance; whether backlog converts to revenue and profit still depends on plant expansion, staffing and project execution progress.

items.title: 〈紐約匯市〉美元上漲 日元因AI股重挫轉強 法國債務疑慮拖累歐元
items.title_en: New York FX Market: Dollar Rises, Yen Gains After AI Stock Plunge, French Debt Concerns Drag Euro
paras: 美元周五(23日)小幅上漲，美元指數本週變動不大。歐元則受法國政府公債遭拋售影響走低，法國債務風險溢酬升至2011年歐元區主權債務危機以來最高水準，歐元兌美元與日元均以週線收黑作收。日元受惠於週四AI概念股遭拋售引發的避險資金流入，兌美元本週上漲。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)上漲0.25%，報101.82，本週上漲約0.03%。
市場對法國國內動盪加劇及預算問題惡化的憂慮，持續打擊歐元。法國內政部長Laurent Nuñez表示，法國將於週六部署7萬名警察，並由特種警力支援，以因應抗議活動。此外，穆迪（Moody’s）也可能於週五調降法國的信用評等。
Bannockburn Global Forex 首席市場策略師 Marc Chandler 表示，「今天歐洲債券市場的壓力已有所緩解，但穆迪稍晚對法國債務評等的檢視仍是一項挑戰。儘管馬克宏政府已威脅動用軍事力量平息社會動盪，但週末可能仍會有更多活動發生。」
歐元兌美元下跌0.21%，至1.1191美元，本週下跌約0.43%。
歐元兌日元跌幅更大，一度觸及175.08日圓，創2025年10月以來最低。歐元兌日元下跌0.11%，本週跌約1.1%。
日元兌美元下跌0.1%，至156.9日元，但本週上漲約0.7%，創下9月中旬以來最佳單週表現。
三菱日聯金融集團（MUFG）資深外匯分析師 Lee Hardman 表示，「隨著本週尾聲的避險交易氣氛升溫，日元持續維持在較強勢水準。」
央行政策會議成市場焦點
交易員正關注下週美國聯準會（Fed）、歐洲央行（ECB）及日本銀行（BoJ）的政策會議。市場預期三家央行都將維持利率不變，但投資人將尋找未來貨幣政策走向的線索。
根據倫敦證券交易所集團（LSEG）數據，週四股市遭拋售後，聯邦基金利率期貨交易員下調了對聯準會12月升息的押注，但市場仍認為升息機率達81%。
交易員目前預估，歐洲央行12月升息的機率為66%。投資人將仔細檢視任何有關利率前景的訊號。歐洲央行總裁拉加德（Christine Lagarde）9月底曾表示，面對通膨，採取適度的政策反應是合適的。

The euro fell as French government bonds were sold off, pushing France's sovereign debt risk premium to its highest level since the Euro‑area crisis of 2011. Both the euro‑dollar and euro‑yen pairs closed the week in the red. The yen benefited from a flight‑to‑safety flow triggered by Thursday’s sell‑off in AI‑related stocks, rising against the dollar over the week.

French Interior Minister Laurent Nuñez said France will deploy 70,000 police officers, supported by special forces, on Saturday to address protests. Moody’s also may downgrade France’s credit rating on Friday.

Marc Chandler, chief market strategist at Bannockburn Global Forex, said, “The pressure on European bond markets has eased today, but Moody’s later review of France’s debt rating remains a challenge. Although the Macron government has threatened to use force to quell social unrest, more activity could still occur over the weekend.”
The euro fell 0.21% against the dollar to $1.1191, down about 0.43% for the week.
The euro‑yen pair slipped further, briefly hitting ¥175.08, the lowest since October 2025, down 0.11% and about 1.1% for the week.
The yen slipped 0.1% to ¥156.9 per dollar, but is up roughly 0.7% for the week, marking its best weekly performance since mid‑September.
Lee Hardman, senior FX analyst at MUFG, said, “With the hedge‑fund atmosphere heating up toward the end of the week, the yen remains firmly on the stronger side.”
Central‑bank policy meetings become market focus

Traders are watching next week’s policy meetings of the U.S. Federal Reserve, the European Central Bank and the Bank of Japan. Markets expect all three central banks to keep rates unchanged, but investors will look for clues on future monetary‑policy direction.

According to data from the London Stock Exchange Group, after Thursday’s equity sell‑off, Fed‑funds futures traders reduced bets on a December rate hike, yet the market still sees an 81% probability of a hike.

Traders currently estimate a 66% chance that the ECB will raise rates in December. Investors will scrutinise any signals about the rate outlook. ECB President Christine Lagarde said at the end of September that a measured policy response to inflation is appropriate.

Purchasing Managers’ Index (PMI) data showed that euro‑area private‑sector growth slowed in October to its weakest level in four months, mainly dragged down by a renewed contraction in French economic activity.

Citigroup economist Giada Giani said, “We think this data dip brings the PMI back in line with other growth indicators rather than signalling rising downside risk. France remains a drag, but the rest of the euro area continues to show resilience.”

In Japan, Friday’s data showed that September core CPI year‑over‑year finally exceeded the Bank of Japan’s 2% inflation target for the first time in nine months. Analysts said the figure indicates price pressure spreading to more sectors and bolsters the case for a near‑term rate hike by the BOJ.
