items.title: 美銀Hartnett示警避險潮延續至11月中 股市、美元、殖利率齊跌
items.title_en: Bank of America’s Hartnett Warns Hedge Wave Will Persist Into Mid‑November, Stocks, Dollar and Yields All Falling
paras: 美銀(BAC-US) 策略師Michael Hartnett預期，市場避險情緒可能延續至11月中旬，債券殖利率、股市與美元恐同步下跌。圍繞人工智慧（AI）交易及美國期中選舉的不安情緒，正壓抑股市表現，促使投資人轉向防禦性資產。
Hartnett週五在致客戶的報告中表示：「我們在戰術上維持避險立場至11月中旬。」他預期，市場將出現殖利率下跌、股市下跌及美元下跌的交易格局。
他指出，市場仍須充分反映民主黨同時取得眾議院與參議院控制權的可能性。在他看來，這樣的選舉結果將終結當前低稅、低監管的政策環境，不利企業獲利成長。
至於風險偏好何時可能回升，Hartnett認為，若歐洲央行或法國政府出手扭轉法國公債賣壓，可能成為訊號之一。
近期令市場不安的AI超大規模雲端服務商債券利差，也是一項觀察重點。他表示，若這些企業削減資本支出，或宣布「極大規模」的股權融資，使債券利差見頂，也可能緩解市場壓力。
儘管疑慮升溫，資金仍持續流入AI相關領域。美銀引述EPFR Global數據指出，科技股獲得7月以來最大單週資金流入。美銀本月公布的調查也顯示，全球投資人對科技股的曝險程度，升至2020年8月以來最高。
不過，最近幾天投資人也開始轉向防禦性資產，以因應油價上漲、融資成本攀升，以及AI交易可能逐漸泡沫化等風險。億萬富豪肯．格里芬（Ken Griffin）本週便警告，投資人「幾乎可以肯定」正身處AI泡沫之中。
資金轉向的跡象也反映在類股表現上。作為衡量市場廣度的指標，標普500等權重指數週四相對於市值加權的標普500指數，創下2024年以來最佳單日表現；防禦性較強的民生必需消費品類股，則可望締造1998年以來最佳單月表現。
paras_en: Bank of America (BAC-US) strategist Michael Hartnett expects the market’s hedging sentiment to continue into mid‑November, with bond yields, equities and the dollar likely to fall together. Anxiety surrounding AI‑driven trading and the U.S. midterm elections is suppressing stock performance and pushing investors toward defensive assets.

Hartnett wrote in a client note on Friday: “We will maintain a tactical hedging stance through mid‑November.” He anticipates a trading environment of falling yields, declining equities and a weaker dollar.

He noted that the market still needs to fully price in the possibility that Democrats could control both the House and the Senate. In his view, such an outcome would end the current low‑tax, low‑regulation policy regime, which is unfavorable for corporate profit growth.
As for when risk appetite might rebound, Hartnett sees a potential signal if the European Central Bank or the French government steps in to curb the selling pressure on French sovereign bonds.

Another focus is the widening credit spreads of ultra‑large AI cloud service providers, which have recently unsettled markets. He said that if these firms cut capital expenditures or announce “massive” equity financings that cap spreads, market pressure could ease.

Despite rising concerns, money continues to flow into AI‑related areas. Bank of America cites EPFR Global data showing the biggest weekly inflow into tech stocks since July, and its own survey this month indicating global investors’ exposure to tech stocks has risen to its highest level since August 2020.

However, in recent days investors have begun shifting toward defensive assets to hedge against rising oil prices, higher financing costs and the potential bubble in AI trading. Billionaire Ken Griffin warned this week that investors are “almost certainly” in an AI bubble.

The shift is also reflected in sector performance. As a breadth gauge, the equal‑weight S&P 500 posted its best single‑day performance this year on Thursday relative to the market‑cap‑weighted S&P 500, while defensive consumer‑staples stocks are on track for their strongest monthly gain since 1998.

items.title_en: <New York Forex> Dollar Flat, Yen Strengthens; Oil, AI and French Situation Stir Market Unease

歐元兌美元下跌0.09%，至1.1222美元。法國社會動盪的疑慮，以及該國財政前景惡化的問題，影響力超過了AI交易的擔憂，後者則拖累美國股市走低。

paras_en: The dollar was roughly flat on Thursday (the 22nd), while the yen is poised to record its biggest single‑day gain in about a month. Weak equity markets, lingering Middle‑East conflict pushing up oil prices, and growing doubts about the future returns on artificial‑intelligence (AI) investments have led investors to seek safe havens.

The euro fell 0.09% against the dollar to $1.1222. Concerns over social unrest in France and the country’s deteriorating fiscal outlook outweighed worries about AI‑driven trading, which has been dragging U.S. equities lower.
In the New York close, the dollar index (DXY), which tracks the greenback against six major currencies, slipped 0.08% to 101.60.
Chris Scicluna, head of economic research at Daiwa Capital Markets, said, “AI is unsettling, oil prices are too… the situation in France is equally worrisome.”
After a Houthi attack on Saudi Arabia, markets feared further supply disruptions in this key energy‑export region, pushing oil prices up about 3% to a five‑month high.
The yen rose 0.75% against the dollar to ¥156.96 per $1.

One reason for the yen’s strength may be its approach to the critical ¥160 level. Market participants think that once the yen nears ¥160, Japanese authorities are more likely to intervene in the forex market to support the currency.

Kevin Ford, chief FX and macro strategist at Convera, called this an “intervention premium” and noted, “Whenever the yen approaches the 160 barrier, speculation about central‑bank intervention heats up.”
On another traditional safe‑haven currency, the Swiss franc, the dollar fell 0.42% to 0.821 CHF per $1.

Erik Nelson, global FX strategy head at Wells Fargo, said, “There are competing market narratives and fragile points right now: on one side, U.S. AI‑related credit risk; on the other, France’s sovereign credit risk. In recent days these two factors have been tug‑of‑war, with one sometimes outweighing the other.”
He added, “As long as France’s risk is more concerning to the market than U.S. AI‑related credit risk, the euro will remain relatively weak.”

items.title: 菲律賓央行意外升息2碼 宣示對抗通膨與披索貶值決心
items.title_en: Philippine Central Bank Unexpectedly Raises Rate by 2 Points, Signaling Determination to Combat Inflation and Peso Depreciation
paras: 菲律賓央行(BSP)周四(22日)採取果斷行動，宣布將目標反向附買回利率調升2碼(0.5個百分點)至5.50%，以應對通膨擴大與披索匯率跌至歷史新低的雙重壓力，這項決策遠比市場預期更為激進。
媒體先前調查的25位經濟學家中，多達24位僅預估升息1碼，僅有1位準確預估升息2碼。央行在聲明中表示，價格壓力擴大需要「強烈」的回應，透過決斷的貨幣政策來遏制二次效應並錨定通膨預期，且已做好必要時採取進一步貨幣政策行動的準備。
自今年早些時候伊朗爆發衝突以來，儘管菲律賓經濟正經歷疫情以來最慢的成長步伐，央行已累計升息125個基點(5碼)。然而通膨前景未見顯著改善，9月消費者物價指數(CPI)年增率衝上7.2%，扭轉了連續4個月的放緩趨勢，使今年以來的平均通膨率達到5.4%，遠高於央行3%的目標。
此外，披索對美元匯率在上周跌破63關卡後續創新低，加劇了依賴進口能源與食品的進口通膨風險。央行維持今年通膨預測於6.1%，但將2027年預測由5.4%顯著調升至6.0%，預計要到2028年才會降至3.3%。
菲律賓央行總裁雷莫洛納(Eli Remolona)表示：「通膨預測比我們預想的還要糟糕，這讓我們感受到壓制通膨壓力的緊迫感。」
雷莫洛納指出，中東局勢升溫推升了國際油價與運輸票價，而未來最大的風險是嚴重的聖嬰現象乾旱可能衝擊農業生產。他同時對披索疲軟及其對進口通膨的影響表達憂慮，但明確表示央行不會耗盡外匯存底來捍衛特定的匯率關卡，並補充指出，在政府支出改善下，國內經濟預計於2027年第一季復甦。
做為唯一精準預測本次決策的專家，菲律賓群島銀行首席經濟學家Emilio Neri Jr.認為，這次大幅升息強化了菲律賓央行對抗通膨的信譽與決心。
不過，Pantheon Macroeconomics經濟學家Miguel Chanco提醒，12月會議是否進一步緊縮仍非定局。他說：「今日超出預期的調整，其動機可能是將今年最後一次會議中原本無爭議的25個基點升息提前實施。」
paras_en: The Philippine central bank (BSP) took decisive action on Thursday (the 22nd), announcing a 2‑point (0.5 percentage‑point) increase in its target reverse repurchase rate to 5.50% to address the dual pressures of widening inflation and the peso sliding to a historic low, a move far more aggressive than markets had expected.

Among the 25 economists surveyed by the media, 24 only forecast a 1‑point hike, with just one correctly predicting a 2‑point increase. In its statement, the bank said that expanding price pressures require a “strong” response, using decisive monetary policy to curb secondary effects and anchor inflation expectations, and it is ready to take further policy action if needed.

Since the outbreak of conflict in Iran earlier this year, even as the Philippine economy has been growing at its slowest pace since the pandemic, the central bank has cumulatively raised rates by 125 basis points (5 points). Yet the inflation outlook has not improved markedly; September’s consumer price index (CPI) rose 7.2% year‑on‑year, reversing four months of slowdown and pushing the year‑to‑date average inflation to 5.4%, well above the bank’s 3% target.

Moreover, after the peso fell below the 63 per‑dollar mark last week and set a new low, import‑driven inflation risks have intensified given the country’s reliance on imported energy and food. The bank kept its 2024 inflation forecast at 6.1% but lifted its 2027 projection sharply from 5.4% to 6.0%, expecting inflation to fall to 3.3% only by 2028.
BSP Governor Eli Remolona said, “The inflation outlook is worse than we anticipated, which makes us feel the urgency of suppressing inflation pressures.”

Remolona noted that heightened tensions in the Middle East have pushed up international oil prices and freight rates, and that the biggest future risk is a severe El Niño‑induced drought that could hit agricultural output. He also expressed concern over the weak peso and its impact on imported inflation, but made clear the bank will not deplete foreign‑exchange reserves to defend a specific exchange‑rate level, adding that, with improved government spending, the domestic economy is expected to recover in the first quarter of 2027.

As the only expert who accurately forecast the decision, Emilio Neri Jr., chief economist at the Bank of the Philippine Islands, said the sharp rate hike reinforces the BSP’s credibility and resolve in fighting inflation.

However, Pantheon Macroeconomics economist Miguel Chanco warned that whether the December meeting will tighten further remains uncertain. He said, “Today’s surprise adjustment may be motivated by moving forward the undisputed 25‑basis‑point hike that was slated for the last meeting of the year.”

items.title: 人工智慧疑慮再起 資金湧入美債、日元與瑞郎避險
items.title_en: AI Concerns Resurface, Funds Flood Into US Treasuries, Yen and Franc as Safe Havens
paras: 由於投資人對人工智慧(AI)交易的獲利前景疑慮再起，導致股市出現震盪，避險資金隨之湧入美國公債、日元及瑞士法郎等避險資產。
美國政府公債殖利率全線下跌至少 3 個基點，其中 30 年期美債殖利率降至 5.38%，創下 9 月 23 日以來最低。同時，澳洲與紐西蘭公債價格也同步走揚，日元兌美元匯率升幅高達 0.3%。
星展銀行(DBS Bank Ltd.)資深利率策略師 Eugene Leow 表示：「隨著投資人重新審視與 AI 相關的資產，近期的市場情緒似乎更加動搖。」他指出，市場對獲利能力與投資報酬率(ROI)的疑慮正在逐漸浮現。在美債殖利率以近期標準衡量仍處於高位的情況下，投資人希望透過轉向美債尋求安全感，以規避部分風險。
股票市場的跌勢，讓美債重新發揮了避險資產的作用；在此之前，對通膨升溫的擔擔曾推動美債殖利率在最近幾周升至多年新高。
儘管沙烏地阿拉伯發生的致命襲擊事件引發市場對供應前景的疑慮，進而推升原油價格，但資金對美債的避險買盤依然強勁。能源成本上升加深了市場對通膨的擔憂，並促使交易員預期美國聯準會(Fed)及全球其他主要中央銀行將進一步升息。
彭博追蹤美債報酬率的指標在 9 月創下近兩年來最大單月跌幅後，10 月已回升約 1.2%。
澳洲國家銀行(National Australia Bank)利率策略主管 Kenneth Crompton 對此指出：「儘管油價一直在緩步上揚，但美債再次吸引了避險資金的流入。」
除美債外，全球其他主要債市與匯市也受到影響。澳洲 10 年期公債殖利率下跌 3 個基點至 5.25%，紐西蘭 2 年期公債殖利率下滑 2 個基點至 3.91%。在匯市方面，日元兌美元升值 0.3% 至 157.68 日元兌 1 美元，瑞士法郎上漲 0.2%，而美元指數指標則變化不大。
法國Credit Agricole策略師 David Forrester 分析：「標普 500 指數期貨的回檔為日元帶來了推升力道。」他強調：「重要之處在於，這種升勢是全面性的，甚至對美元同樣上揚，這凸顯出在 AI 熱潮遭遇波折時，日元所具備的避險資產地位。」
paras_en: Investors' renewed doubts about the profit prospects of AI trading have caused stock market volatility, prompting safe‑haven money to pour into US government bonds, the Japanese yen and the Swiss franc.

US government bond yields fell across the board by at least three basis points, with the 30‑year Treasury yield dropping to 5.38%, the lowest since September 23. At the same time, Australian and New Zealand government bond prices rose, and the yen gained about 0.3% against the dollar.

Eugene Leow, senior rate strategist at DBS Bank Ltd., said: “As investors re‑evaluate AI‑related assets, market sentiment has become more unsettled.” He noted that concerns over profitability and ROI are emerging, and with Treasury yields still high by recent standards, investors are turning to US bonds for safety and to hedge some risk.
The equity market decline has restored the role of Treasuries as a safe‑haven asset; previously, worries about rising inflation had pushed Treasury yields up to multi‑year highs in recent weeks.

Although a deadly attack in Saudi Arabia raised supply‑side concerns and lifted oil prices, buying pressure for US Treasuries remained strong. Higher energy costs have deepened inflation worries and led traders to expect further rate hikes from the US Federal Reserve and other major central banks worldwide.
Bloomberg’s Treasury yield index, after posting the biggest monthly drop in nearly two years in September, has recovered about 1.2% in October.
Kenneth Crompton, head of rate strategy at National Australia Bank, said: “Even though oil prices have been inching higher, US Treasuries are once again attracting safe‑haven flows.”

Beyond Treasuries, other major bond and currency markets were also affected. Australian 10‑year government bond yields fell three basis points to 5.25%, New Zealand two‑year yields slipped two basis points to 3.91%. In the FX market, the yen appreciated 0.3% to 157.68 per dollar, the Swiss franc rose 0.2%, while the US dollar index was largely unchanged.

David Forrester, a strategist at Credit Agricole in France, analyzed: “The pull‑back in S&P 500 futures provided upward momentum for the yen.” He stressed: “The key point is that this rise is broad‑based, even lifting the dollar, highlighting the yen’s safe‑haven status when the AI hype hits a snag.”

Multiple Iranian officials say they intend to delay talks with the United States to weaken President Trump’s prospects in the November mid‑term elections. Reuters surveys show most economists expect the Bank of Japan (BOJ) to raise rates to 1.50% in December and keep a quarterly‑hike rhythm. Japan’s government reported September imports and exports grew 18.9% and 16.7% year‑on‑year, respectively, below expectations, but strong demand for semiconductor and AI‑related products kept exports up for a 13th consecutive month while the trade deficit narrowed to ¥536.6 billion. Finance Minister Shunichi Suzuki noted rising import costs are pushing Japanese prices higher and that the economy is entering a wage‑driven, sustained inflation phase. The government will stay in close contact with the BOJ, and both sides see no major disagreement on inflation outlook or policy, supporting yen gains as the USD/JPY pair fell from its ¥158.39 high.

As long‑term Japanese government bond yields continue to rise, they are attracting capital back to Japan. BOJ Deputy Governor Masayoshi Amamiya said higher fuel and raw‑material prices are lifting inflation, and robust global AI demand adds upward pressure on prices. He believes Japan’s core inflation is now close to the BOJ’s 2% target, indicating the central bank is ready to raise borrowing costs, widening the USD/JPY decline to a ¥157.82 low. paras: 美元周三(21日)下跌，交易員評估油價上漲再度引發的通膨風險，並等待聯準會(Fed)下週召開會議。澳幣則因央行官員發表偏緊縮言論而走強。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)下跌0.14%，報101.65。
加拿大豐業銀行首席外匯策略師Shaun Osborne表示，「目前市場並沒有一個主導全局的明確主題……我認為這種情況至少會持續到下週聯邦公開市場委員會（FOMC）會議前。我們需要了解聯準會的想法。」
美國與伊朗持續交戰，加深了市場對油價推升通膨可能影響聯準會政策的擔憂。
聯邦基金利率期貨交易員認為，聯準會下週升息的可能性不高，下一次升息預計將落在12月。聯準會主席華許(Kevin Warsh)也不太可能暗示未來的政策走向。
不過，Osborne表示，「我認為，下週市場至少會進一步評估未來升息的可能時間點，相關預期也會變得更加明確。」
投資人也擔心AI交易行情還能持續多久。
儘管上週數據顯示美國9月消費者物價通膨加速，美元仍然走弱。先前市場對AI產業的樂觀情緒吸引資金流入美國，並推升經濟成長與通膨預期，為美元提供支撐。
CIBC Capital Markets外匯策略師Noah Buffam表示，「美國經濟成長很大程度上是由整體AI交易行情所帶動。這也使通膨持續高於目標水準，因此AI對美國的影響比對其他國家更大。」
馬斯克週二表示，合併旗下SpaceX與特斯拉是「一個好主意」，而SpaceX也公布上市以來首次獲利，部分緩解了市場對股市的疑慮。
另一方面，AI伺服器製造商美超微（Super Micro）預估，季營收與利潤率將高於華爾街預期。
歐元兌美元上漲0.01%，至1.1237美元。
法國大規模反政府抗議活動，以及日益惡化的財政前景，持續對歐元造成壓力。法國10年期公債借貸成本週三升至24年來高點。
Saxo全球宏觀策略主管John Hardy表示，「法國的債務問題難以處理。他們確實需要採取適當的財政調整措施，降低債務水準，至少要展現出對債務發展趨勢的重視。」
法國總統馬克宏(Emmanuel Macron)承諾，將防止上週末的暴動與掠奪事件再次發生。同時，黃背心運動(Yellow Vest)已提出計畫，準備於週六在巴黎舉行大型遊行，這將成為法國政府面臨的下一項重大考驗。

paras_en: The dollar fell on Wednesday (the 21st) as traders assessed renewed inflation risks from rising oil prices and waited for the Federal Reserve's meeting next week. The Australian dollar strengthened on tighter‑tone comments from central bank officials.
In the New York close, the dollar index (DXY) tracking the greenback against six major currencies slipped 0.14% to 101.65.

Scotiabank’s chief FX strategist Shaun Osborne said, “There isn’t a clear, dominant theme driving the market right now… I think this will last at least until the FOMC meeting next week. We need to understand the Fed’s thinking.”
The ongoing conflict between the United States and Iran has heightened market concerns that higher oil prices could push inflation up and affect Fed policy.
Federal‑funds futures traders see little chance of a rate hike next week, with the next increase expected in December. Fed Chair Kevin Warsh is also unlikely to signal future policy direction.
However, Osborne added, “I think the market will at least further assess the timing of any future hikes next week, and expectations will become clearer.”
Investors are also worried about how long the AI‑driven market rally can last.

Even though last week’s data showed September U.S. CPI accelerating, the dollar remained weak. Earlier optimism toward the AI sector had drawn capital into the United States, boosting growth and inflation expectations and supporting the greenback.

CIBC Capital Markets FX strategist Noah Buffam said, “U.S. economic growth is largely driven by the overall AI trading rally. That keeps inflation above target, so AI’s impact on the U.S. is greater than on other countries.”
Elon Musk said on Tuesday that merging his SpaceX and Tesla businesses was “a good idea,” and SpaceX reported its first profit since going public, easing some market concerns about equities.
On the other hand, AI server maker Super Micro projected quarterly revenue and margins above Wall Street expectations.
The euro rose 0.01% against the dollar to $1.1237.
Large anti‑government protests in France and a worsening fiscal outlook continue to pressure the euro. France’s 10‑year bond yields rose on Wednesday to a 24‑year high.

Saxo Global macro‑strategy head John Hardy said, “France’s debt problem is hard to solve. They really need to take appropriate fiscal adjustment measures, lower debt levels, and at least show concern for the debt‑development trend.”

French President Emmanuel Macron pledged to prevent a repeat of last weekend’s riots and looting. Meanwhile, the Yellow Vest movement has announced plans for a large march in Paris on Saturday, which will be the next major test for the French government.
Elsewhere, RBA deputy governor Andrew Hauser told a Citi conference that the inflation outlook was “clearly deteriorating,” fueling Australian‑dollar gains.
The Australian dollar rose 0.41% against the U.S. dollar to $0.7031.
The British pound gained 0.16% against the dollar to $1.34. Data showed September UK inflation rose more than expected, strengthening the case for a BoE rate hike in November.
The pound also rose against the euro to its highest level in 17 months.

items.title: 英國財政預算案前夕 英鎊對歐元避險成本創5個月新高
items.title_en: Britain's Budget Looms as GBP/EUR Hedging Cost Hits Five-Month High
paras: 隨著交易員針對下周即將公布的英國財政預算案進行布局，英鎊對歐元匯率波動的避險成本已攀升至5個月來的新高。
其中，涵蓋預算案公布日期的歐元對英鎊一周隱含波動率一度升至 4.88%，創下 5 月以來的最高水準。一周與三周波動率之間的價差大幅偏向短天期，顯示出強烈的事件風險溢價，創下5個月來最大差距，儘管三周期的選擇權同時涵蓋了英國央行與歐洲央行的利率決策會議。
目前市場投資人高度聚焦於英國的財政前景，以及財政大臣希利(John Healey)將如何平衡政府收支。由於英國今年上半年的政府借款高於預期，推升國家債務總額突破 3 兆英鎊(約 4 兆美元)。
選擇權市場的情緒(反映於風險逆轉指標)顯示，儘管交易員支付更高代價以防範預算案公布期間的大幅波動，但市場仍預期未來一周英鎊對歐元將呈現溫和走強。此外，交易員過去常利用歐元來表達英國特有的風險，但此次歐元自身也已面臨財政與地緣政治壓力。
集保結算公司(DTCC)數據顯示，交易員已透過延伸至預算案公布日後的合約防範英鎊對美元下跌，但對歐元的布局則相對分歧。
在預算案存在不確定性的同時，英國 9 月通膨率因汽柴油價格飆升而創下 11 個月新高，強化了市場對升息的預期，使英國央行處於3年多來首次升息的軌道上。對於央行而言，關鍵在於財政聲明是否會改變通膨前景。
施羅德投資(Schroders)全球經濟主管David Rees對此表示：「市場對預算案的期望雖然不高，但任何顯著的財政刺激措施，都可能增加進口通膨變得更加持久的風險，並迫使英國央行進入更長的緊縮周期。」
paras_en: As traders position for next week’s UK fiscal budget announcement, the hedging cost of GBP/EUR volatility has risen to a five‑month peak.

The one‑week implied volatility of EUR/GBP covering the budget release date briefly spiked to 4.88%, the highest since May. The spread between one‑week and three‑week volatilities swung sharply toward the short end, indicating a strong event‑risk premium and the widest gap in five months, even though the three‑week options also encompass both the Bank of England and European Central Bank rate‑setting meetings.

Market participants are now intensely focused on the UK’s fiscal outlook and how Finance Minister John Healey will balance the government’s books. Borrowing in the first half of the year has exceeded expectations, pushing total national debt past £3 trillion (about $4 trillion).

Options‑market sentiment, reflected in the risk‑reversal indicator, shows that although traders are paying higher premiums to guard against large moves during the budget release, the market still expects a modest GBP strength against the euro over the next week. Historically, traders have used the euro to express UK‑specific risk, but this time the euro itself is also under fiscal and geopolitical pressure.

Data from the Depository Trust & Clearing Corporation (DTCC) indicate that traders have extended contracts beyond the budget announcement date to hedge against a GBP fall versus the dollar, while positioning on the euro remains more mixed.

Amid budget uncertainty, September UK inflation hit an 11‑month high driven by soaring petrol and diesel prices, bolstering expectations of further rate hikes and putting the Bank of England on track for its first increase in over three years. For the central bank, the key question is whether the fiscal statement will alter the inflation outlook.

David Rees, global head of economics at Schroders, said: “Market expectations for the budget are modest, but any significant fiscal stimulus could make imported inflation more persistent and force the Bank of England into a longer tightening cycle.”
